jobs.title: Senior Operator/Biotechnologist Ibex® m/f/d
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular build complex to develop and manufacture biological products. It enables companies to get access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain.
The Ibex® Complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow and possibly the next step in your career?

At our location in Visp, in the canton of Valais, we are constantly looking for Biotechnologists with a relevant background at all levels in Life Sciences in order to support our growth in several business units.

Key responsibilities:

• Assignment in various functions within the production facilities in compliance with safety regulations and consideration of cGMP quality requirements.

• Recognition, interpretation and elimination of deviations

• Execution of production steps incl. recording and calculations

• Support in training of new team members

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician etc

• Safety-conscious work

• Knowledge of process engineering

• Fluent English

• German language skills advantageous

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 4-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) è un complesso modulare per lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti biologici. Consente alle aziende di accedere a una soluzione completa, di ottenere velocità e di raggiungere una catena di valori semplificata. Il complesso Ibex® è il nostro contributo alla medicina di domani e forse il prossimo passo nella tua carriera? Nella nostra posizione a Visp, nel cantone del Vallese, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di biotecnologi con un background rilevante a tutti i livelli in Scienze della Vita per sostenere la nostra crescita in diverse unità aziendali. Responsabilità chiave:
• Assegnazione in varie funzioni all'interno degli impianti di produzione in conformità alle normative di sicurezza e alla considerazione dei requisiti di qualità cGMP.
• Riconoscimento, interpretazione e eliminazione delle deviazioni
• Esecuzione delle fasi di produzione, comprese le registrazioni e i calcoli
• Supporto per la formazione di nuovi membri del team Requisiti chiave:
• Formazione chimica completa / biofarmaceutica
• Esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica come operatore / tecnico di produzione ecc
• Lavoro sicuro
• Conoscenza dell'ingegneria dei processi
• Inglese fluido
• competenze linguistiche tedesche vantaggiose
• Volontà di lavoro a turni (ad esempio modello a 4 turni) con programmazione flessibile del lavoro Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen. Es ermöglicht Unternehmen den Zugang zu einer Komplettlösung, gewinnt an Geschwindigkeit und erreicht eine vereinfachte Wertschöpfungskette. Der Ibex® Komplex ist unser Beitrag zur Medizin von morgen und möglicherweise der nächste Schritt in Ihrer Karriere? An unserem Standort in Visp, im Wallis, sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach Biotechnologen mit einem relevanten Hintergrund auf allen Ebenen der Life Sciences, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Zuweisung in verschiedenen Funktionen innerhalb der Produktionsanlagen unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen.
• Anerkennung, Interpretation und Beseitigung von Abweichungen
• Durchführung von Produktionsschritten inkl. Aufzeichnung und Berechnungen
• Unterstützung bei der Schulung neuer Teammitglieder Hauptanforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene chemische / biopharmazeutische Ausbildung
• Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion als Bediener/Produktionstechniker etc.
• Sicherheitsbewusstes Arbeiten
• Kenntnisse der Verfahrenstechnik
• fließendes Englisch
• Deutschkenntnisse vorteilhaft
• Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten (z. B. 4-Schicht-Muster) mit flexibler Arbeitsplanung Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird. Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht. Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) est un complexe modulaire de fabrication de produits biologiques. Il permet aux entreprises d'accéder à une solution complète, de gagner en vitesse et de réaliser une chaîne de valeur simplifiée. Le Complexe Ibex® est notre contribution à la médecine de demain et peut-être la prochaine étape de votre carrière? Sur notre site à Viège, dans le canton du Valais, nous recherchons en permanence des biotechnologues ayant une formation pertinente à tous les niveaux en Sciences de la Vie afin de soutenir notre croissance dans plusieurs unités commerciales. Principales responsabilités :
• Attribution de diverses fonctions dans les installations de production conformément aux règles de sécurité et à la prise en compte des exigences de qualité des BPFc.
• Reconnaissance, interprétation et élimination des écarts
• Exécution des étapes de production incluant enregistrement et calculs
• Soutien à la formation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe Principales exigences:
• Formation chimique / biopharmaceutique terminée
• Expérience professionnelle dans la production pharmaceutique en tant qu'opérateur/technicien de production, etc.
• Travail soucieux de la sécurité
• Connaissance de l'ingénierie des procédés
• Anglais couramment
• Compétences linguistiques allemandes avantageuses
• Volonté de travailler par équipes (par exemple, 4 postes) avec un horaire de travail flexible Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: BIO Operator P1P2 4 Schicht (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp suchen wir einen BIO Operator (m/w/d):

Aufgaben:

• Selbstständiges Fahren der ihm vertrauten Teile der Produktionsanlage gemäss Vorgabedokumenten (Herstellungsprotokolle/ Bedienungsanleitungen / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOP)

• Sichere und richtige Arbeitsausführung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP Qualitätsanforderungen

• Verantwortung für Sauberkeit und Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie den zugewiesenen Räumen und Lagern

• Erledigen von Überwachungs-, Instandhaltungs-, und Reinigungsarbeiten sowie das Melden und Beheben von Mängeln und Störungen in der Anlage inklusive deren Dokumentation

• Jeder Mitarbeiter / in ist als gleichwertiges Teammitglied durch Seine / Ihre aktive Mithilfe an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen  beteiligt.

Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung  vorausgesetzt

• Chemische oder pharmatechnologische Ausbildung sowie GMP und / oder BICO Ausbildung von Vorteil

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort, Schrift und Verständnis

• Akkurate Arbeits- und Dokumentationsweise

• Ausführung der Arbeiten mit hohem Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit ( 4 Schicht-Betrieb) mit Flexibilität bei der Arbeitseinteilung

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Compiti:

• Responsabilità per la pulizia e l'ordine sul posto di lavoro, nonché per le stanze e i depositi assegnati

• Lavori di monitoraggio, manutenzione e pulizia completati, nonché di segnalazione e riparazione di difetti e difetti nell'impianto, compresa la documentazione

Profilo dei requisiti:

• Formazione professionale completata

• La formazione chimica o farmaceutica, nonché la formazione GMP e/o BICO sono utili

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola, scrittura e comprensione

• Lavoro e documentazione accurati

Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is now a world leader in the Life Science business, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for how we work. Our most important scientific solution is to create talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, whether large or small, improve the world. And this is the kind of work we want to have part in.

At the Visp site we are looking for a BIO Operator (m/f/d):

Tasks:

• Self-driving of the parts of the production plant familiar to him according to specifications (production protocols/ user manuals/working instructions/SOP)

• Safe and correct work execution in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order in the workplace, as well as the assigned rooms and storage facilities

• Completed monitoring, maintenance and cleaning work as well as reporting and repairing defects and faults in the plant including their documentation

• Each employee / in is involved as an equivalent team member through his / her active assistance in continuous improvement processes.

Requirements profile:

• Vocational training completed provided

• Chemical or pharmatechnological training as well as GMP and/or BICO training is beneficial

• Good German knowledge in word, writing and understanding

• Accurate working and documentation

• Execution of the work with high safety and quality awareness

• The shiftwork is prepared (four shifts) with flexibility in the division of labour

Lonza's products and services have a daily positive impact on millions of people. This is not only a great honour for us, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important for us as our own successes. Lonza places great emphasis on respect and we protect our employees as well as our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is where people come to meet challenges and develop new ideas for complex problems with their creativity in life science. Together, we contribute to improving the lives of many people around the world, offering them the certainty and satisfaction of making a real difference with their own work.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist Mammalian (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for several Manufacturing Specialists for our Ibex-facility. In this role, you will be responsible for executing operational activities of assigned manufacturing projects in specific areas (Up-stream or Down-stream processing).

Key responsibilities:

• Execute manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Engage in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of new manufacturing units as manufacturing expert. Responsible for delivering all input required for the specific set-up, commissioning and qualification of the manufacturing suites and equipment

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related disciplines is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation or in the area protein purification

• Excellent communication skills, team player, driven and solution-oriented

descriptionByLocale.it:

Lonza è oggi un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nel settore delle scienze della vita, attiva in tre continenti. Operiamo nel campo della scienza, ma non esiste una formula magica per il modo in cui affrontiamo il lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante sono i collaboratori di talento, che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri collaboratori gestiscono autonomamente la propria carriera. Perché le loro idee, grandi o piccole che siano, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui desideriamo far parte.

Presso la sede di Visp è ricercato/a un/una tecnico/a di laboratorio per il reparto QC Microbiologia. In qualità di membro del nostro giovane e dinamico team di microbiologia, sarai responsabile dell'esecuzione routinaria di diversi metodi microbiologici nel rispetto delle direttive GMP e di sicurezza.

Le vostre mansioni:

- Esecuzione dei metodi analitici nell'ambito di competenza, valutazione, revisione e stesura dei rapporti sui risultati.
- Redazione di protocolli di analisi, istruzioni di prova e brevi rapporti.
- Documentazione di tutte le attività di laboratorio in conformità alle GMP e alle direttive interne.
- Rispetto delle prescrizioni in materia di qualità (SOP e GMP) e sicurezza.
- Pulizia e ordine in laboratorio.
- Focus metodologico principale: identificazione dei microrganismi e misurazione delle endotossine.

Il vostro profilo:

- Formazione completata come tecnico/a di laboratorio, BTA o BSC con specializzazione in biologia, biochimica o settore affine.
- Conoscenza fluente del tedesco; l'inglese costituisce un vantaggio.
- L'esperienza pratica di laboratorio (in particolare l'esperienza con tecniche di analisi microbiologica) costituisce un vantaggio.
- Le conoscenze nell'ambito delle GMP costituiscono un vantaggio.

Offriamo

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno ogni giorno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo rappresenta non solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Il modo in cui raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è per noi importante tanto quanto i risultati stessi. In Lonza il rispetto è fondamentale e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti sia il nostro ambiente. Per noi, il successo significa un progresso eticamente sostenibile.

In Lonza arrivano persone che accettano le sfide e, con la loro creatività nel campo delle scienze della vita, sviluppano nuove idee per problematiche complesse. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Lonza is today a globally leading company in the field of Life Sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach our work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, both big and small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of.

A laboratory technician in QC Microbiology is being sought at the Visp site. As a member of our young and dynamic microbiology team, you will be responsible for routinely performing various microbiological methods in compliance with GMP and safety guidelines.

Your responsibilities:

- Performing analytical methods within the area of responsibility, evaluating, reviewing and reporting the results.
- Preparing analysis protocols, test instructions and brief reports.
- Documenting all laboratory activities in accordance with GMP and internal guidelines.
- Complying with quality (SOP and GMP) and safety regulations.
- Cleanliness and order in the laboratory.
- Main methodological focus: Microbial identifications and endotoxin measurements.

Your profile:

- Completed training as a laboratory technician, BTA, or BSC with a specialization in biology, biochemistry or a similar field.
- Fluent German and English are an advantage.
- Hands-on laboratory experience (particularly experience with microbiological analytical techniques) is a plus.
- Knowledge of GMP is a plus.

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is highly valued, and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means ethically responsible progress.

People come to Lonza who embrace challenges and use their creativity in the field of life sciences to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together, they make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This gives them the certainty and satisfaction of truly making a difference through their own work.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is now a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, we are looking for an apprentice laboratory technician in EFZ Chemie. As a laboratory technician EFZ Chemie, you work in laboratories in various fields such as research and development, analytics, synthesis and partly also in biology. Your task as a laboratory technician EFZ Chemie is to carry out laboratory tests. In these trials, you make new products and analyze them. Your tasks also include quality control / analysis of products from the companies. You create a work plan, get the materials and chemicals you need, and decide which appliances are best for work.

Your education
The teaching lasts three years. At the beginning of the apprenticeship, you will complete an introductory course in the modern Lonza training laboratory for 5 months. Then you go on rotation in the various laboratories of Lonza. In four internships, each lasting five to seven months, you will work in the various departments such as Research & Development, Synthesis, Analytics and Biology. Vocational education is attended for one and a half days per week.

Your profile

• Enthusiasm for chemistry, physics and mathematics

• Initiative and creativity

• Structured thinking

• Precise work

• Good technical understanding

• High reliability and persistence

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

• Modern training in our own teaching companies

Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who accept challenges and with their creativity in the field
Life Science develops new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Sur le site de Visp, nous recherchons un apprenti chimique et pharmacologue/technologue EFZ. En tant que chimique et pharmacotechnologue, vous travaillez dans des entreprises de production, de développement et d'enseignement dans les industries chimiques, pharmaceutiques et biotechnologiques. Vous contrôlez et surveillez les usines de fabrication automatisées pour la production d'ingrédients actifs pour les médicaments, les produits chimiques fins ou les produits phytopharmaceutiques. Souvent vous travaillez en équipe, parce que plusieurs personnes sont nécessaires pour les activités de processus. Mais aussi des travaux qui doivent être effectués à la main, comme la préparation de produits chimiques, le remplissage, l'échantillonnage et la préparation du produit sont nécessaires. En cas de déviation ou de perturbation, vous prenez immédiatement les mesures nécessaires. En plus de la production, les pièces de l'usine sont nettoyées, des contrôles fonctionnels et des travaux d'entretien mineurs sont effectués.

Votre éducation
L'enseignement dure trois ans. La formation pratique est complétée par des spécialistes en chimie et en pharmacotechnologie dans plusieurs entreprises de production de l'industrie chimique, biotechnologique ou pharmaceutique. L'école professionnelle est fréquentée en moyenne un jour et demi par semaine.

Votre profil

• Intérêt pour la chimie, la physique et les mathématiques

• Bonne compréhension technique

• Capacité de concentration élevée et bonne capacité d'observation

• Bonne constitution physique

• Travail d'équipe

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau minimum B2)

Nous offrons
Chez Lonza, nous croyons fermement qu'en plus d'apprendre une profession, le développement personnel dès le premier jour est important. Nous formons donc nos apprenants non seulement en tant que professionnels qualifiés, mais aussi en tant que personnalités indépendantes. Cela vous permet de faire un début prometteur à votre carrière.

• La formation moderne dans nos propres entreprises d'enseignement

• Formateurs professionnels*

• GA pour CHF 1.- par jour

• Enseignement plus 1

• AFS – Année à l'étranger

• Groupe de travail sur l ' apprentissage

• Enseignement adapté aux sports de performance

• 6 semaines de vacances par an

• Matériel informatique personnel

Veuillez nous envoyer les documents suivants avec votre demande :

• Lettre de motivation

• CVC

• Copies des certificats scolaires des deux dernières années

• Vérification multiple (si disponible)

• Procès-verbal d ' essai (le cas échéant)

Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes chaque jour. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante pour nous que nos succès eux-mêmes. À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Lonza est rejoint par des gens qui acceptent les défis et avec leur créativité dans le domaine
Life Science développe de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

jobs.description:
As an Intern QC Lab Associate at Lonza AG in Visp, you will join a dynamic and international environment where you can actively contribute to meaningful projects and develop your technical skills. This role is ideal for individuals who are eager to learn, enjoy hands‑on laboratory work, and want to grow within a global organization.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

Key responsibilities:

• Carry out routine analysis of assigned analytical methods, in compliance with GMP and safety guidelines

• Contribute to method implementation, validation and method transfer

• Administrative activities, such as documenting the results and creating work instructions

• Support laboratory maintenance (responsibility for equipment) and ensure that the laboratory is clean and tidy

Key requirements

• You have started or completed and apprenticeship program as a Laboratory Technician, or you have started or completed your BSc / MSc studies in life sciences

• First experience in analytical lab work, e.g. at school or at university, or in another company

• Experience in the field of Quality Control and GMP is a plus

• You are independent, responsible and have a very precise way of working

• You have good communication and teamwork skills and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration

• You enjoy being part of a young, dynamic team, are committed and have initiative

• Fluent in either German or English (language skills in the respective other language is a plus)

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)
Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du die Qualitätskontrolle der Biologics-Produktion am Standort Visp. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, dass Medikamente weltweit sicher und wirksam eingesetzt werden können. Der Job bietet Abwechslung, Verantwortung und attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – im modernen Labor und im gut strukturierten 4‑Schicht‑Modell.

Was du bekommst

• Ein modernes Laborumfeld mit erstklassiger Ausstattung.

• Eine inklusive, kollegiale Arbeitskultur mit klaren Entwicklungspfaden.

• ÖV-Unterstützung, Aktienprogramme, erweiterte Elternzeit und starke Pensionskassenleistungen; Alle lokalen Benefits am Standort Visp

• Drei interne Analysten-Stufen für eine Karriere ohne Führungsverantwortung und die Möglichkeit bis zu 150 verschiedene Methoden zu erlernen.

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Spezialisierungsmöglichkeiten.

Dein Arbeitsplatz
Unser Labor wurde 2022 neu gebaut – modern, effizient und technisch auf dem neuesten Stand. Wir leben eine offene Feedback-Kultur: Verbesserungsvorschläge von Analystinnen und Analysten werden ernst genommen, bewertet und aktiv umgesetzt (Kaizen-Prinzip). Wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden – gemeinsam und mit echtem Teamgeist.

Was du tust

• Du führst mikrobiologische, biochemische und physikalisch‑chemische Analysen unter GMP-Bedingungen durch, z.B. Bioburden, Endotoxin, HPLC / Chromatographie, UV oder TOC

• Du stellst im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb die zeitkritische Analyse und Freigabe von Produktions-Chargen sicher.

• Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen.

• Du unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse nach dem Kaizen-Prinzip.

• Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter – als Spezialist/in oder Generalist/in, je nach deinen Interessen.

Was du mitbringst

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in EFZ oder eine naturwissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger/innen mit Erfahrung in Schichtarbeit und/oder in einem regulierten, hygienisch kontrollierten Arbeitsumfeld werden berücksichtigt.

• Erste Laborerfahrung und GMP-Kenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Freude an präziser Laborarbeit, Verantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

• Deutsch-Kenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B1; Englisch-Kenntnisse von Vorteil.

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Modell (Frühschicht 5:00Uhr) und Wohnort in erreichbarer Nähe zu Visp.

• Hands-on Mentalität, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation für langfristige Entwicklung.

Über Lonza
Lonza zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Life‑Sciences‑Industrie. Entra a far parte del nostro team come Manufacturing Specialist a 4 turni 80-100% (m/f/d) e contribuisci attivamente alle nostre campagne di produzione microbica con le tue competenze.

In questo ruolo versatile, seguirai le campagne di fermentazione e purificazione sotto il profilo organizzativo e tecnico, garantirai un processo produttivo sicuro ed efficiente e lavorerai a stretto contatto con diversi reparti specialistici.

Cosa offriamo:

- Un percorso di carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
- Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
- Programmi retributivi che premiano le prestazioni elevate

- Garantire il regolare svolgimento dei processi mediante il supporto organizzativo e tecnico alle campagne di fermentazione e purificazione – con particolare attenzione a qualità, efficienza e sicurezza

- Affiancare tecnicamente gli operatori e trasmettere loro conoscenze sugli impianti e sulle procedure standardizzate
- Garantire, verificare e ottimizzare continuamente le istruzioni di produzione, le SOP e la documentazione dei batch

- Laurea (Bachelor/Master) in biotecnologia, microbiologia o ingegneria biochimica/chimica

- La conoscenza delle GMP è auspicabile – oppure la disponibilità ad acquisirla
- Disponibilità a lavorare con un sistema flessibile a 4 turni

I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come collaboriamo. Le idee di ogni singola persona, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale per migliorare milioni di vite, ed è proprio a questo che desideriamo renderti partecipe.

In Lonza apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Description

Become part of our team as a Manufacturing Specialist 4-shift 80-100% (m/f/d) and actively support our microbial production campaigns with your expertise.

In this versatile role, you will provide organizational and technical support for fermentation and purification campaigns, ensure a safe and efficient production process, and work closely with various departments.

What we offer:

- An agile career and a dynamic work culture
- An inclusive and ethical workplace
- Compensation programs that recognize high performance
- In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the full list of our global benefits at: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Your responsibilities:

- Ensuring smooth operations through organizational and technical support of fermentation and purification campaigns – with a focus on quality, efficiency and safety
- Monitoring and controlling planned process steps during the upstream (fermentation) and downstream phases
- Active participation in microbial production processes (e.g., fermentation, cell harvest, purification) in compliance with applicable cGMP guidelines – including troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous process optimization
- Contribute to risk assessments and implement defined safety and quality measures
- Providing technical guidance and knowledge transfer to operators on equipment and standardized procedures
- Ensuring, reviewing and continuously optimizing manufacturing instructions, SOPs and batch documentation

Your qualifications:

- Completed degree (Bachelor/Master) in biotechnology, microbiology or bio-/chemical engineering
- Experience in microbial production processes (particularly fermentation and/or purification) is an advantage
- GMP knowledge is desirable – or the willingness to acquire it
- Willingness to work in a flexible 4-shift system
- Very good German language skills are required; English language skills are an advantage
- Teamwork, strong communication skills and a structured, solution-oriented way of working – you actively contribute your ideas

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to make the medicines of tomorrow. Join us as Head of Plant Engineering 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp and take ownership of engineering operations, maintenance strategy, utilities, and capital investments while leading a talented team and driving operational excellence across our facilities.

jobs.description:

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join our growing manufacturing teams in Visp and contribute to the production of life-changing medicines. This is an exciting opportunity for biotechnologists at various career stages to work in a highly innovative life sciences environment while developing technical expertise and supporting global healthcare advancements.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

- Documentazione di tutte le attività di laboratorio secondo GMP e linee guida interne.
- Rispetto delle norme di qualità (SOP e GMP) e di sicurezza.
- Pulizia e ordine in laboratorio.
- Focus metodologico principale: identificazioni dei germi e misurazioni delle endotossine.

Il tuo profilo richiesto:

- Formazione completata come tecnico di laboratorio, BTA o BSC con specializzazione in biologia, biochimica o campo simile.
- Il tedesco e l'inglese fluenti sono un vantaggio.
- L'esperienza pratica di laboratorio (in particolare l'esperienza con le tecniche di analisi microbiologiche) è un vantaggio.
- La conoscenza della GMP è un plus.

Offriamo

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Il modo in cui raggiungiamo i nostri risultati commerciali è importante per noi quanto i nostri successi. In Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Successo per noi significa progresso moralmente sostenibile.

Da Lonza arrivano persone che affrontano sfide e sviluppano nuove idee per problemi complessi con la loro creatività nel campo delle scienze della vita. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo dà loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are seeking an experienced Chemist / Chemical Engineer (m/f/d) with strong expertise in Downstream Processing (DSP) and in particular in preparative chromatography to join our team in Visp. In this strategic role, you will be responsible for the continuous improvement and advancement of DSP technologies across development and manufacturing, helping to maintain and strengthen the organization's competitive position in this field.

As a senior scientific and technical expert, you will provide leadership in DSP technologies, develop process, support other experts, serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, support commercial and business development activities, and contribute to strategic investment and growth initiatives.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

Benefits in Visp:  https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you will do:

• Drive continuous improvement and innovation in DSP technologies by staying current with industry developments and collaborating closely with Manufacturing, QA, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams

• Act as the organization's technical and scientific expert for DSP technologies in customer interactions, commercial events, and the broader scientific community, while supporting technical sales activities and global sites

• Lead and/or support DSP process development projects, including planning, supervision, and evaluation of laboratory activities, ensuring delivery against quality, cost, and timeline objectives

• Support the transfer of DSP manufacturing processes into GMP production facilities and provide technical expertise during manufacturing campaigns

• Lead or support troubleshooting activities, investigations, deviation assessments, document reviews, and process improvements in collaboration with Production, QA, QC, and customers

• Define and support investment strategies for DSP equipment and technologies, including the evaluation and execution of capital investment projects

• Drive growth and innovation initiatives by leading end-to-end DSP projects and contributing to strategic business development activities

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline

• Extensive expertise in Downstream Processing (DSP) within the biopharmaceutical, chemical, or related industry

• Proven experience with preparative HPLC (Prep HPLC) and chromatographic purification processes is required

• Strong background in process development, scale-up, and technology transfer

• Experience working in GMP-regulated environments is an advantage

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Proven track record in leading large-scale CAPEX, investment, or technology implementation projects, delivering high-quality results on time; fluent English required, German is a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

• Promuovere iniziative di crescita e innovazione con i principali progetti DSP end-to-end e contribuire alle attività strategiche di sviluppo aziendale

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• PhD in Chimica, Ingegneria Chimica, o una disciplina scientifica correlata

• Ampia esperienza nella lavorazione a valle (DSP) nell'industria biofarmaceutica, chimica o relativa

• È richiesta un'esperienza comprovata con HPLC preparatorio (Prep HPLC) e processi di purificazione cromatografica

• Forte sfondo nello sviluppo di processo, scala-up e trasferimento di tecnologia

• L'esperienza di lavoro in ambienti GMP regolamentati è un vantaggio

• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di leadership, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo

• Provato record di pista in grandi dimensioni CAPEX, investimenti, o progetti di implementazione della tecnologia, offrendo risultati di alta qualità in tempo; richiesto fluente inglese, tedesco è un plus.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?
Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Manager (f/m/d) within QA Analytics is ensuring that all processes within the QC functional areas comply with GxP, data integrity and regulatory requirements as well with internal/external quality standards. As a Quality and Compliance representative for particular functional area, you are a key member in cross-functional teams, serving as an interface between QC and QA Operations and interact with senior stakeholders across the site.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Represent QA Analytics in cross-functional teams and meetings

• Represent QA concerns to the Quality Control (QC) and ensure that GxP requirements are met and global/local procedures (SOP) are followed

• Review and approve QC/AD related documents (e.g. method transfer documents, method validation documents, SOP, etc.)

• Review and approve TW records related to QC processes

• Ensure QC deviations/investigations are appropriately investigated and documented following regulatory requirements

• Act as decision-maker during QC deviations/investigation process

• Responsible to drive QA Analytics and QC related CAPA and Effectiveness Check items to completion and timely closing

• Ensure that documents are correct and adhere to SOPs and to customer’s requirements

• Represent specific functional areas as QA Analytics Subject Matter Expert (SME) and provide guidance and recommendations in these areas to internal or external stakeholders

• Support and drive specific projects as well as revise and approve SOPs

• Support QC during regulatory inspections and customer audits.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Chemistry/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/ Life Science or related field

• Profound working experience in the pharmaceutical industry within QC/QA required

• Founded analytical expertise and experience with analytical method validation, change management, deviation management and OOx investigations

• Strong background in cGMP regulations, incl. USP, European and Japanese Pharmacopeia

• Auditing experience and experience in interaction with Health Authorities (FDA, Swissmedic)

• Experience in working in cross-functional teams

• Excellent verbal and written communication in English required; German is advantageous.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
Lehrstelle Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/in EFZ per 01. August 2027 (100%)

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Lonza in Stein (AG) bietet eine spannende Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologen/-login EFZ an. In dieser dreijährigen Lehre spezialisierst du dich in der Ansatzherstellung im aseptischen Bereich. Du bist Teil eines motivierten Teams und steuerst und überwachst den Produktionsprozess von Medikamenten sowie unterstützt bei der Behebung von Störungen. Während deiner Ausbildung bei Lonza arbeitest du mit hochmodernen, automatisierten Produktionsanlagen im Entwicklungsbereich und erlernst den Umgang mit pharmatechnologischen Verfahren.

Neben der Arbeit im Betrieb besuchst du an zwei Tagen pro Woche die Berufsfachschule in Aarau. Dort lernst du alles Wichtige für deinen Beruf. Während der Ausbildung besuchst du zudem insgesamt 45 Tage überbetriebliche Kurse (üK), in denen du praktische Fertigkeiten trainierst und dein Fachwissen erweiterst.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Gesamten aseptische Ansatzherstellungsprozess überwachen, beobachten, protokollieren

• Durchführung von Inprozesskontrollen (IPC), Integritätstests und Funktionskontrollen am Produktionsablauf

• Steuern und überwachen von automatisierten Produktionsanlagen

• Mikrobiologische Probenahme

• Vor- und Nachbereitung von Räumen und Gerätschaften

• Richtlinien einhalten zum Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz sowie zur Arbeitssicherheit

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Schulabschluss im mittleren oder oberen Niveau (bei sehr guten Leistungen auch Basisniveau) oder Matura/Abitur

• Interesse an technischen und naturwissenschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

• Hohe Konzentrationsfähigkeit und eine gute Beobachtungsgabe sowie vernetztes Denken

• Motivation und Durchhaltewille

Benefits für Lernende:

• 6 Wochen Ferien und zusätzlich bezahlte Feiertage

• Generalabonnement (GA) für CHF 1.- pro Tag

• Persönliches IT-Equipment

• Ermässigung im Personalrestaurant (Lunch-Check) sowie kostenlos Wasser, Kaffee, Tee

• E-Bikes für private und geschäftliche Fahrten

• Kostenlosen, unbegrenzten Zugang zu Online-Lernplattformen und Sprachkursen

Du interessierst dich für unsere Lehrstelle und willst Teil von Lonza werden? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung über unser Recruiting-Tool mit folgenden Unterlagen:
• Zeugnisse der letzten drei Schuljahre (Sekundarschule)
• Lebenslauf mit Foto
• Motivationsschreiben

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Apprendistato chimico e farmaceutico Tecnologo/in EFZ a partire dal 01. agosto 2027 (100%)

Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Lonza in Stein (AG) offre un'emozionante formazione come chimico e farmacista/login EFZ. In questo apprendistato di tre anni, sei specializzato in preparazione asettica. Sarà parte di un team motivato e controllerà e monitorerà il processo di produzione di farmaci, così come aiutare a risolvere i disturbi. Durante il vostro apprendistato a Lonza, lavorerete con impianti di produzione automatizzati all'avanguardia nel settore dello sviluppo e imparerete come utilizzare i processi farmacologici.

Oltre a lavorare in azienda, si visita la Scuola Professionale di Aarau due giorni alla settimana. Qui si impara tutto importante per la vostra professione. Durante la formazione, parteciperai anche ad un totale di 45 giorni di corsi intercompany (ÜK), in cui ti allenerai competenze pratiche ed espanderai la tua esperienza.

I vostri compiti:

• Monitorare, osservare, registrare l'intero processo di preparazione asettica

• Attuazione dei controlli in-process (IPC), test di integrità e controlli funzionali sul processo di produzione

• Controllo e monitoraggio di impianti di produzione automatizzati

• Campionamento microbiologico

• Preparazione e follow-up di camere e attrezzature

• Rispetto degli orientamenti in materia di tutela della salute e dell'ambiente e sicurezza del lavoro

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Livello più alto o intermedio (per prestazioni molto buone anche livello di base) o Matura/Abitur

• Interessi in contesti tecnici e scientifici

• Alta capacità di concentrazione e una buona capacità di osservazione e pensiero in rete

• Motivazione e perseveranza

Vantaggi per gli studenti:

• 6 settimane vacanze e ferie aggiuntive pagate

• Abbonamento generale (GA) per CHF 1.- al giorno

• Attrezzature informatiche personali

• Sconto nel ristorante del personale (controllo pranzo) così come acqua gratuita, caffè, tè

• E-bike per viaggi privati e di lavoro

• Accesso gratuito e illimitato a piattaforme di apprendimento online e corsi di lingua

Sei interessato al nostro apprendistato e vuoi entrare a far parte di Lonza? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online tramite il nostro strumento di reclutamento con i seguenti documenti:
• Certificati degli ultimi tre anni di scuola (scuola secondaria)
• CV con foto
• Lettera di motivazione

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Apprenticeship Chemical and Pharmaceutical Technologist/in EFZ as of 01. August 2027 (100%)

Lonza is now a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

Lonza in Stein (AG) offers an exciting training as a chemical and pharmacologist/login EFZ. In this three-year apprenticeship, you specialize in aseptic preparation. You will be part of a motivated team and will control and monitor the production process of medications as well as assist in resolving disorders. During your apprenticeship at Lonza, you will work with state-of-the-art, automated production facilities in the development sector and learn how to use pharmatechnological processes.

In addition to working in the company, you visit the Vocational School in Aarau two days a week. There you learn everything important for your profession. During the training, you will also attend a total of 45 days of intercompany courses (ÜK), in which you will train practical skills and expand your expertise.

Your tasks:

• Monitor, observe, log entire aseptic preparation process

• Implementation of in-process controls (IPC), integrity tests and functional controls on the production process

• Control and monitor automated production facilities

• Microbiological sampling

• Preparation and follow-up of rooms and equipment

• Compliance with guidelines on health and environmental protection and occupational safety

Your requirement profile:

• Higher or intermediate level (for very good performances also basic level) or Matura/Abitur

• Interest in technical and scientific contexts

• High concentration ability and a good observation ability as well as networked thinking

• Motivation and perseverance

Benefits for learners:

• 6 weeks holidays and additional paid holidays

• General subscription (GA) for CHF 1.- per day

• Personal IT equipment

• Discount in the staff restaurant (lunch check) as well as free water, coffee, tea

• E-bikes for private and business trips

• Free, unlimited access to online learning platforms and language courses

Are you interested in our apprenticeship and want to become part of Lonza? Then we look forward to your online application via our recruiting tool with the following documents:
• Certificates of the last three years of school (secondary school)
• CV with photo
• Letter of motivation

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Apprentissage Technologue chimique et pharmaceutique/en EFZ au 1er août 2027 (100 %)

Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Lonza in Stein (AG) offre une formation passionnante en tant que produit chimique et pharmacologue/login EFZ. Dans cet apprentissage de trois ans, vous vous spécialisez dans la préparation aseptique. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe motivée et contrôlerez et surveillerez le processus de production des médicaments et aiderez à résoudre les troubles. Pendant votre apprentissage à Lonza, vous travaillerez avec des installations de production automatisées de pointe dans le secteur du développement et apprendrez à utiliser les procédés pharmaceutiques.

En plus de travailler dans l'entreprise, vous visitez l'école professionnelle à Aarau deux jours par semaine. Là, vous apprenez tout ce qui est important pour votre profession. Au cours de la formation, vous assisterez également à un total de 45 jours de cours interentreprises (ÜK), dans lesquels vous formerez des compétences pratiques et développerez votre expertise.

Vos tâches:

• Surveiller, observer, enregistrer le processus complet de préparation aseptique

• Mise en oeuvre des contrôles en cours de fabrication (CPI), des essais d'intégrité et des contrôles fonctionnels du processus de production

• Contrôler et surveiller les installations de production automatisée

• Échantillonnage microbiologique

• Préparation et suivi des locaux et du matériel

• Respect des directives en matière de santé et de protection de l'environnement et de sécurité au travail

Votre profil d'exigence:

• Niveau supérieur ou intermédiaire (pour de très bonnes performances aussi niveau de base) ou Matura/Abitur

• Intérêt pour les contextes techniques et scientifiques

• Capacité de concentration élevée et bonne capacité d'observation ainsi que pensée en réseau

• Motivation et persévérance

Avantages pour les apprenants:

• 6 semaines de vacances et jours fériés supplémentaires payés

• Abonnement général (GA) pour CHF 1.- par jour

• Matériel informatique personnel

• Réduction dans le restaurant du personnel (contrôle de lunch) ainsi que l'eau gratuite, café, thé

• Vélos électriques pour les voyages privés et professionnels

• Accès libre et illimité aux plateformes d'apprentissage en ligne et aux cours de langues

Vous êtes intéressé par notre apprentissage et souhaitez faire partie de Lonza? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne via notre outil de recrutement avec les documents suivants:
• Certificats des trois dernières années d'études secondaires
• CV avec photo
• Lettre de motivation

Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes chaque jour. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante pour nous que nos succès eux-mêmes. À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Lonza est rejoint par des personnes qui prennent des défis et utilisent leur créativité pour développer de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

• Fehlersuche und Problemlösung von Steuerungs- und Automatisierungssysteme an technischen Anlagen

• Programmieren und Inbetriebnahme von Anlagen und Geräten

• Durchführung von Instandhaltungsarbeiten wie Kalibrierung, Updates und Elektroschemen an Anlagen

• Erarbeiten von technischen Dokumentationen und Unterlagen

• Planen, abwickeln und überwachen von Kleinprojekten

• Begeisterung für die Automatisierung von Prozessanlagen

• Technisches Flair

• Analytisches Denkvermögen und räumliche Vorstellungskraft

• Interesse an neuen Technologien und an der Elektrotechnik

• Feinmotorische Fähigkeiten für genaues Arbeiten

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui travaillent ensemble et développent des idées pour aider d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés façonnent activement leur carrière, parce que leurs idées, grandes ou petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Lonza à Bâle vous offre une formation passionnante et pratique comme assistant de laboratoire / à EFZ Chemie.
Dans cet apprentissage de trois ans, vous apprendrez à connaître différents domaines de travail chimiques. La langue de l'entreprise est l'anglais, ce qui vous permet d'utiliser vos compétences linguistiques sur une base quotidienne et de les développer continuellement. Vous réaliserez des expériences, produireez des résultats, travaillerez avec des équipements de laboratoire modernes et aurez un aperçu complet du monde de l'industrie chimique et pharmaceutique.
Vous développerez une compréhension approfondie des réactions chimiques, des méthodes d'analyse, des règlements sur la sécurité et l'environnement et des exigences réglementaires. Au cours de votre formation, vous serez supervisé par des formateurs professionnels expérimentés et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec différents domaines spécialisés.

La formation théorique a lieu à l'école professionnelle de Muttenz (BL). Vous y apprendrez toutes les connaissances de base dans les domaines respectifs. La formation est complétée par des cours interentreprises (üK), dans lesquels vous acquérez des compétences pratiques supplémentaires.

Vos tâches:

• Effectuer des expériences et des analyses chimiques et physicochimiques

• Travailler avec des équipements modernes de laboratoire et d'analyse

• Documentation et évaluation des résultats des essais conformément aux normes scientifiques et réglementaires

• Préparation et manipulation des échantillons de divers produits chimiques et substances

• Participation au développement et à l'optimisation des procédés chimiques

• Soutien à la recherche, au contrôle de la qualité et à la production

Votre profil d'exigence:

• Enseignement supérieur ou intermédiaire ou diplôme

• Intérêt pour la chimie, les sciences naturelles et les travaux de laboratoire

• Travail précis, prudent et responsable

• Profitez du travail pratique et de l'équipement technique de manutention

• Travail d'équipe et fiabilité

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en mots et en écriture

Avantages pour les apprenants:

• 6 semaines de vacances et jours fériés supplémentaires payés

• Abonnement général (GA) pour CHF 1.- par jour

• Matériel informatique personnel

• Lunch Check est un avantage alimentaire qui vous permet d'obtenir une réduction ou de payer des repas gratuitement

• Vélos électriques pour les voyages privés et professionnels

• Accès libre et illimité aux plateformes d'apprentissage en ligne et aux cours de langues

Vous êtes intéressé par notre apprentissage et souhaitez faire partie de Lonza? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne via notre outil de recrutement avec les documents suivants:
• Certificats des trois dernières années d'études secondaires
• CV avec photo
• Lettre de motivation

Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes chaque jour. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante pour nous que nos succès eux-mêmes. À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Lonza est rejoint par des personnes qui prennent des défis et utilisent leur créativité pour développer de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Lonza is now a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

The training as a polymechanic at Lonza in Stein (AG) offers you an exciting opportunity to learn a wide range of technical skills. In this four-year training, you will be systematically prepared to produce high-precision workpieces and components as well as to maintain machines and plants and to control complex production processes. During your apprenticeship, a special focus will be on the production of precision parts, which are intended for the highly regulated pharmaceutical industry and require the highest precision and accuracy.

In the vocational school you will learn technical basics such as mathematics, computer science, learning and working technology as well as physics, supplemented by technical English as another school subject. The training also includes materials and manufacturing engineering, drawing and machine engineering, and electrical and control engineering. In addition, you will attend intercompany courses at our partner company aprentas in Liestal (BL), where you can further develop and deepen your practical skills in a realistic environment.

Your tasks:

• Manufacture of tools and equipment

• Assembly of electrical and mechanical components

• Repair and maintenance work

• Preparation of malfunction reports and the correction of technical malfunctions

• Planning, handling and monitoring of small projects

Your requirement profile:

• Higher or intermediate level (for very good performances also basic level) or Matura/Abitur

• Good technical understanding

• Analytical thinking and spatial imagination

• Fine motor skills for exact work

• Patience, perseverance and concentration

• Enjoyment of technology

Your benefits:

• 6 weeks holidays and additional paid holidays

• General subscription (GA) for CHF 1.- per day

• Personal IT equipment

• Discount in the staff restaurant (lunch check) as well as free water, coffee, tea

• Certificates of the last three years of school (secondary school)

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, Switzerland.

For our successful Drug Product (DP) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Technology Transfer Lead position.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:
Ensure all activities are performed according to current quality, regulatory and health and safety standards.

• You lead technical transfer activities for sterile GMP drug product manufacturing projects

• You manage drug product transfers from clinical development through first commercial launch

• You define project scope, timelines, risks, and milestones, and track progress effectively

• You lead process setup, scale-up, and implementation at GMP manufacturing sites

• You prepare and maintain technical transfer and process implementation documentation

• You drive GMP change management and handle deviations and CAPAs when required.

• You support regulatory documentation, inspections, audits, and customer interactions.

What we are looking for:

• Ph.D. or Master in pharmaceutical sciences, pharmaceutical engineering, chemistry, biochemistry, or related fields or similar qualification

• Significant experience in biotech / pharma industry

• Knowledge of technical issues and requirements for drug product technical transfers.

• Know-how in aseptic product manufacture for protein drug products including lyophilization process highly desirable including knowledge on ADCs/highly potent drug product manufacturing.

• Good leadership and interpersonal skills; proven ability as team player and ability to manage cross-functional teams.

• Very good planning and organizing skills, including project management and risk management skills

• Excellent communication skills and command of English both written and oral

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.
