jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp wird ein QC Data Reviewer (m/w/d) für die QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. In dieser Position überprüfen Sie die Protokolle der Laboranten auf gute Dokumentationspraxis. Ausserdem sind Sie für die Identifizierung und Behebung von Fehlerquellen der Arbeitsroutinen verantwortlich. Da wir uns in einem kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess des Labors befinden, wird proaktive Mitarbeit und das Einbringen von eigenen mehr als wertgeschätzt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sorgfältige Überprüfung von Analyseprotokolle.

• Selbstständige Prüfung der Dokumentation und der Endergebnisse.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit dem Laborteam, Wissenschaftler*innen und Projektleiter*innen.

• Regelmässige Mitarbeiterschulungen zur Beseitigung von Fehlerquellen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit.

• Aktive Beteiligung an der Laborplanung und Mitentwicklung von Verbesserungsprozessen.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Hochschulabschluss (FH/BSc/ MSc) oder mehrjährige Laborerfahrung.

• GMP-Erfahrung von Vorteil, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.

• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit LIMS wünschenswert.

• Ein Hohes Mass an Selbstorganisation.

• Eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie Freude an der Arbeit in einem jungen, motivierten Team.

• Kommunikationsstärke und fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is now a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a QC Data Reviewer (m/f/d) for QC microbiology is sought. In this position, check the protocols of the laboratory for good documentation practice. You are also responsible for identifying and resolving sources of error in work routines. Since we are in a continuous improvement process of the laboratory, proactive cooperation and the contribution of our own is more than appreciated.

Their tasks:

• Careful review of analysis protocols.

• Independent examination of documentation and final results.

• Close cooperation and communication with the laboratory team, scientists and project managers.

• Regular employee training to eliminate sources of error and continuously improve cooperation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

La sede effettiva di questa posizione si trova a Visp, in Svizzera. Ai candidati idonei e alle loro famiglie viene offerto, se necessario, supporto per il trasferimento.

In qualità di ingegnere di bioprocesso, farà parte del team di produzione e svolgerà le mansioni di un ingegnere di bioprocesso nell'ambito della pulizia e della gestione dei progetti nell'operatività quotidiana.

All'interno dell'impianto di produzione Microbial Large Scale vengono condotte sia le prime campagne di engineering sia i processi commerciali in funzionamento continuo.

Questa posizione è interamente basata presso la sede. La stretta collaborazione personale in loco consente un coordinamento diretto in tempo reale e favorisce la precisione tecnica necessaria per la produzione di medicinali secondo i più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa la attende

- Una carriera agile e una cultura lavorativa dinamica.
- Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
- Programmi retributivi che riconoscono le alte prestazioni.
- L'opportunità di contribuire attivamente alla definizione e all'ottimizzazione di bioprocessi GMP complessi.
- Collaborazione con team interdisciplinari in un contesto internazionale.
- Numerose opportunità di sviluppo e formazione continua.
- L'elenco completo dei nostri benefit globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Le sue mansioni

- Collaborazione con i team degli impianti e dei progetti per garantire un flusso operativo efficiente e interfunzionale.
- Redazione, revisione e aggiornamento di SOPs, rapporti di pulizia e altri documenti di lavoro nell'ambito della pulizia degli impianti.
- Gestione e supervisione autonome dei processi di pulizia e produzione in corso, nel rispetto di elevati standard di qualità e conformità.
- Gestione di progetti, nonché ottimizzazione continua e ulteriore sviluppo dei processi esistenti.
- Rappresentanza del team di produzione durante audit e ispezioni da parte di clienti e autorità, con particolare attenzione alla pulizia degli impianti.
- Supporto ai team di progetto nella preparazione, documentazione e gestione di deviazioni, CAPAs e indagini, nonché nella gestione di questioni tecniche relative ai processi di pulizia.
- Svolgimento di attività in un ambiente regolamentato GMP nel rispetto delle linee guida applicabili e dei requisiti di qualità.

Cosa cerchiamo

- MSc, BSc in chimica/ ingegneria di processo/ biotecnologia presso un'università o una scuola universitaria professionale, oppure un titolo di studio equivalente con diversi anni di esperienza professionale
- L'esperienza nella produzione farmaceutica e nell'ambito GMP è auspicabile
- L'esperienza con TrackWise e le conoscenze nell'ambito della pulizia degli impianti costituiscono un vantaggio.
- Tedesco e inglese parlati e scritti
- Approccio al lavoro orientato alle soluzioni e autonomo, con grande spirito d'iniziativa e senso di responsabilità.
- Apertura ai processi di miglioramento continuo
- Disponibilità a partecipare al servizio di picchetto

Informazioni su Lonza

In Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra più grande forza. In oltre 30 sedi distribuite su cinque continenti, i nostri team connessi a livello globale collaborano ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità rispecchiano chi siamo e il modo in cui collaboriamo. Le idee di ciascuno, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è proprio a questo che desideriamo farvi partecipare.

L'innovazione prospera quando persone di ogni provenienza apportano le loro prospettive uniche. In Lonza apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a trasformare le idee rivoluzionarie dei nostri clienti in terapie applicabili, saremo lieti di darvi il benvenuto a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Candidati ora!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The actual location of this position is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation support is available to eligible applicants and their families if needed.

As a Bioprocess Engineer, you will be part of the production team and perform the duties of a bioprocess engineer in the area of purification and day-to-day project support.

Within the Microbial Large Scale production facility, both initial engineering campaigns and continuously running commercial processes are carried out.

This position is a fully site-based role. Close personal collaboration on site enables direct coordination in real time and supports the technical precision required to manufacture medicines according to the highest quality and safety standards.

What awaits you

- An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
- An inclusive and ethical working environment.
- Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
- The opportunity to actively shape and optimize complex GMP bioprocesses.
- Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams in an international environment.
- Diverse development and training opportunities.
- You can find the complete list of our global benefits here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Your responsibilities

- Collaboration with facility and project teams to ensure an efficient and cross-functional operational workflow.
- Creation, editing, and maintenance of SOPs, cleaning reports, and other work documents in the area of equipment cleaning.
- Independent management and monitoring of ongoing cleaning and production processes in compliance with high quality and compliance standards.
- Handling of projects as well as continuous optimization and further development of existing processes.
- Representing the production team during customer and regulatory authority audits and inspections, with a focus on equipment cleaning.
- Supporting project teams in the preparation, documentation, and handling of deviations, CAPAs, and investigations, as well as with technical questions regarding cleaning processes.
- Performing tasks in a GMP-regulated environment in compliance with applicable guidelines and quality requirements.

What we are looking for

- MSc, BSc in Chemistry/Chemical Engineering/Biotechnology from a university or university of applied sciences, or comparable qualification with several years of professional experience
- Experience in pharmaceutical production and in a GMP environment is desirable
- Experience with TrackWise and knowledge of equipment cleaning are an advantage.
- German and English, both written and spoken
- Solution-oriented and independent working style with a high degree of initiative and sense of responsibility.
- Openness to continuous improvement processes
- Willingness to participate in on-call duty

About Lonza

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to make the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values—collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion, and integrity—reflect who we are and how we work together. The ideas of each individual, whether big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is exactly what we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from diverse backgrounds contribute their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to turn our customers' groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

jobs.description:

As a Automation Engineer MES / DeltaV, you will be responsible for the implementation, optimization, and ongoing support of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Emerson DeltaV process control systems within biopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities. You will play a key role in ensuring efficient production operations, regulatory compliance, and adherence to the highest quality standards

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career with opportunities for professional growth in a global life sciences organization.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and ethical workplace where diverse perspectives are valued.

• Competitive compensation and recognition programs that reward high performance.

• Access to a wide range of local and global benefits, depending on role and location.

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and automation.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Design, implement, and validate MES recipes and DeltaV control strategies that support robust and compliant biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, Process Development, Automation, Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure seamless system integration and operational excellence.

• Troubleshoot and resolve MES and DeltaV system issues, minimizing production disruptions and supporting reliable plant operations.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including specifications, work instructions, and validation records in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Support end users through training, technical guidance, and ongoing system expertise.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize manufacturing processes, automation strategies, and system performance.

• Contribute to the implementation of new technologies and digital manufacturing solutions that enhance productivity, compliance, and operational efficiency.

What we are looking for:

• Experience working in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.

• Strong knowledge of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ideally including Werum PAS-X, Rockwell PharmaSuite, or comparable platforms.

• Experience with Emerson DeltaV or other distributed control systems used in process manufacturing.

• Understanding of GMP regulations, computerized system validation, and qualification activities in regulated industries.

• Ability to analyze complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• A degree in Bioprocess Engineering, Biotechnology, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience demonstrating these capabilities.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower, Switzerland.

The Global Category Manager Logistics & Warehousing is responsible for developing and executing global sourcing strategies for logistics, transportation, and warehousing services. The role drives value through strategic sourcing, supplier management, cost optimization, and risk mitigation while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to improve service quality, resilience, innovation, and sustainable business performance.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Basel: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/5c78e3b906804b0cb6710009ab5507de?updated

What you will do:

• Develop and implement global category and sourcing strategies for logistics, transportation, and warehousing services across regions and business units.

• Lead strategic sourcing projects, competitive tenders, supplier negotiations, and contract management to deliver sustainable value and cost optimization.

• Build and manage a robust savings pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting, tracking, and realization of procurement benefits.

• Act as the global procurement subject matter expert for logistics and warehousing, providing market intelligence and strategic guidance.

• Drive supplier selection, onboarding, performance management, and governance to improve service quality, resilience, innovation, and compliance.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align category strategies with business needs, operational priorities, sustainability goals, and risk mitigation plans.

• Identify and implement continuous improvement, digitalization, and process harmonization initiatives to enhance efficiency and transparency.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Significant experience in category management, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management within logistics, transportation, and warehousing.

• Strong negotiation, tendering, commercial contracting, and total cost of ownership analysis capabilities.

• Solid understanding of logistics markets, freight modes, warehousing operations, Incoterms, service level agreements, and supplier performance management.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex global projects within a matrix organization.

• Strong analytical skills with experience in spend analysis, business case development, savings delivery, forecasting, and risk management.

• Experience with procurement and sourcing systems such as SAP, Ariba, iCertis, or similar tools, combined with excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Shape the future of digital manufacturing by translating complex production requirements into smart MES solutions that power shop floor operations and drive efficiency. This unique role combines process expertise, programming skills, and cross-functional collaboration, offering exciting opportunities to optimize interfaces across MES, SAP, LIMS, and automation systems.
Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Configure and continuously optimize MES recipes by translating manufacturing specifications into digital production workflows and batch records used on the shop floor.

• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Owners, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless integration between MES and connected systems such as SAP, LIMS, and automation platforms.

• Develop, test, and maintain MES functionalities using TypeScript, ensuring reliable process execution, data integrity, and compliance with quality standards.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, data flows, and system interfaces, driving greater efficiency and automation across manufacturing operations.

• Provide MES subject matter expertise by supporting production activities, troubleshooting system-related issues, and contributing to the ongoing evolution of MES capabilities.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience working with MES systems in a configuration, development, or programming capacity, rather than solely as an end user.

• Solid understanding of GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, with the ability to translate production requirements into compliant digital solutions.

• Hands-on programming experience in any modern programming language and a strong interest in developing and optimizing manufacturing applications.

• Fluent English communication skills are essential to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

• A proactive and analytical mindset with the ability to identify process improvement opportunities across systems and interfaces; TypeScript, Fill & Finish experience, IT-related education, and German language skills (or willingness to learn) are considered strong advantages.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

- Good knowledge of GMP requirements, data integrity, and quality systems.
- Experience handling deviations, CAPAs, and change control processes.

Pour renforcer notre service de chimie humide du contrôle qualité (QC), nous recherchons une personne engagée et dotée d’une solide expertise technique pour le poste de Senior QC Scientist. Dans ce rôle, vous assumez, outre des activités analytiques exigeantes au laboratoire, la responsabilité technique de méthodes et de domaines d’expertise définis. Vous assistez le responsable du laboratoire afin de garantir un fonctionnement efficace du laboratoire conforme aux normes GMP et assurez son remplacement en son absence

Ce qui vous attend

- Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
- Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique.
- Des programmes de rémunération qui récompensent les hautes performances.
- Une variété d’avantages, selon le poste et le lieu de travail.

La liste complète de nos avantages à l’échelle mondiale est disponible ici : https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Vos responsabilités

- Réalisation autonome d’analyses complexes et d’activités liées aux méthodes dans le laboratoire QC.
- Assumer la responsabilité technique de méthodes d’analyse, d’équipements ou de domaines d’expertise définis.
- Soutien au responsable du laboratoire dans l’organisation et la coordination des activités quotidiennes du laboratoire.
- Assurer la fonction de suppléant du responsable du laboratoire et apporter un soutien pour les questions opérationnelles et techniques.
- Garantir la mise à disposition en temps voulu de résultats d’analyse de haute qualité et conformes aux exigences GMP.

- Accompagnement technique des validations de méthodes, des vérifications de méthodes et des transferts de méthodes.
- Réalisation d’analyses des erreurs et résolution de problèmes en cas de difficultés analytiques ou méthodologiques.
- Identification et mise en œuvre d’améliorations dans le domaine des méthodes analytiques, des processus et des flux de travail.
- Soutien aux audits et inspections, ainsi qu’au traitement des demandes des autorités dans le domaine de responsabilité.
- Promotion d’une intégrité élevée des données ainsi que du respect des exigences GMP et qualité.
- Soutien technique et accompagnement des collaborateurs pour les questions liées aux méthodes.

Ce que nous recherchons

- Diplôme obtenu en chimie, biochimie, pharmacie, sciences de la vie ou dans une discipline scientifique comparable.
- Plusieurs années d’expérience professionnelle dans un laboratoire QC réglementé par les GMP.
- Connaissances approfondies des méthodes analytiques et des processus de laboratoire.
- Expérience en validation de méthodes, transfert de méthodes et dépannage analytique.
- Bonne connaissance des exigences GMP, de l’intégrité des données et des systèmes qualité.
- Expérience dans la gestion des écarts, des CAPA et des processus de contrôle des changements.
- Fortes compétences analytiques et conceptuelles ainsi qu’une méthode de travail structurée.
- Un grand sens des responsabilités, l’esprit d’équipe et d’excellentes qualités de communication.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l’allemand et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

À propos de Lonza

Chez Lonza, nos collaborateurs sont notre plus grande force. Sur plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale collaborent chaque jour pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales — collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité — reflètent qui nous sommes et la manière dont nous collaborons. Les idées de chacun, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d’améliorer la vie de millions de personnes, et c’est précisément à cette aventure que nous souhaitons vous associer.

L'innovation s'épanouit lorsque des personnes d'horizons les plus divers apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous valorisons la diversité et nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les collaborateurs. Si vous êtes prêt à transformer les idées révolutionnaires de nos clients en thérapies concrètes, nous serons ravis de vous accueillir à bord.

Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie ? Postulez dès maintenant.

Nous développons des procédés de fabrication pour des principes actifs innovants dans nos laboratoires et les mettons en œuvre dans nos installations à l’échelle technique, dans le respect des GMP. En tant qu’Operations Manager Launch Manufacturing, vous contribuez de manière décisive à offrir de nouvelles options thérapeutiques aux patients du monde entier.

- Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique

- Grâce à une communication efficace, à votre engagement et à votre esprit d’équipe, vous créez un environnement de travail basé sur la confiance et propice à la réussite, dans lequel nous et nos clients poursuivons un objectif commun
- Vous vous adaptez avec flexibilité à l’évolution des priorités et êtes capable de soutenir plusieurs projets simultanément

Votre profil

- Diplôme universitaire achevé (PhD ou master) en chimie, génie chimique, génie des procédés ou dans une discipline apparentée
- Une expérience professionnelle dans le développement et/ou la production dans les secteurs chimique et/ou pharmaceutique constitue un atout
- Connaissances en GMP ainsi que compétences en gestion d’entreprise souhaitées
- Excellentes capacités analytiques et goût pour le traitement de problématiques techniques complexes
- Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit
- Grande capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer avec différents interlocuteurs et niveaux hiérarchiques
- Personnalité proactive, flexible et désireuse d’apprendre, dotée d’un sens des responsabilités et d’une grande efficacité sous pression temporelle

Chez Lonza, nos collaborateurs sont notre plus grande force. Nos valeurs fondamentales : la collaboration, la responsabilité, l’excellence, la passion et l’intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et la manière dont nous collaborons. jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our SCM team as a Logistics Systems & SAP EWM Specialist 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp and play a key role in connecting Logistics Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and IT. Drive the optimization of SAP EWM/MM processes, ensure smooth end-to-end logistics operations in a GMP-regulated environment, and help shape the future of our warehouse and supply chain systems.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: Benefits - Visp

What you’ll do:

• Owns and continuously improves end-to-end SAP MM and SAP EWM processes covering inbound operations, warehousing, internal material flows, production supply, inventory management, returns, and outbound logistics.

• Analyzes business requirements, prepares functional specifications, and supports system configurations, enhancements, interfaces, and rollouts in close collaboration with IT and implementation partners.

• Monitors and manages the integration between SAP ERP/S/4HANA, decentralized SAP EWM, LIMS, 3PL systems, as well as warehouse automation and material handling systems, coordinating issue resolution when required.

• Plans and executes testing activities, data validation, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and handover to support teams, ensuring thorough and compliant documentation of results.

• Ensures compliance with cGMP, data integrity, CSV, quality, safety, and internal governance requirements throughout process and system changes.

• Manages incidents, masterdata, and change requests, conducts root cause analyses, and implements sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

• Defines role and authorization requirements in line with Segregation of Duties (SoD) principles and supports the implementation of risk-based mitigation measures.

• Creates and maintains process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, training materials, and key user documentation, while delivering training and knowledge transfer to end users.

What we are looking for:

• Several years of experience with SAP EWM, ideally complemented by SAP MM expertise, in a manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated environment.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse and logistics processes, including inbound, storage, inventory management, production supply, and outbound distribution.

• Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions and drive process improvements in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.

• Experience with system implementations, enhancements, integrations, testing, validation, cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities.

• Solid knowledge of cGMP, CSV, data integrity, and quality requirements within regulated environments is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• Proactive, independent, and solution-oriented professional with excellent communication skills

• Fluency in English is required and German is a strong advantage.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Unisciti al nostro team SCM come Logistics Systems & SAP EWM Specialist 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp e gioca un ruolo chiave nella connessione Logistics Operations, Supply Chain, Quality e IT. Guidare l'ottimizzazione dei processi SAP EWM/MM, garantire operazioni logistiche end-to-end fluide in un ambiente regolamentato GMP, e contribuire a modellare il futuro dei nostri sistemi di magazzino e supply chain.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura in Visp può essere trovata su: Vantaggi - Visp

Cosa farai:

• Owns e migliora continuamente i processi SAP MM e SAP EWM che coprono operazioni di inbound, warehousing, flussi di materiale interno, fornitura di produzione, gestione dell'inventario, ritorni e logistica in uscita.

• Analizza i requisiti aziendali, prepara specifiche funzionali e supporta configurazioni di sistema, miglioramenti, interfacce e rollout in stretta collaborazione con partner IT e implementazione.

• Monitora e gestisce l'integrazione tra SAP ERP/S/4HANA, sistemi SAP EWM decentralizzati, sistemi LIMS, 3PL, sistemi di automazione del magazzino e gestione dei materiali, coordinando la risoluzione dei problemi quando necessario.

• Pianifica ed esegue attività di test, convalida dei dati, cutover, go-live, ipercare e consegna ai team di supporto, garantendo una documentazione completa e conforme dei risultati.

• Garantisce la conformità a cGMP, l'integrità dei dati, CSV, la qualità, la sicurezza e i requisiti di governance interna durante i cambiamenti di processo e di sistema.

• Gestisce gli incidenti, i masterdati e le richieste di cambiamento, conduce analisi delle cause root e implementa azioni correttive e preventive sostenibili.

• Definisce i requisiti di ruolo e di autorizzazione in linea con i principi di Segregazione delle Duties (SoD) e supporta l'attuazione delle misure di mitigazione basate sui rischi.

• Crea e mantiene la documentazione di processo, le SOP, le istruzioni di lavoro, i materiali di formazione e la documentazione chiave dell'utente, offrendo allo stesso tempo formazione e trasferimento di conoscenze agli utenti finali.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Diversi anni di esperienza con SAP EWM, idealmente integrati dalla competenza di SAP MM, in un ambiente di produzione, farmaceutico, biotecnologico o altro.

• Forte comprensione dei processi di magazzino end-to-end e logistica, tra cui inbound, stoccaggio, gestione dell'inventario, fornitura di produzione e distribuzione in uscita.

• Prova capacità di tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni di sistema scalabili e migliorare i processi in collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT.

• Esperienza con implementazioni di sistema, miglioramenti, integrazioni, test, validazione, cutover, go-live e attività di ipercare.

• La solida conoscenza di cGMP, CSV, l'integrità dei dati e i requisiti di qualità in ambienti regolamentati è altamente auspicabile.

• Forte capacità di gestione analitica, problem-solving e stakeholder, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente tra le squadre interfunzionali.

• Professionista attivo, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• La fluidità in inglese è richiesta e il tedesco è un forte vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Für unseren Standort in Visp sind wir aktuell auf der Suche nach einem Anlagen-, Projektingenieur BioAtrium 80-100%(m/w/d). In dieser Rolle bist Du für die Umsetzung von Investitionsvorhaben unter Berücksichtigung der Funktionalität, der Termine und der Kosten verantwortlich. Du bist für die Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit der zugeteilten Anlage/n oder Teilanlage/n unter Berücksichtigung eines kostenoptimalen Betriebsengineerings verantwortlich. Du bist für die fachgerechte und wirtschaftliche Durchführung der Instandhaltung, des Engineerings und von Umstellungen verantwortlich. Du trägst massgebend zur laufenden Optimierung von Prozessen, Anlagen und internen Abläufen bei.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: Benefits - Visp

Deine Aufgaben:

• Gewährleisten einer fachgerechten und wirtschaftlichen Durchführung der Instandhaltung bei gleichzeitig ausreichender Anlagenverfügbarkeit, inkl. Umgang mit den Behörden (z.B.: SVTI etc.)

• Erarbeitung von möglichen Anlagen-Optimierungen und deren Umsetzung·

• Vorbereitung und Koordination der Instandhaltungsarbeiten mit den Werkstätten

• Planung und Realisierung von Investitionsvorhaben

• Sicherstellung der technisch funktionellen und GMP-gerechten Ausführung der Projekte

• Leitung der technischen Anlagenanpassungen bei Neuproduktionen

• GMP gerechtes Änderungswesen unter Anwendung der zur Verfügung gestellten Systeme

• Hochhalten von Sicherheit, Hygiene, Umwelt, Qualität (cGMP) in Bezug auf technische Einrichtungen

• Lückenlose Aufnahme und Pflege der Daten technischer Plätze, Equipments und Ersatzteile, zugehöriger Stücklisten, Arbeitsanleitungen, Pflege der Historie und Mutationen im SAP

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (ETH, FH, HF) in der Fachrichtung Maschinenbau oder Verfahrenstechnik o.ä.

• Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung idealerweise im Biotech-/Pharmaumfeld

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten; starker Teamplayer; sehr guter Kommunikationsstil

• Lösungsorientiertes, strukturiertes, fokussiertes und organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP; SAP, COMOS - von Vorteil

• Fliessende Deutsch- und/oder sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Dich teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Du bereit bist, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Dich an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerb

descriptionByLocale.it:
Se necessario, i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento.

Per il nostro sito a Visp, stiamo attualmente cercando un impianto, ingegnere di progetto BioAtrium 80-100%(m/f/d). In questo ruolo, sei responsabile dell'attuazione di progetti di investimento tenendo conto delle funzionalità, delle scadenze e dei costi. L'utente è responsabile di garantire la disponibilità dell'impianto/i stanziati o dei sostituti/i, tenendo conto dell'ingegneria operativa ottimale per i costi. Sei responsabile per l'implementazione professionale ed economica di manutenzione, ingegneria e conversioni. Contribuisci in modo significativo alla continua ottimizzazione di processi, impianti e processi interni.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche in: Benefits - Visp

I vostri compiti:

• Assicurare un'attuazione professionale ed economica della manutenzione contemporaneamente sufficiente disponibilità di impianti, anche trattare con le autorità (ad esempio: SVTI ecc.)

• Sviluppo di possibili ottimizzazioni vegetali e loro attuazione ·

• Preparazione e coordinamento dei lavori di manutenzione con laboratori

• Pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti di investimento

• Garantire l'esecuzione tecnicamente funzionale e conforme a GMP di progetti

• Gestione degli adeguamenti tecnici degli impianti per nuove produzioni

• GMP fair change management utilizzando i sistemi forniti

• Mantenere sicurezza, igiene, ambiente, qualità (cGMP) in relazione alle strutture tecniche

• Registrazione e manutenzione continua dei dati di luoghi tecnici, attrezzature e pezzi di ricambio, liste di parti associate, istruzioni di lavoro, manutenzione della storia e mutazioni in SAP

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione completa (ETH, FH, HF) nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica o dell'ingegneria dei processi o simili

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale idealmente nell'ambiente biotecnologico/farmaceutico

• lavoro autonomo e flessibile; giocatori di squadra forti; Molto buono stile di comunicazione

• Comportamento di lavoro orientato alla soluzione, strutturato, focalizzato e organizzato

• Buona conoscenza di GMP; SAP, COMOS - un vantaggio

• Flusso tedesco e/o ottime competenze in inglese

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

For our site in Visp, we are currently looking for a plant, project engineer BioAtrium 80-100%(m/f/d). In this role, you are responsible for implementing investment projects taking into account functionality, deadlines and costs. You are responsible for ensuring the availability of the allocated plant(s) or sub-plant(s), taking into account cost-optimal operational engineering. You are responsible for the professional and economical implementation of maintenance, engineering and conversions. You contribute significantly to the ongoing optimization of processes, plants and internal processes.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Ensure a professional and economical implementation of the maintenance with at the same time sufficient plant availability, including dealing with the authorities (e.g.: SVTI etc.)

• Development of possible plant optimizations and their implementation ·

• Preparation and coordination of maintenance work with workshops

• Planning and realisation of investment projects

• Ensuring technically functional and GMP-compliant execution of projects

• Management of technical plant adjustments for new productions

• GMP fair change management using the systems provided

• Maintaining safety, hygiene, environment, quality (cGMP) in relation to technical facilities

• Continuous recording and maintenance of the data of technical locations, equipment and spare parts, associated parts lists, work instructions, maintenance of the history and mutations in SAP

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training (ETH, FH, HF) in the field of mechanical engineering or process engineering or the like

• Several years of professional experience ideally in the biotech/pharmaceutical environment

• self-employed and flexible work; strong team players; Very good communication style

• Solution-oriented, structured, focused and organized work behavior

• Good knowledge of GMP; SAP, COMOS - an advantage

• Flowing German and/or very good English skills

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

• Formation complète (ETH, FH, HF) dans le domaine de l'ingénierie mécanique ou de l'ingénierie des procédés ou similaires

• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle idéalement dans l'environnement biotechnologique/pharmaceutique

jobs.title: Process Expert - Compounding & Support 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join a collaborative, proactive and diverse team where you will drive process excellence across compounding operations, support operators with technical expertise, lead deviations,  investigations, and execute validation and qualification activities while ensuring continuous inspection readiness. As part of an exciting greenfield growth project, you will take ownership, make a visible impact, and contribute to the successful delivery of safe, high-quality products. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Lead and continuously improve aseptic compounding processes, leveraging GMP manufacturing experience to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient operations.

• Provide hands-on technical support to operators, troubleshoot process issues, and drive deviations, investigations, and corrective actions to maintain product quality and compliance.

• Execute and support validation and qualification activities, including the preparation, review, and maintenance of all relevant GMP documentation.

• Maintain equipment and processes in an inspection-ready state, support internal and external audits, and contribute expertise in sterile manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate within a proactive, reliable, and accountable team, bringing a BSc/MSc in a scientific discipline, fluent English and conversational German (B1); experience with GMP washers, sterilization processes, thawing, and compounding is an advantage.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a Life Sciences discipline (e.g., Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry) with hands-on experience in aseptic/sterile manufacturing environments.

• Proven experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, with a strong understanding of quality, compliance, and documentation requirements is a must. Experience in qualification and validation activities are a strong advantage.

• Fluent English and conversational German (B1 level or above), enabling effective communication across teams and functions.

• A proactive, reliable team player who enjoys collaborating with others, takes ownership of responsibilities, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple parallel activities.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity with a high degree of flexibility; experience in thawing and compounding operations and knowledge of GMP washers and autoclaves are considered strong advantages.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Unisciti a un team collaborativo, proattivo e diversificato in cui guiderai l'eccellenza del processo nelle operazioni di compounding, supporterai gli operatori con competenze tecniche, deviazioni di piombo, indagini e eseguirai attività di validazione e qualificazione, garantendo al contempo una continua disponibilità all'ispezione. Come parte di un progetto di crescita greenfield emozionante, prenderete la proprietà, fare un impatto visibile, e contribuire alla consegna di prodotti sicuri e di alta qualità. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.
L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
I nostri vantaggi locali: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Cosa farai:

• Guidare e migliorare continuamente i processi di compounding asettico, sfruttando l'esperienza di produzione GMP per garantire operazioni sicure, conformi ed efficienti.

• Fornire supporto tecnico pratico agli operatori, problemi di processo di risoluzione dei problemi e deviazioni di unità, indagini e azioni correttive per mantenere la qualità del prodotto e la conformità.

• Eseguire e sostenere le attività di validazione e qualificazione, tra cui la preparazione, la revisione e la manutenzione di tutta la documentazione GMP rilevante.

• Mantenere le attrezzature e i processi in uno stato pronto all'ispezione, sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni, e contribuire a competenze in ambienti di produzione sterili.

• Collaborare all'interno di un team proattivo, affidabile e responsabile, portando un BSc/MSc in una disciplina scientifica, fluente inglese e conversazione tedesco (B1); esperienza con lavatrici GMP, processi di sterilizzazione, scongelamento e compounding è un vantaggio.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Corso di laurea o Master in una disciplina di Scienze della Vita (ad esempio, Biotecnologia, Farmacia, Biologia, Chimica) con esperienza pratica in ambienti di produzione asettico/sterile.

• Un'esperienza comprovata nella produzione regolamentata da GMP, con una forte comprensione dei requisiti di qualità, conformità e documentazione. L'esperienza nelle attività di qualificazione e validazione è un forte vantaggio.

• Tedesco fluente e conversazione (livello B1 o superiore), che consente una comunicazione efficace tra team e funzioni.

• Un giocatore di squadra proattivo e affidabile che si diverte a collaborare con altri, prende la proprietà delle responsabilità, e prospera in un ambiente frenetico con il cambiamento delle priorità e molteplici attività parallele.

• Confortevole ambiguità di navigazione con un alto grado di flessibilità; l'esperienza nelle operazioni di scongelamento e compounding e la conoscenza di lavatrici GMP e autoclavi sono considerati forti vantaggi.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The Sterility Assurance Lead (SAL)(f/m/d) is responsible for leading the Sterility Assurance and Microbial Control Program for Drug Product Module at Visp site. This role owns the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) and drives a strong sterility assurance culture by partnering closely with Operations, QA, QC, Central Contamination Prevention & Control Teams, Microbiology, Engineering, and Global Technical Functions. The position ensures regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across all contamination control and aseptic processing activities.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Own and continuously improve the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, Lonza guidelines and industry best practices.

• Provide technical leadership and oversight for aseptic processing, aseptic process simulations (APS), sterilization, cleanroom management, and contamination control programs.

• Act as the Sterility Assurance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for facility design, technology transfers, and contamination risk assessments.

• Lead investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and root cause analyses related to sterility assurance topics.

• Manage environmental monitoring strategies, performance metrics, trend analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen microbial control.

• Represent Sterility Assurance during health authority inspections, customer audits, and in all cross-functional platforms.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in a scientific discipline with extensive experience in microbial control and sterility assurance within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong hands-on expertise in contamination control, aseptic processing, APS, environmental monitoring, and complex microbiological investigations.

• Deep knowledge of cleanroom engineering, sterilization processes, microbiological testing methodologies, and contamination risk management.

• Excellent communication, decision making, conflict resolution, and change management skills in complex operational environments.

• Comprehensive understanding of pharmaceutical regulations and GMP requirements.

• Strong technical knowledge of USP/EP requirements, bioburden, endotoxin, sterility testing, environmental monitoring, and contamination control systems.

Standort. Visp, Schweiz.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. An unserem Standort in Visp, im Wallis, suchen wir ständig Betreiber-Biotechnologen mit einem relevanten Hintergrund auf allen Ebenen der Life Sciences, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen!

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Rolle und Standort.

• Verantwortung für die zeitnahe und qualitativ hochwertige Erstellung der erforderlichen Produktionsdokumentation (z. B. MBRs, Formulare).

• Betrieb, Einrichtung und Reinigung von Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten nach Bedarf.

• Frühere Erfahrungen in einer GMP-regulierten Umgebung (vorzugsweise in der sterilen Herstellung von Arzneimitteln).

• Vertraut mit GMP-Anforderungen, Qualitätsverfahren und SOP-Ausführung.

• Starke Teamorientierung und kollaborative Denkweise.

• Strukturierter, fokussierter und gut organisierter Arbeitsansatz und hoch motiviert, proaktiv und dynamisch.

• Verfügbar und bereit für flexible Arbeitszeiten, einschließlich Schichtarbeit. Bereit, in 2 Schichten zu arbeiten.

Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Exécuter les activités de fabrication dans la région du produit pharmaceutique conformément aux lignes directrices du BPFc, assurer l'exécution appropriée des lots, résoudre les problèmes et formuler des recommandations pour la résolution.

• Effectuer une inspection visuelle manuelle des flacons liquides et lyophilisés pour identifier et éliminer toutes les unités défectueuses. Le produit final doit être exempt de tout défaut (p. ex. absence de particules, absence d'intégrité ou de défauts du contenant) pour s'assurer qu'il peut être administré en toute sécurité sous forme d'injection stérile aux patients.

• Fournir un soutien technique et procédural en première ligne en collaboration avec l'équipe de fabrication.

• S'assurer que chaque lot est fabriqué en toute sécurité, selon le calendrier prévu et en pleine conformité avec les instructions de lot et les exigences de qualité.

• Être responsable de la préparation en temps opportun et de haute qualité des documents de production requis (p. ex. MBR, formulaires).

• Exploiter, mettre en place et nettoyer le matériel et les locaux de production au besoin.

Ce que nous recherchons:

• Expérience antérieure dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF (de préférence dans la fabrication stérile de produits pharmaceutiques).

• Connaissance des exigences des BPF, des procédures de qualité et de l'exécution des PON.

• Orientation forte de l'équipe et esprit de collaboration.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité d'interagir efficacement entre diverses fonctions au sein de l'organisation.

• Approche de travail structurée, ciblée et bien organisée et très motivée, proactive et dynamique.

• Disponible et prêt à travailler des heures flexibles, y compris le travail posté. Préparé à travailler en 2 équipes.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'âge, au statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: QC Project Leader 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Manufacturing Science and Technology Expert – Drug Product (m/f/d) - 80% -100%. This role is important for ensuring successful technology transfers, maintaining GMP compliance, and driving continuous improvement. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a strong background in manufacturing science and technology, we want to hear from you. The position is based in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation is available for a successful candidate and their family, if needed.

Job Responsibilities:

• Manage and lead QC projects from initiation to completion, defining project scope, timelines, resources, deliverables, and reporting project progress while escalating issues when necessary.

• Perform, oversee, and coordinate chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products using analytical techniques such as HPLC, GC, UV/Vis, KF, and FTIR, ensuring data integrity, testing compliance, and timely support of project and release activities.

• Develop, validate, and transfer chromatographic analytical methods in accordance with ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and applicable quality standards.

• Troubleshoot analytical instrumentation and methods, implementing corrective and preventive actions as required.

• Ensure compliance with GMP/cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal quality standards across all QC activities.

• Initiate, manage, and close change controls, deviations, OOS/OOT/OOE investigations, and laboratory investigations, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, CAPA implementation, and thorough documentation to ensure timely resolution.

• Document and review analytical results, project activities, and investigation outcomes in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Prepare, author, review, and approve technical documents, including method validation and method transfer protocols and reports, SOPs, quality instructions, and other QC-related cGMP documentation.

• Act as the primary QC point of contact for assigned customer projects, ensuring effective communication and stakeholder alignment.

• Serve as the interface between QC personnel and external contract laboratories, coordinating testing activities and resolving technical issues as required.

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Production, Quality Assurance, and external partners, to ensure successful project execution and regulatory compliance.

• Provide technical expertise, coaching, and guidance to junior chemists and other team members.

• Participate in internal and external audits, address audit observations, and support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Qualifications:

• PhD in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific field; alternatively, a Master's or Bachelor's degree with significant relevant industry experience.

• Strong theoretical and practical expertise in analytical chemistry, including hands-on experience with chromatographic techniques such as HPLC and GC.

• Experience in analytical method development, validation, and transfer is highly desirable.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements and regulatory standards; familiarity with ISO 9001 is considered an advantage.

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail and a scientific, data-driven approach.

• Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and build positive working relationships.

• Team-oriented mindset with a commitment to fostering a positive, collaborative, and professional work environment.

• Fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto di tecnologia e scienza di produzione – Prodotto Droga (m/f/d) - 80% -100%. Questo ruolo è importante per garantire trasferimenti tecnologici di successo, mantenere la conformità GMP e migliorare continuamente. Se sei un problem-solver proattivo con un forte background nella scienza e nella tecnologia di produzione, vogliamo sentire da voi. La posizione si trova a Visp, in Svizzera. Il trasferimento è disponibile per un candidato di successo e la loro famiglia, se necessario.

Responsabilità del lavoro:

• Gestire e guidare i progetti QC dall'iniziazione al completamento, definendo l'ambito di progetto, le linee temporali, le risorse, i deliverables e segnalando i progressi del progetto, aumentando i problemi quando necessario.

• Eseguire, supervisionare e coordinare i test chimici e fisici delle materie prime, dei campioni di processo e dei prodotti finiti utilizzando tecniche analitiche come HPLC, GC, UV/Vis, KF e FTIR, garantendo l'integrità dei dati, la conformità dei test e il supporto tempestivo delle attività di progetto e rilascio.

• Sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodi analitici cromatografici in conformità con le linee guida ICH, requisiti normativi e standard di qualità applicabili.

• Risoluzione dei problemi di strumentazione e metodi analitici, implementando azioni correttive e preventive come richiesto.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti GMP/cGMP, delle aspettative normative e degli standard di qualità interni in tutte le attività QC.

• Avviare, gestire e chiudere i controlli di cambiamento, deviazioni, indagini OOS/OOT/OOE e indagini di laboratorio, tra cui l'analisi della causa principale, la valutazione dell'impatto, l'implementazione della CAPA e la documentazione approfondita per garantire la risoluzione tempestiva.

• Documento e revisione risultati analitici, attività di progetto e risultati di indagine in conformità con i requisiti GMP.

• Preparare, autore, rivedere e approvare i documenti tecnici, compresi i protocolli e i rapporti di convalida e trasferimento dei metodi, le SOP, le istruzioni di qualità e altri documenti relativi al CGMP.

• Agire come punto di contatto primario QC per i progetti dei clienti assegnati, assicurando una comunicazione efficace e l'allineamento degli stakeholder.

• Servire come interfaccia tra il personale di QC e i laboratori di contratto esterni, coordinare le attività di test e risolvere i problemi tecnici come richiesto.

• Collabora efficacemente con team interfunzionali, tra cui R&D, Production, Quality Assurance e partner esterni, per garantire l'esecuzione del progetto e la conformità alle normative.

• Fornire competenze tecniche, coaching e guida ai chimici junior e altri membri del team.

• Partecipare a audit interni ed esterni, affrontare le osservazioni di audit e sostenere l'attuazione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Qualifiche di lavoro:

• Dottorato di ricerca in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Biochimica, Ingegneria Chimica, o un campo scientifico correlato; alternativamente, un Master o laurea con significativa esperienza industriale rilevante.

• Forte esperienza teorica e pratica nella chimica analitica, tra cui esperienza pratica con tecniche cromatografiche come HPLC e GC.

• L'esperienza nello sviluppo del metodo analitico, la convalida e il trasferimento è altamente auspicabile.

• La conoscenza dei requisiti GMP e degli standard normativi; la familiarità con ISO 9001 è considerata un vantaggio.

• Ottima capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione dei problemi, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio scientifico e basato sui dati.

• Forte capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e di gestione del progetto, con la capacità di gestire in modo efficace più priorità.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, interpersonale e di leadership, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente attraverso le funzioni e costruire relazioni di lavoro positive.

• mentalità orientata al team con l'impegno di promuovere un ambiente di lavoro positivo, collaborativo e professionale.

• Fluente sia in tedesco che in inglese, con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, stato veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
