descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Nous recherchons un expert en science et technologie de fabrication – Produit pharmaceutique (h/f/d) - 80% -100%. Ce rôle est important pour assurer le succès des transferts de technologie, le maintien de la conformité aux BPF et l'amélioration continue. Si vous êtes un problème-solveur proactif avec une solide expérience dans la science et la technologie de fabrication, nous voulons entendre de vous. Le poste est basé à Viège, Suisse. La réinstallation est disponible pour un candidat reçu et sa famille, au besoin.

Responsabilités professionnelles:

• Gérer et diriger les projets de CQ du début à la fin, définir la portée du projet, les échéanciers, les ressources, les produits livrables et rendre compte de l'avancement du projet tout en augmentant les problèmes au besoin.

• Effectuer, superviser et coordonner les essais chimiques et physiques des matières premières, des échantillons en cours de fabrication et des produits finis à l'aide de techniques d'analyse telles que la CLHP, le GC, les UV/Vis, le KF et le FTIR, en assurant l'intégrité des données, la conformité des essais et l'appui opportun aux activités de projet et de rejet.

• Élaborer, valider et transférer des méthodes d'analyse chromatographique conformément aux lignes directrices, aux exigences réglementaires et aux normes de qualité applicables de l'ICH.

• Dépanner les instruments et les méthodes d'analyse, mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives au besoin.

• Assurer la conformité aux exigences des BPF/BPFc, aux attentes réglementaires et aux normes internes de qualité pour toutes les activités du CQ.

• Entreprendre, gérer et fermer les contrôles du changement, les écarts, les enquêtes OOS/OOT/OOE et les enquêtes de laboratoire, y compris l'analyse des causes profondes, l'analyse d'impact, la mise en oeuvre de l'ACAP et la documentation détaillée pour assurer une résolution rapide.

• Documenter et examiner les résultats analytiques, les activités de projet et les résultats des enquêtes conformément aux exigences des BPF.

• Préparer, rédiger, examiner et approuver les documents techniques, y compris les protocoles et les rapports de validation des méthodes et de transfert des méthodes, les PON, les instructions sur la qualité et d'autres documents liés au PSGC.

• Agir comme principal point de contact du CQ pour les projets clients assignés, en assurant une communication efficace et l'harmonisation des intervenants.

• Servir d'interface entre le personnel du CQ et les laboratoires contractuels externes, coordonner les activités d'essai et résoudre les problèmes techniques au besoin.

• Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris la R-D, la production, l'assurance de la qualité et les partenaires externes, pour assurer la réussite de l'exécution des projets et la conformité à la réglementation.

• Fournir une expertise technique, un encadrement et des conseils aux chimistes juniors et aux autres membres de l'équipe.

• Participer aux vérifications internes et externes, répondre aux observations des vérificateurs et appuyer la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration continue.

Qualifications d'emploi:

• PhD en chimie, chimie analytique, biochimie, génie chimique, ou un domaine scientifique connexe; alternativement, une maîtrise ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience importante de l'industrie pertinente.

• Forte expertise théorique et pratique en chimie analytique, y compris l'expérience pratique avec les techniques chromatographiques telles que HPLC et GC.

• L'expérience en matière de développement, de validation et de transfert des méthodes d'analyse est hautement souhaitable.

• Connaissance des exigences des BPF et des normes réglementaires; la connaissance de la norme ISO 9001 est considérée comme un avantage.

• Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en résolution de problèmes, avec une grande attention aux détails et une approche scientifique axée sur les données.

• Fortes compétences en matière d'organisation, de planification et de gestion de projet, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités.

• Fortes compétences en communication, en relations interpersonnelles et en leadership, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les fonctions et d'établir des relations de travail positives.

• L'esprit d'équipe avec l'engagement de favoriser un environnement de travail positif, collaboratif et professionnel.

• Fluent en allemand et en anglais, avec d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient de faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans égard à la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'âge, le statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, le statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Location. Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Repairing or replacing malfunctioning components, parts, and other mechanical or electrical equipment in the clean room and sterile environment (experience with aseptic filling lines is preferrable)

• Performing functional tests to validate the effectiveness of repair work. Maintaining records of maintenance services and repairs

• Executes manufacturing activities in the area of Drug Product according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Eliminating faults in the systems

• Open and track malfunction reports

• Continuous improvements

• Cooperate, advice and support Plant Engineering department

• Coordination of work processes in consultation with the team leaders

• Advanced handling of SAP, Cornerstone, DMS, Office 365.

What we are looking for:

• You have completed an EFZ apprenticeship as a mechanic or related profession (production mechanic, car mechanic, etc.)

• Several years of experience as a mechanic is an advantage.

• Excellent interpretation of P&ID diagrams or drawings.

• Very good knowledge of German is essential, English is an advantage

• Independent and precise way of working.

• You are customer-oriented and open to new ideas.

• Very good knowledge of English is essential, German is an advantage.

• Willing to work in 3-Shifts pattern, including Saturdays. Willing to be part of on call duty.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

jobs.title: CSV Engineer Biologics 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a CSV Engineer (m/f/d) you will be responsible for the generation and execution of the validation of the computerized systems on process engineering equipment and facilities. You are responsible to follow the planning and implementation of CSV activities resulting from projects and plant adaptations during the system life cycle of the plants, as well as make a contribution to the ongoing optimization of processes, facilities and internal procedures.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on Benefits - Visp

What you will do:

• Prepare commissioning and validation documents for new systems, and supervise conversion, expansion, and new construction projects. This includes CSV activities for critical systems in new construction projects and SLC support for all systems post debut.

• Supervise deviations, changes (GEP and GMP), and CAPAs, ensuring strict adherence to protocols.

• Coordinate CSV executions with internal groups, as well as external service providers and suppliers, to strictly ensure seamless integration.

• Present CSV documents during audits and inspections, showcasing our world-class standards.

• Schedule and report CSV activities, maintaining a flawless record of progress and outcomes.

• Align CSV strategy with QA CSV for all Biologics scope, showcasing our dedication to high standards.

• Contribute to the review and continuous amelioration of all CSV documents, ensuring ongoing optimization and success.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor / Master / Diploma from a technical school (HF) / university of applied sciences (FH) or university in a technical field or equivalent experience, showcasing your solid educational foundation.

• Significant experience in a regulated environment with regard to Computerized System Validation (CSV), demonstrating your proven expertise.

• Knowledge of KNEAT, COMOS (plant engineering software solution), DMS, TrackWise, and SAP is an advantage, improving your ability to compete in our ambitious environment.

• Proficient in English, with German language skills being advantageous, enabling you to collaborate effectively in our diverse team.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. Spread across 30+ sites and five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity shape what we achieve and how we achieve it. Join a highly ambitious greenfield project that is a cornerstone of Lonza’s Drug Product expansion, where you will provide strategic technical expertise, supporting the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of contamination control, sterility assurance and cleaning validation programs to ensure regulatory compliance and robust manufacturing performance throughout the product lifecycle  and help establish one of Switzerland’s most innovative sterile manufacturing sites. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will do:

• Act as  Subject Matter Expert for Sterility Assurance, Contamination Control and Cleaning Validation, providing strategic technical leadership to support compliant, efficient and inspection-ready sterile manufacturing operations.

• Support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of  the facility-wide Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), driving risk assessments, cross-contamination prevention measures and robust contamination control programs across the site.

• Support the lifecycle strategy and execution of key sterility assurance programs, including Aseptic Process Simulations (APS/Media Fills), Environmental Monitoring Performance Qualification (EM PQ), Smoke Studies, EMPQ and associated validation activities.

• Develop, optimize and sustain Cleaning Validation protocols, strategies and lifecycle programs, closing compliance gaps, strengthening process robustness and ensuring effective validation of equipment, facilities and manufacturing processes.

• Drive complex investigations, deviations, CAPAs and continuous improvement initiatives while partnering across functions to support facility start-up, project delivery, regulatory inspections and the successful growth of a landmark greenfield sterile manufacturing facility.

What we are looking for:

• Hands-on experience in aseptic Drug Product manufacturing, including Fill & Finish operations for vials and/or syringes, with a strong understanding of sterile processing principles.

• Proven expertise in either Cleaning Validation or Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) within sterile drug product manufacturing.

• Solid understanding of cleanroom classifications, material flows, HVAC concepts and contamination control principles, combined with the ability to perform and document risk-based assessments.

• Degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline, with fluent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse technical and operational stakeholders.

• Agile, proactive and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and drive alignment across multiple functions; experience supporting regulatory inspections and health authority interactions (e.g. FDA, Swissmedic) is a plus.

• Support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of the facility-wide Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), driving risk assessments, cross-contamination prevention measures and robust contamination control programs across the site.

• Support the lifecycle strategy and execution of key sterility assurance programs, including Aseptic Process Simulations (APS/Media Fills), Environmental Monitoring Performance Qualification (EM PQ), Smoke Studies, EMPQ and associated validation activities.

• Develop, optimize and sustain Cleaning Validation protocols, strategies and lifecycle programs, closing compliance gaps, strengthening process robustness and ensuring effective validation of equipment, facilities and manufacturing processes.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp, the Group Leader Drug Linker Development will lead the assigned group of PD/MSAT/DSP Chemists working on pipeline development and portfolio optimization of Drug Linker and Toxin products: He/she will also play a significant role in the set up of the Drug Linker Development unit Organization for the Drug Linker Asset under construction.
You will ensure close alignment between your team and the supported production facilities, while collaborating with the ADS Portfolio Optimization and Pipeline Development organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for the roadmap and strategy for continuous improvement, technical capabilities, and capacity of the assigned Development & MSAT scientist team.

This is a highly visible role for a scientist who wants to combine deep technical expertise with people leadership, customer-facing scientific impact, and strategic contribution to a growing Drug Linker Development and Manufacturing organization in the ADC market.
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the Drug Linker Development Organization Head in the ramp up phase of the Accelerate Asset Development unit by defining and supporting the implementation of all critical business processes for drug linker projects

• Manage the hiring process of the Accelerate Chemists for the Drug Linker Accelerate Asset together with the DL Development leadership team.

• Lead the assigned Drug Linker Process Development team of Chemists in line with agreed objectives and commitments and monitor and control their performance.

• Support the responsible Drug Linker Development Organization Head, in alignment with the Drug Linker Development Teams, in managing and allocating required chemists and lab resources resources.

• Guide Development and/or MSAT chemists to enable the efficient and robust transfer of Drug Linker Processes into the supported GMP manufacturing facilities.

• Drive the development and implementation of innovative technologies to increase capability, capacity, and efficiency within Drug Linker Toxin operations and support Lab investment programs for the introduction of relevant technology and tools.

• Act as a technical and scientific expert for Drug Linker Toxin projects internally and externally, responsibility includes creation of external scientific content to enhance reputation and visibility.

• Facilitate close collaboration between the Drug Linker Development team and critical interfaces and related product areas like Bioconjugates and Small Molecules Operations.

• Lead all HR-related aspects for the assigned team and actively contribute to the scientific development of scientists in their areas of expertise.

• Ensure compliance with GMP and safety regulations throughout all activities.

• Support the Head of Drug Linker Organization in assigned initiatives and strategic duties.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD in Organic Chemistry preferred.

• Approximately 5-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical process development, API development, clinical supply, or manufacturing sciences.

• Proven experience leading complex projects in a matrix organization within clinical supply, development, or manufacturing operations.

• Strong knowledge of chemical process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing requirements.

• Good knowledge of Drug Linker technology and understanding of safe work execution in containment assets.

• People management experience or strong motivation to develop into an expanded leadership role, including coaching and talent development.

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets and delivering against performance targets.

• Fluent English language skills; German proficiency is a strong asset.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Con sede a Visp, il Leader del Gruppo Drug Linker Development porterà il gruppo assegnato di chimici PD/MSAT/DSP che lavorano sullo sviluppo delle tubazioni e l'ottimizzazione del portafoglio dei prodotti Drug Linker e Toxin: Ha anche un ruolo significativo nella creazione dell'unità di sviluppo di Drug Linker Organization for the Drug Linker Asset in costruzione.
Potrai garantire un allineamento stretto tra il tuo team e gli impianti di produzione supportati, collaborando con le organizzazioni ADS Portfolio Optimization e Pipeline Development. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della roadmap e della strategia per il miglioramento continuo, le capacità tecniche e la capacità del team di scienziati assegnato Development & MSAT.

Questo è un ruolo altamente visibile per uno scienziato che vuole combinare profonda competenza tecnica con la leadership delle persone, l'impatto scientifico di fronte al cliente, e il contributo strategico per una crescente Drug Linker Development and Manufacturing organizzazione nel mercato ADC.
Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Sostenere l'Organizzazione per lo Sviluppo di Drug Linker Head nella fase di espansione dell'unità Accelerate Asset Development definendo e supportando l'implementazione di tutti i processi aziendali critici per i progetti di collegamento droga

• Gestire il processo di assunzione dei farmacisti Accelerate per il Drug Linker Accelerate Asset insieme al team di leadership DL Development.

• Guidare il team di sviluppo del processo di Drug Linker assegnato dei chimici in linea con gli obiettivi e gli impegni concordati e monitorare e controllare le loro prestazioni.

• Sostenere il responsabile Drug Linker Development Organization Head, in allineamento con i team di sviluppo di Drug Linker, nella gestione e nell'assegnazione di farmaci e risorse di laboratorio necessarie.

• Guida Sviluppo e/o chimici MSAT per consentire il trasferimento efficiente e robusto dei processi di collegamento dei farmaci negli impianti di produzione GMP supportati.

• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di tecnologie innovative per aumentare la capacità, la capacità e l'efficienza nelle operazioni di Drug Linker Toxin e sostenere i programmi di investimento Lab per l'introduzione di tecnologie e strumenti rilevanti.

• Agire come esperto tecnico e scientifico per i progetti Drug Linker Toxin internamente ed esternamente, la responsabilità include la creazione di contenuti scientifici esterni per migliorare la reputazione e la visibilità.

• Facilitate una stretta collaborazione tra il team di sviluppo di Drug Linker e le interfacce critiche e le relative aree di prodotto come Bioconjugates e Small Molecules Operations.

• Guidare tutti gli aspetti legati alle risorse umane per il team assegnato e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo scientifico degli scienziati nelle loro aree di competenza.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle normative GMP e di sicurezza in tutte le attività.

• Sostenere il Capo dell'Organizzazione dei Linker della Droga in iniziative assegnate e compiti strategici.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• PhD in Chimica, Ingegneria Chimica, o una disciplina relativa; PhD in Chimica Organica ha preferito.

• Circa 5-10 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del processo farmaceutico, nello sviluppo API, nella fornitura clinica o nelle scienze della produzione.

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce progetti complessi in un'organizzazione di matrice all'interno di attività di fornitura clinica, sviluppo o produzione.

• Forte conoscenza di processi chimici sviluppo, scala-up, trasferimento tecnologico e requisiti di produzione GMP.

• Buona conoscenza della tecnologia Drug Linker e la comprensione dell'esecuzione di lavoro sicura nei beni di contenimento.

• Esperienza di gestione delle persone o forte motivazione per sviluppare un ruolo di leadership ampliato, tra cui coaching e sviluppo del talento.

• Dimostrata esperienza di gestione dei bilanci di progetto e la consegna contro gli obiettivi di performance.

• competenze linguistiche fluenti; la competenza tedesca è un bene forte.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Basé à Visp, le chef de groupe Drug Linker Development dirigera le groupe désigné de chimistes PD/MSAT/DSP travaillant sur le développement de pipelines et l'optimisation du portefeuille de produits Drug Linker et de toxines : Il/elle jouera également un rôle important dans la mise en place de l'Unité de développement des liens médicamenteuses pour l'actif des liens médicamenteuses en construction.

Il s'agit d'un rôle très visible pour un scientifique qui veut combiner une expertise technique approfondie avec le leadership humain, l'impact scientifique de la clientèle et la contribution stratégique à une organisation croissante de développement et de fabrication de liens pharmaceutiques sur le marché de l'ADC.
C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement.

La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices

• Appuyer le chef de l'organisation de liaison des drogues dans les initiatives et les tâches stratégiques assignées.

• PhD en chimie, génie chimique ou une discipline connexe; PhD en chimie organique préféré.

• Expérience éprouvée menant des projets complexes dans une organisation matricielle au sein d'opérations cliniques d'approvisionnement, de développement ou de fabrication.

• Bonne connaissance des exigences en matière de développement des procédés chimiques, d'expansion, de transfert de technologie et de fabrication de BPF.

• Bonne connaissance de la technologie Drug Linker et compréhension de l'exécution sécuritaire des travaux dans les installations de confinement.

• Expérience en gestion des personnes ou forte motivation à devenir un rôle de leadership élargi, y compris l'encadrement et le perfectionnement des talents.

jobs.description:
Location. Visp, Switzerland.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you will do:

• Executes manufacturing activities in the area of Drug Product.

• According to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution.

• Provides front line technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing team.

• Securing each batch is manufactured safely, on time, in compliance with the batch instructions and quality requirements

• Responsible for establishing timely and with high quality the required production documentation (preparation, execution and review of batch records) or other relevant GMP documents for the assigned production area.

• Supports process related investigations and assists in decision making on production issues

• Supports process changes and CAPAs related to processes within required timelines

• Performs training activities of relevant areas as operator and supports others and new joiners.

• Operating, setting up and cleaning production equipment and premises for the production of liquid and freeze-dried drug forms (e.g.:compounding, parts washing, autoclaving, filter integrity testing, visual inspection)

What we are looking for:

• Several years of experience GMP environment on the shopfloor (preferably in sterile manufacturing of Drug Product)

• Fluent inEnglish (German is a plus).

• Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution

• Strong team orientation

• Effective communication skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization

• Structured, focused, and well-organized working attitude

• High motivation and dynamic drive

• IT knowledge and knowledge in SAP and MES is a benefit

• Prepared to work in 3 shifts pattern including nights and Saturdays.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione. Visp, Svizzera.

Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Cosa farai:

• Esegui le attività di produzione nell'area del Prodotto Droga.

• Secondo le linee guida cGMP, assicurando l'esecuzione batch, valutando i risultati dei test, risolvendo i problemi, risolvere le attrezzature di produzione e fare raccomandazioni per la risoluzione.

• Fornisce supporto tecnico e procedurale di prima linea, lavorando con il team di produzione.

• Securing ogni lotto viene prodotto in modo sicuro, puntuale, nel rispetto delle istruzioni batch e dei requisiti di qualità

• Responsabile per la determinazione tempestiva e di alta qualità della documentazione di produzione richiesta (preparazione, esecuzione e revisione dei record batch) o di altri documenti GMP rilevanti per l'area di produzione assegnata.

• Supporta le indagini relative al processo e assiste nel processo decisionale sui problemi di produzione

• Supporta i cambiamenti di processo e CAPA relativi ai processi entro le tempistiche richieste

• Esegui le attività di formazione di settori rilevanti come operatore e supporta altri e nuovi aggregatori.

• Attrezzature e locali di produzione per la produzione di liquidi e congelati (ad es.:compounding, lavaggio parti, autoclave, test di integrità del filtro, ispezione visiva)

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Diversi anni di esperienza GMP ambiente sul pavimento del negozio (preferibilmente nella produzione sterile di prodotti farmaceutici)

• Fluente in inglese (il tedesco è un plus).

• Familiarità con requisiti GMP, procedure di qualità e esecuzione SOP

• Forte orientamento di squadra

• Capacità di comunicazione efficaci e interazione con una varietà di interfacce all'interno dell'organizzazione

• Attuazione di lavoro strutturata, focalizzata e ben organizzata

• Alta motivazione e dinamica

• Conoscenze e conoscenze IT in SAP e MES

• Preparato a lavorare in 3 turni modello compreso notti e sabato.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C MES DeltaV Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade) landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: Benefits - Visp

What you’ll do:

• Execute and lead MES DeltaV projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.

• Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade) systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.

• Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.

• Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.

• Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).

• Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES DeltaV (formerly Syncade), or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.

• Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.

• Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.

• Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.

• Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Unisciti al nostro team di ingegneri a Visp come EI&C MES Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) e guida l'evoluzione del nostro paesaggio MES attraverso il suo ciclo di vita completo. In questo ruolo, formerai la produzione digitale con i principali progetti MES, rafforzando gli standard di sistema e garantendo prestazioni di sistema conformi a GMP e ad alto impatto.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di medicinali ai massimi standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura in Visp può essere trovata su: Vantaggi - Visp

Cosa farai:

• Eseguire e condurre progetti MES in tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita, tra cui analisi dei requisiti, progettazione, implementazione, test e distribuzione.

• Mantenere, ottimizzare e sviluppare ulteriormente gli standard MES, garantendo coerenza, conformità e allineamento con il sito e le linee guida globali.

• Assicurare un funzionamento, un miglioramento e un aggiornamento affidabili dei sistemi MES, riconoscendo il loro impatto diretto sui processi produttivi e sulla documentazione conforme a GMP.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team Operations, QA, Automation e IT/OT per garantire l'integrazione senza interruzioni del sistema e l'elevata disponibilità del sistema.

• Analizzare e migliorare i flussi di lavoro correlati a MES, identificare le opportunità di digitalizzazione, guadagni di efficienza e miglioramenti dell'integrità dei dati.

• Coordinare e gestire partner esterni e fornitori coinvolti nelle attività di progetto e supporto di MES o OT.

• Assicurare l'esecuzione conforme a GMP di tutte le attività MES e OT, tra cui documentazione, controllo dei cambiamenti e disponibilità di validazione.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea completa in Informatica, IT/OT industriale, Ingegneria dell'automazione, o un campo correlato (livello BAchelor o superiore).

• Esperienza professionale significativa in IT/OT, MES o ruoli di ingegneria legati all'automazione all'interno di un ambiente regolamentato.

• Solida comprensione dei requisiti GMP e dell'esperienza di lavoro con sistemi di produzione o automazione convalidati.

• Responsabilità per il ciclo di vita MES, tra cui il funzionamento del sistema, miglioramenti, gestione del rilascio e coordinamento dell'interfaccia.

• Forte conoscenza delle reti OT, delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione (ad esempio, VMware), delle architetture di sistema e dei principi di sicurezza informatica di base.

• Tedesco fluente o inglese (livello minimo B2) per una collaborazione efficace con gli stakeholder locali e globali.

• Strutturato, stile di lavoro indipendente con una comunicazione forte e capacità di problem solving.

• Volontà di partecipare a dovere on-call (Pikettdienst) 2-3 volte all'anno.

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Fundiertes Verständnis der GMP-Anforderungen und Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit validierten Produktions- oder Automatisierungssystemen.

• Verantwortung für den MES-Lebenszyklus, einschließlich Systembetrieb, Erweiterungen, Release-Management und Schnittstellenkoordination.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über OT-Netzwerke, Virtualisierungstechnologien (z. B. VMware), Systemarchitekturen und grundlegende Cybersicherheitsprinzipien.

• fließend Deutsch oder Englisch (Mindestniveau B2) für eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen und globalen Stakeholdern.

• Strukturierter, unabhängiger Arbeitsstil mit starken Kommunikations- und Problemlösungskompetenzen.

• Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst 2-3 Mal pro Jahr.

Unsere Grundwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Die theoretische Ausbildung findet in den ersten beiden Lehrjahren in Schweizerhalle (BL) statt. Dort erlernst du alle grundlegenden Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Verfahrenstechnik, Betriebstechnik, Chemie sowie in weiteren spannenden und angrenzenden Fachgebieten. • Gesamten Herstellprozess von Medikamenten in der präklinischen Bereich  überwachen, beobachten, protokollieren

• Richtlinien einhalten zum Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz sowie zur Arbeitssicherheit

• Interesse an technischen und naturwissenschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

Our most important scientific solution is talented people who work together and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In turn, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, big and small, make the world a better place. And that's the kind of work we want to be a part of.

Lonza in Basel offers an exciting apprenticeship as a chemical and pharmaceutical technologist EFZ. The company language is English, which gives you the opportunity to use and continuously expand your language skills on a daily basis. In this three-year apprenticeship, you will specialize in batch manufacturing in the preclinical area (non-GMP). You will be part of a motivated team and will control and monitor the production process of medicines as well as provide support in rectifying malfunctions. During your apprenticeship at Lonza, you will work with state-of-the-art, automated production facilities in the development area and learn how to use pharmaceutical technology processes.

The theoretical training takes place in Schweizerhalle (BL) in the first two years of the apprenticeship. There you will learn all the basic knowledge in the areas of process engineering, industrial engineering, chemistry and other exciting and related fields. The training is supplemented by various inter-company courses (üK).

Your tasks:

• Monitor, observe, log the entire manufacturing process of drugs in the preclinical area

• Implementation of in-process controls (IPC), integrity tests and functional checks on the production process

• Monitoring of automated production systems, support during filling

• Performing analytical measurements

• Preparation and follow-up of rooms and equipment

• Comply with guidelines for health and environmental protection as well as occupational safety

Your requirement profile:

• School leaving certificate at the intermediate or upper level (with very good performance also basic level) or Matura/Abitur

• Interest in technical and scientific contexts

• High level of concentration and good observation skills as well as networked thinking

• Motivation and perseverance

Il sito di Visp, la Svizzera sta crescendo e per la nostra organizzazione di Biologics, stiamo attualmente cercando esperti di processo e esperti di processo senior in Ibex® Solutions, il nostro concetto di produzione e sviluppo biologico da poco lanciato. Abbiamo opportunità sia in USP che in DSP in sostanza per la produzione su larga scala di mammiferi (fino a 20.000L). Come proprietario di un processo, sei responsabile della scala di successo, della supervisione e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi mammali. Diventa parte di questa eccitante opportunità e applica ora!

Responsabilità chiave:

• Leader tra team funzionali come esperto di processo incaricato di trasferimenti tecnologici (elaborazione di processo e up-scaling) e l'implementazione tempestiva di processo a scala di produzione. Questo include l'intero ciclo di vita dei progetti assegnati dalla pianificazione su coordinamento, implementazione, controllo e completamento del progetto allineati con gli obiettivi di gestione del progetto.

• Agire come interfaccia tra il donatore di processo (cliente, sviluppo di processo) e le operazioni. Responsabile per garantire scalabilità del processo e manufacturability.

• Securing successo durante il trasferimento tecnologico applicando processi e strumenti formali per gestire il trasferimento di informazioni, i rischi connessi al processo e il controllo dei cambiamenti

• Lavorare come esperto di processo MSAT in progetti di investimento di capitale per la costruzione e la messa in servizio delle unità di produzione. Principale responsabile della fornitura di tutti gli input necessari per i processi specifici (schemi di blocco, elenchi di supporti e buffer, elenchi di parametri critici)

• Responsabile per l'attuazione del processo di fabbricazione nell'impianto.

• Interagire direttamente con i clienti durante il trasferimento tecnico, la preparazione della campagna, l'esecuzione e la chiusura, compresa la segnalazione quotidiana di stato e prestazioni batch.

• Garantire una tempestiva compilazione di deviazioni, richieste di modifiche e report delle campagne

• Completare le sezioni CMC in documenti di deposito e contenuto tecnico dei rapporti di validazione

• Contribuire allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di procedure e processi standardizzati MSAT.

• Responsabile per il miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni di processo

• Supervisione dei compiti nell'area delle iniziative locali e globali di MSAT o delle principali forze di lavoro o team di risoluzione dei problemi.

• Valutare e guidare tendenze innovative nella rispettiva area di competenza

• Agire come mentore per il personale scientifico e produttivo in diversi campi di competenza.

• Formazione specifica di processo per il personale di produzione.

• Responsabile per la risoluzione dei problemi di processo che possono sorgere durante la produzione, considerando tutti i requisiti normativi

• Responsabile per l'esecuzione dell'analisi dei rischi GMP per i processi produttivi.

Requisiti chiave:

• Bachelor / Master, PhD preferito

• Area di studio consigliata: Biotecnologia, ingegneria chimica o discipline correlate

• Più di 5 anni di esperienza nel settore della produzione di biofarmaci e/o dello sviluppo di processi preferibili nel settore della produzione di mammiferi

• GMP e profonda comprensione della tecnologia del bioprocesso

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco

• Forte capacità di leadership

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione e interazione con tutti i tipi di interfacce all'interno dei clienti e l'organizzazione del progetto

• Forte orientamento di squadra

• Attuazione di lavoro strutturata, focalizzata e ben organizzata

• Aperto per nuove idee e suggerimenti

• Azionamento aggressivo, altamente motivato e dinamico

• Soluzione orientata

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this exciting opportunity and apply now!

Key responsibilities:

• Leading cross functional teams as a process expert tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning over coordination, implementation, control and project completion aligned with project management goals.

• Act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and operations. Responsible to ensure process scalability and manufacturability.

• Securing success during technology transfer by applying formal processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control

• Working as MSAT process expert in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of the manufacturing units. Main responsible for delivering all input required for the specific processes (block-flow diagrams, media and buffer lists, critical parameter lists)

• Responsible for implementing the manufacturing process in the plant.

• Interacting directly with customers during tech transfer, campaign preparation, execution and closure including daily reporting of batch status and performance.

• Ensuring timely compilation of process related deviations, change requests and campaign reports

• Compiling CMC sections in filing documents and technical content of validation reports

• Contributing to the development and implementation of standardized MSAT procedures and processes.

• Responsible for continuous improvement of process performance

• Supervising tasks in the area of local and global MSAT initiatives or leading major task forces or troubleshooting teams.

• Evaluating and driving innovative trends within the respective area of expertise

• Acting as a mentor for scientific and production staff in different fields of expertise.

• Performing process specific trainings for production staff.

• Responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory requirements

• Responsible for execution of GMP risk analysis for the manufacturing processes.

Key requirements:

• Bachelor / Master's degree, PhD preferred

• Preferred area of study: Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related disciplines

• More than 5 years of experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferable in the area of Mammalian Manufacturing

• GMP and deep understanding of bioprocess technology

• Fluency in English and German

• Strong leadership skills

• Very good communication skills and interaction with all kinds of interfaces within customers and the project organisation

• Strong team orientation

• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude

• Open-minded for new ideas and suggestions

• Agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive

• Solution-oriented

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Der Standort in Visp, Schweiz, wächst und für unsere Biologics-Organisation suchen wir derzeit erfahrene Prozessexperten und Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, unserem kürzlich eingeführten einzigartigen biologischen Herstellungs- und Entwicklungskonzept. Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Führende funktionsübergreifende Teams als Prozessexperte, der mit Technologietransfers (Prozessdesign und Up-Scaling) und zeitnaher Prozessimplementierung im Fertigungsmaßstab beauftragt ist. Dies umfasst den gesamten Lebenszyklus der zugewiesenen Projekte von der Planung über die Koordination, Umsetzung, Kontrolle und Projektabwicklung im Einklang mit den Projektmanagementzielen.

• Verantwortlich für die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Prozessleistung

• Verantwortlich für die Lösung von Prozessproblemen, die während der Herstellung auftreten können, unter Berücksichtigung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen

Wichtigste Anforderungen:

• Bachelor / Master, PhD bevorzugt

• Bevorzugter Studienbereich: Biotechnologie, Chemietechnik oder verwandte Disziplinen

• Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich der biopharma Herstellung und / oder Prozessentwicklung bevorzugt im Bereich der Säugetierherstellung

• GMP und tiefes Verständnis der Bioprozesstechnologie

• Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

• Starke Führungsqualitäten

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Interaktion mit allen Arten von Schnittstellen innerhalb der Kunden und der Projektorganisation

• Starke Teamorientierung

• Strukturierte, fokussierte und gut organisierte Arbeitseinstellung

• Aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Vorschläge

• Agiler, hochmotivierter und dynamischer Antrieb

• Lösungsorientiert

Jeden Tag haben die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Die Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um sich der Herausforderung und Kreativität zu stellen, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied kommt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Le site de Viège, en Suisse, est en pleine croissance et pour notre organisation de produits biologiques, nous recherchons actuellement des experts en procédés expérimentés et des experts en procédés seniors dans Ibex® Solutions, notre concept de fabrication et de développement biologique unique récemment lancé. Nous avons des possibilités en USP et en DSP en substance médicamenteuse pour la fabrication à grande échelle de mammifères (jusqu'à 20.000L). En tant que propriétaire de processus, vous êtes responsable de l'échelle réussie, de la supervision et de l'optimisation des processus de mammifères. Faites partie de cette opportunité passionnante et appliquez maintenant!

Principales responsabilités :

• Diriger les équipes interfonctionnelles en tant qu'expert en processus chargé des transferts de technologie (conception et mise à niveau des procédés) et de la mise en œuvre opportune des procédés à l'échelle de la fabrication. Cela comprend l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets assignés depuis la planification de la coordination, de la mise en oeuvre, du contrôle et de l'achèvement du projet, conformément aux objectifs de gestion du projet.

• Agir comme interface entre le donneur de processus (client, élaboration de processus) et les opérations. Responsable d'assurer l'évolutivité et la fabrication des procédés.

• Assurer le succès pendant le transfert de technologie en appliquant des processus et des outils officiels pour gérer le transfert de l'information, les risques liés au processus et le contrôle du changement

• En tant qu'expert en processus MSAT dans les projets d'investissement pour la construction et la mise en service des unités de fabrication. Responsable principal de la livraison de toutes les entrées nécessaires pour les processus spécifiques (diagrammes de flux de blocs, listes de supports et de tampons, listes de paramètres critiques)

• Responsable de la mise en œuvre du processus de fabrication dans l'usine.

• Interagir directement avec les clients lors du transfert de technologie, de la préparation, de l'exécution et de la fermeture de la campagne, y compris la notification quotidienne de l'état des lots et des performances.

• Assurer la compilation en temps opportun des écarts liés au processus, des demandes de changement et des rapports de campagne

• Compiler les sections CMC dans les documents de dépôt et le contenu technique des rapports de validation

• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre de procédures et de processus normalisés pour les systèmes MSAT.

• Responsable de l'amélioration continue de la performance du processus

• Superviser les tâches dans le domaine des initiatives MSAT locales et mondiales ou diriger des équipes spéciales ou des équipes de dépannage.

• Évaluer et stimuler les tendances novatrices dans le domaine d'expertise respectif

• Agir comme mentor pour le personnel scientifique et de production dans différents domaines d'expertise.

• Former le personnel de production à des processus spécifiques.

• Responsable du règlement des problèmes de procédé qui peuvent survenir pendant la fabrication, compte tenu de toutes les exigences réglementaires

• Responsable de l'exécution de l'analyse des risques des BPF pour les procédés de fabrication.

Principales exigences:

• Baccalauréat / maîtrise, doctorat préféré

• Domaine d'études privilégié : biotechnologie, génie chimique ou disciplines connexes

• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la fabrication de produits biopharmaceutiques et/ou du développement de procédés préférable dans le domaine de la fabrication de mammifères

• BPF et compréhension approfondie de la technologie des bioprocédés

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand

• Fortes compétences en leadership

• Très bonnes compétences en communication et interaction avec toutes sortes d'interfaces au sein des clients et de l'organisation du projet

• Une forte orientation de l'équipe

• Une attitude de travail structurée, ciblée et bien organisée

• Ouverture d'esprit pour de nouvelles idées et suggestions

• Conduite agile, très motivée et dynamique

• Orientation vers une solution

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

jobs.title: QC Laboratory Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to work in a challenging GMP-regulated environment and make a meaningful contribution to product quality through physical and physico-chemical testing? As part of our QC Physical Analytics team, you will take ownership of analytical testing, laboratory equipment, and the continuous improvement of our processes.

What you will get:

• A diverse and rewarding role in a modern laboratory environment.

• Meaningful work with a direct impact on product quality and patient safety.

• Access to modern technologies and analytical techniques.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A collaborative team culture built on openness, respect, and mutual support.

What you will do:

• Perform, evaluate, and document physico-chemical analyses in compliance with cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal procedures.

• Ensure the timely and GMP-compliant execution of assigned testing activities.

• Take responsibility for designated laboratory equipment, including calibration, qualification, and associated documentation.

• Support troubleshooting activities, deviation investigations, and the implementation of corrective actions.

• Actively contribute to the development and optimization of laboratory processes, analytical methods, and workflows.

• Support the onboarding and training of new team members and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

• Participate in the on-call duty rota as scheduled.

What we are looking for:

• Completed apprenticeship or degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a comparable scientific discipline.

• Initial or several years of experience in Quality Control, ideally within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or chemical manufacturing environment.

• Experience with physical and physico-chemical analytical techniques, such as:
• pH measurements

• Karl Fischer titration

• UV spectroscopy for protein concentration determination

• Osmolality and conductivity measurements

• Strong quality mindset and understanding of GMP and compliance requirements.

• Structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

• Good command of English and basic German skills.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stai cercando di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato GMP impegnativo e dare un contributo significativo alla qualità del prodotto attraverso test fisici e fisico-chimici? Nell'ambito del nostro team QC Physical Analytics, avrai la proprietà di test analitici, attrezzature di laboratorio e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi.

Cosa otterrai:

• Un ruolo vario e gratificante in un ambiente di laboratorio moderno.

• Lavoro significativo con un impatto diretto sulla qualità del prodotto e sulla sicurezza del paziente.

• Accesso alle moderne tecnologie e alle tecniche analitiche.

• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e personale.

• Una cultura collaborativa del team costruita su apertura, rispetto e supporto reciproco.

Cosa farai:

• Eseguire, valutare e documentare analisi fisico-chimiche nel rispetto dei requisiti cGMP, aspettative normative e procedure interne.

• Assicurare l'esecuzione tempestiva e conforme a GMP delle attività di test assegnate.

• Assumere la responsabilità di attrezzature di laboratorio designate, tra cui calibrazione, qualificazione e documentazione associata.

• Supporta le attività di risoluzione dei problemi, le indagini sulla deviazione e l'attuazione di azioni correttive.

• Contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione dei processi di laboratorio, dei metodi analitici e dei flussi di lavoro.

• Sostenere l'imbarco e la formazione di nuovi membri del team e promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze all'interno del team.

• Partecipare al rota di servizio di chiamata come previsto.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Apprendistato completato o laurea in Chimica, Biologia, Scienze Farmaceutiche, o una disciplina scientifica comparabile.

• Inizialmente o diversi anni di esperienza nel controllo della qualità, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, biotecnologico o chimico regolamentato da GMP.

• Esperienza con tecniche analitiche fisiche e fisico-chimiche, come:
• Misurazione del pH

• Titolazione Karl Fischer

• spettroscopia UV per la determinazione della concentrazione delle proteine

• Misurazioni di osmolalità e conducibilità

• Forte mentalità di qualità e comprensione di GMP e requisiti di conformità.

• Strutturato, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione.

• Goditi di lavorare in collaborazione e contribuendo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Buon comando delle competenze in inglese e tedesco di base.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti i background portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

• Strukturierte, unabhängige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

• Genießen Sie die Zusammenarbeit und tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen bei.

Über Lonza

The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As an HVAC & Utilities Engineer, you ensure the GMP‑compliant, safe, and energy‑efficient operation of Black Utilities, Clean Utilities, and HVAC systems within our new sterile Drug Product facility. During the start‑up phase of this global strategic growth project, you will significantly contribute to designing and implementing an optimal operational set‑up. In routine operations, you are responsible for system reliability, regulatory compliance, and up‑to‑date documentation in alignment with applicable guidelines and SOPs.
This position is part of our Drug Product Services (DPS) Business Unit in Stein, Switzerland, a CDMO environment supporting customers in solving some of the most complex challenges in modern therapeutics.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Stein: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5?lz=2

What you will do:

• Participate in FATs, construction walkdowns, commissioning, and qualification to ensure a smooth handover of Black Utilities, Clean Utilities, and HVAC systems

• Ensure safe, cGMP‑compliant operation and execution of maintenance activities after handover

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up‑to‑date system documentation

• Support risk analyses and create SOPs and work instructions for the new facility and assigned equipment

• Maintain qualification status of responsible areas in line with safety and GMP requirements

• Manage deviations and changes across the assigned system landscape

• Act as subject matter expert (SME) during audits and inspections for all HVAC & Utilities topics

What we are looking for:

• Degree in engineering (HF, FH, Dipl. Ing., B.Sc., M.Sc.) or a comparable technical education with strong technical understanding

• Proficiency in German (required); English skills preferred

• Significant experience in equipment maintenance, ideally in a pharmaceutical GMP environment

• Strong knowledge of SAP‑PM and MS Office

• Analytical mindset with the ability to define and track KPIs

• Familiarity with GMP compliance requirements preferred

• Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic project and operational setting

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, KPIs zu definieren und zu verfolgen

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. jobs.description:
Operational Excellence Manager (m/f/d) 80%-100%

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Mid-Scale Microbial Operations team in Visp and help shape the future of biopharmaceutical manufacturing through Operational Excellence. In this role, you will drive strategic improvement initiatives, lead Lean Six Sigma projects, and enable sustainable business performance through innovation, coaching, and continuous improvement.

This role is based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• Opportunities to lead high-impact transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Professional growth through coaching, mentoring, and leadership exposure across the organization.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and coordinate innovation and Operational Excellence projects using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to improve manufacturing performance and operational efficiency.

• Own the end-to-end asset improvement roadmap, accelerating operational gains, enhancing process robustness, and supporting reliable long-term drug substance supply.

• Partner with functional leaders across Operations, Quality, Engineering, and Technical Services to identify opportunities and establish continuous improvement objectives.

• Coach and support employees pursuing White Belt, Yellow Belt, and Green Belt certifications while fostering a culture of continuous improvement throughout the organization.

• Monitor, review, and improve operational performance metrics, ensuring data-driven decisions and sustainable business outcomes.

• Align and prioritize improvement initiatives to maximize synergies between local asset objectives and broader site and organizational transformation programs.

• Act as a change agent by promoting innovation, problem-solving, and Lean thinking across the Mid-Scale Microbial asset.

What we are looking for:

• Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline. A PhD in one of these fields is considered an advantage.

• 5-10 years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, process development, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a GMP-regulated environment.

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification with demonstrated success in delivering measurable business improvements through structured problem-solving and process optimization. Master Black Belt or Lean Master certification is highly desirable.

• Strong experience leading cross-functional projects and driving operational excellence initiatives from concept through implementation.

• Proven ability to coach, train, and mentor employees across different Lean Six Sigma certification levels and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

• Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are considered a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills, with the ability to translate strategic objectives into sustainable operational results.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
