In this role, you will shape and continuously improve maintenance strategies across technical assets and production systems (e.g. HVAC, utilities, facilities, automation systems, and fill & finish equipment), driving reliability, data quality, and asset availability in a cutting-edge sterile drug product facility. As part of an exciting greenfield project, you will collaborate with planners, service providers, and cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges, optimize performance through data-driven insights and KPIs, and help build the future of manufacturing in a fast-paced, highly diverse environment. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:
●     An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
●     An inclusive and ethical workplace.
●     Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.

Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Develop and continuously enhance maintenance strategies for technical assets and production systems to maximize equipment reliability, compliance, and operational availability.

• Establish and optimize maintenance plans for new and existing assets, including spare parts strategies, master data management, documentation, and alignment of maintenance activities with long-term reliability objectives.

• Drive maintenance excellence through data analysis, KPI monitoring, work order management, and continuous improvement initiatives that improve plant operability, reliability, and performance.

• Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. planners, service providers, technicians, operators, engineers, and quality teams) to ensure maintenance activities are scheduled effectively, resources are available, and strategy-driven plans are executed on time.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in maintenance engineering, maintenance planning, or reliability management, with the ability to develop effective maintenance strategies and translate asset requirements into sustainable maintenance plans.

• Strong hands-on knowledge of SAP PM, including maintenance planning, work order management, asset data management, and the evaluation of technical and cost-related information to support decision-making.

• Excellent communication skills in German (fluent) and English (professional level), enabling effective collaboration with technicians, contractors, and international stakeholders.

• Technical education in Engineering or a related field preferred, combined with a solid understanding of equipment maintenance, reliability improvement, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Thrives in a dynamic and fast-changing environment, bringing a proactive, solution-oriented mindset, a high degree of ownership, and the flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities; experience with COMOS, GMP, and/or the pharmaceutical industry is considered a strong advantage.

• Stabilire e ottimizzare piani di manutenzione per asset nuovi ed esistenti, incluse strategie per i pezzi di ricambio, gestione dei dati master, documentazione e allineamento delle attività di manutenzione con gli obiettivi di affidabilità a lungo termine.

• Promuovere l'eccellenza nella manutenzione attraverso l'analisi dei dati, il monitoraggio dei KPI, la gestione degli ordini di lavoro e iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano l'operatività, l'affidabilità e le prestazioni dell'impianto.

• Collaborare strettamente con stakeholder trasversali (ad esempio pianificatori, fornitori di servizi, tecnici, operatori, ingegneri e team di qualità) per garantire che le attività di manutenzione siano programmate in modo efficace, che le risorse siano disponibili e che i piani guidati dalla strategia vengano eseguiti puntualmente.

• Agire come esperto di manutenzione focalizzato sull'affidabilità, fornendo formazione di sistema, supporto alla risoluzione dei problemi e indicazioni tecniche, mantenendo al contempo dati di alta qualità degli asset e individuando opportunità per migliorare la disponibilità delle apparecchiature in tutto il sito.

• Esperienza comprovata in ingegneria della manutenzione, pianificazione della manutenzione o gestione dell'affidabilità, con la capacità di sviluppare strategie di manutenzione efficaci e tradurre i requisiti degli asset in piani di manutenzione sostenibili.

• Solida conoscenza pratica del SAP PM, inclusa pianificazione della manutenzione, gestione degli ordini di lavoro, gestione dei dati degli asset e la valutazione di informazioni tecniche e relative ai costi per supportare il processo decisionale.

• Eccellenti capacità comunicative in tedesco (fluente) e inglese (livello professionale), che permettono una collaborazione efficace con tecnici, appaltatori e stakeholder internazionali.

• Si preferisce formazione tecnica in Ingegneria o in un campo correlato, combinata con una solida comprensione della manutenzione delle apparecchiature, del miglioramento dell'affidabilità, della risoluzione dei problemi e delle metodologie di miglioramento continuo.

• Prospera in un ambiente dinamico e in rapido cambiamento, portando una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni, un alto grado di appartenenza e la flessibilità di adattarsi alle priorità in evoluzione; l'esperienza con COMOS, GMP e/o l'industria farmaceutica è considerata un grande vantaggio.

Da Lonza, le nostre persone sono la nostra più grande forza. I nostri valori fondamentali di Collaborazione, Responsabilità, Eccellenza, Passione e Integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di ognuno, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare la vita di milioni di persone, ed è questo il tipo di lavoro a cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando persone di ogni provenienza portano le loro prospettive uniche. In Lonza, valorizziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se sei pronto a trasformare le idee rivoluzionarie dei nostri clienti in terapie praticabili, non vediamo l'ora di accoglierti a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Candidati ora.

• Erstellung und Optimierung von Wartungsplänen für neue und bestehende Anlagen, einschließlich Ersatzteilstrategien, Masterdatenmanagement, Dokumentation und Abstimmung der Wartungsaktivitäten mit langfristigen Zuverlässigkeitszielen.

• Fördern Sie Wartungsqualität durch Datenanalyse, KPI-Überwachung, Verwaltung von Arbeitsaufträgen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen, die die Betriebsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung der Anlage verbessern.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit bereichsübergreifenden Interessengruppen (z. B. Planer, Dienstleister, Techniker, Bediener, Ingenieure und Qualitätsteams) zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Wartungsaktivitäten effektiv geplant werden, Ressourcen zur Verfügung stehen und strategieorientierte Pläne pünktlich ausgeführt werden.

• Agieren Sie als zuverlässigkeitsfokussierter Wartungsexperte, indem Sie Systemschulungen, Fehlerbehebungsunterstützung und technische Beratung anbieten, während hochwertige Vermögensdaten gepflegt und Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Verfügbarkeit von Geräten auf dem gesamten Gelände identifiziert werden.

Was wir suchen:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Wartungstechnik, Wartungsplanung oder Zuverlässigkeitsmanagement mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Wartungsstrategien zu entwickeln und die Anforderungen der Vermögenswerte in nachhaltige Wartungspläne umzusetzen.

• Umfassendes praxisorientiertes Wissen über SAP PM, einschließlich Wartungsplanung, Arbeitsauftragmanagement, Asset-Datenmanagement sowie der Bewertung technischer und kostenbezogener Informationen zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung.

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (fließend) und Englisch (auf professionellem Niveau), was eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit Technikern, Auftragnehmern und internationalen Interessengruppen ermöglicht.

• Technische Ausbildung im Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich wird bevorzugt, kombiniert mit einem fundierten Verständnis von Gerätewartung, Zuverlässigkeitsverbesserung, Fehlerbehebung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden.

• Gedeiht in einem dynamischen und sich schnell verändernden Umfeld, bringt eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise, ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und die Flexibilität, sich an sich ändernde Prioritäten anzupassen; Erfahrung mit COMOS, GMP und/oder der Pharmaindustrie gilt als großer Vorteil.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit 30+ Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen aller Menschen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau diese Art von Arbeit möchten wir, dass du dabei bist.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord willkommen zu heißen.
Bereit, die Zukunft der Lebenswissenschaften mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

Il s'agit d'un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne favorise une collaboration étroite en temps réel ainsi que la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments selon les normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :
● Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
● Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique.
● Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent la haute performance.
En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages liés au style de vie, à la famille et aux loisirs.
La liste complète de nos avantages mondiaux est disponible ici : https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Nos avantages locaux : 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Ce que vous ferez :

• Développer et améliorer continuellement les stratégies de maintenance des actifs techniques et des systèmes de production afin de maximiser la fiabilité, la conformité et la disponibilité opérationnelle des équipements.

• Établir et optimiser des plans de maintenance pour les actifs nouveaux et existants, y compris les stratégies de pièces détachées, la gestion des données maîtresses, la documentation et l'alignement des activités de maintenance avec les objectifs de fiabilité à long terme.

• Favoriser l'excellence de la maintenance grâce à l'analyse des données, au suivi des indicateurs clés de performance, à la gestion des ordres de travail et à des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui améliorent l'opérabilité, la fiabilité et la performance de l'usine.

• Agir en tant qu'expert en maintenance axé sur la fiabilité en fournissant formation système, soutien au dépannage et conseils techniques tout en maintenant des données d'actifs de haute qualité et en identifiant des opportunités pour améliorer la disponibilité des équipements sur tout le site.

Ce que nous recherchons :

• Expérience avérée en ingénierie de maintenance, planification de maintenance ou gestion de la fiabilité, avec la capacité de développer des stratégies de maintenance efficaces et de traduire les besoins en actifs en plans de maintenance durables.

• Solide connaissance pratique du SAP PM, incluant la planification de maintenance, la gestion des ordres de travail, la gestion des données d'actifs, ainsi que l'évaluation des informations techniques et liées aux coûts pour soutenir la prise de décision.

• Excellentes compétences en communication en allemand (couramment) et en anglais (niveau professionnel), permettant une collaboration efficace avec les techniciens, les entrepreneurs et les parties prenantes internationales.

• Une formation technique en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe est privilégiée, combinée à une solide compréhension de la maintenance des équipements, de l'amélioration de la fiabilité, du dépannage et des méthodologies d'amélioration continue.

• Prospère dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide, apportant un état d'esprit proactif et orienté vers les solutions, un haut degré de prise en charge et la flexibilité de s'adapter aux priorités changeantes ; une expérience avec le COMOS, les BPF et/ou l'industrie pharmaceutique est considérée comme un atout important.

Chez Lonza, nos équipes sont notre plus grande force. Avec 30+ sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent ensemble chaque jour pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de Collaboration, Responsabilité, Excellence, Passion et Intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de chacun, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer la vie de millions de personnes, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de tous horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous valorisons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider à transformer les idées révolutionnaires de nos clients en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Postulez dès maintenant.

jobs.title: Upstream Team Lead
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

The USP Team Lead is responsible for providing technical leadership and manufacturing support for Upstream Processing (USP) operations. The role directly manages a team of Bioprocess Engineers and works closely with four USP Shift Team Leads to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing execution. The position serves as the primary technical escalation point for USP operations and supports the Head USP in achieving departmental goals related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and people development.

Picket Dienst (on-call duty) is required sometimes in this role.

What you will do:

• Accountable for the planning, execution and documentation of manufacturing campaigns within the USP area.

• Provides technical leadership and expertise for mammalian cell culture manufacturing operations.

• Supports technology transfers, process validation, process monitoring and lifecycle management activities.

• Ensures manufacturing activities are performed in accordance with cGMP requirements and approved procedures.

• Prepares and executes SHE, EM, operational and cleaning risk assessments and ensures implementation of mitigation measures.

• Acts as manufacturing subject matter expert during customer audits, inspections and visits.

• Acts as manufacturing expert for capital projects, commissioning, qualification and start-up activities.

• Drives innovation, operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensures a high level of technical standardization across the USP organization.

• Provides direct line management, leadership, coaching and development for a team of Bioprocess Engineers.

• Sets objectives, establishes priorities and manages performance of direct reports.

• Ensures effective allocation of Bioprocess Engineer resources across manufacturing support, investigations and improvement projects.

• Supports recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of talent; Conducts performance reviews, talent assessments, succession planning and development discussions.

• Acts as the primary escalation point for technical and personnel-related matters within the Bioprocess Engineering team.

• Partners closely with USP Shift Team Leads to ensure alignment between manufacturing execution and engineering support activities.

• Supports the Head USP in operational planning, resource optimization and strategic initiatives.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences or related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in biotechnology, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, process engineering or USP operations.

• Strong technical expertise in mammalian cell culture and GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

• Previous leadership and people management experience preferred.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

• Fluent English required; German highly desirable.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di medicinali ai massimi standard di qualità e sicurezza

Cosa otterrai:

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi su misura locali può anche essere trovato di seguito.

• Vantaggi in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

L'USP Team Lead è responsabile di fornire leadership tecnica e supporto manifatturiero per le operazioni di Upstream Processing (USP). Il ruolo gestisce direttamente un team di ingegneri di bioprocesso e lavora a stretto contatto con quattro Team USP Shift per garantire un'esecuzione di produzione sicura, conforme ed efficiente. La posizione serve come punto di escalation tecnico primario per le operazioni USP e supporta il Head USP nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi dipartimentali relativi alla sicurezza, alla qualità, alla consegna, alla produttività e allo sviluppo delle persone.

Picket Dienst (su richiesta) è richiesto a volte in questo ruolo.

Cosa farai:

• Contabile per la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la documentazione delle campagne di produzione nell'area USP.

• Fornisce leadership tecnica e competenze per le operazioni di produzione di cellule mammali.

• Supporta i trasferimenti tecnologici, la convalida dei processi, il monitoraggio dei processi e le attività di gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Assicura le attività di produzione vengono svolte in conformità con i requisiti cGMP e le procedure approvate.

• Prepara ed esegue SHE, EM, valutazioni di rischio operative e di pulizia e garantisce l'implementazione di misure di mitigazione.

• Atto come esperto di materia di produzione durante i controlli, le ispezioni e le visite dei clienti.

• Agisce come esperto di produzione per progetti di capitale, commissioning, qualificazione e attività di start-up.

• Guida innovazione, eccellenza operativa e iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Garantisce un elevato livello di standardizzazione tecnica in tutta l'organizzazione USP.

• Fornisce gestione diretta della linea, leadership, coaching e sviluppo per un team di Bioprocess Engineers.

• Imposta gli obiettivi, stabilisce le priorità e gestisce le prestazioni delle relazioni dirette.

• Garantisce un'efficace allocazione delle risorse dell'Ingegnere Bioprocess attraverso progetti di supporto, indagini e miglioramento della produzione.

• Supporta il reclutamento, l'imbarco, la formazione e la ritenzione del talento; Conduce recensioni sulle prestazioni, valutazioni dei talenti, piani di successione e discussioni sullo sviluppo.

• Agisce come punto di escalation primario per questioni tecniche e relative al personale all'interno del team di Bioprocess Engineering.

• I partner di stretta collaborazione con USP Shift Team sono in grado di garantire l'allineamento tra le attività di esecuzione e supporto tecnico.

• Supporta il Head USP nella pianificazione operativa, nell'ottimizzazione delle risorse e nelle iniziative strategiche.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea o Master in Biotecnologia, Ingegneria Biochimica, Ingegneria Chimica, Scienze della Vita o disciplina relativa.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in biotecnologie, produzione biofarmaceutica, ingegneria dei processi o operazioni USP.

• Forte competenza tecnica nella cultura cellulare dei mammiferi e negli ambienti di produzione regolati da GMP.

• Precedente leadership e la gestione delle persone esperienza preferita.

• Forte comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di problem solving.

• Inglese fluente richiesto; tedesco altamente desiderabile.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed

Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we build production-ready data infrastructure that connects process, execution, and development data into a coherent and trusted foundation used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global data teams.

We are looking for a Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp to design, build, and operate this data foundation and support reliable, scalable use of operational data across teams

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and operate automated data pipelines integrating distributed file-based data stores and raw operational system databases, including historians (PI), MES, ELN and instrument data, into a coherent, end-to-end operational data foundation.

• Replace manual, file-based data handling with governed, versioned and traceable data flows that stand up to daily operational use.

• Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring to ensure data reliability at scale in an operational environment.

• Deliver analytics-ready datasets (clean schemas, consistent semantics, time-aligned data) to downstream BI, advanced analytics and modeling layers supporting operational decision-making.

• Work closely with MSAT, Process Development, Automation, QA, IT and global data teams to align data models, definitions and integration patterns across the organization.

• Continuously improve pipeline performance, robustness and maintainability in line with operational priorities.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience building, operating, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines in manufacturing, industrial, or operational environments.

• Strong SQL expertise with the ability to design efficient data models and optimize queries for high-volume operational workloads.

• Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipeline development and integration of process, execution, and operational data sources.

• Practical knowledge of OT systems, including MES, PI Historian, instrument data, or similar industrial data platforms.

• Solid understanding of data quality, lineage, traceability, governance, and compliance, ideally within GxP-regulated environments.

• Experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control, and cloud-native data architectures.

• Background in biopharma, life sciences, manufacturing, or operations data, with the ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable data solutions.

About Lonza:
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

All'interno del team Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) embedded direttamente in Operations, costruiamo l'infrastruttura di dati pronta alla produzione che collega i dati di processo, esecuzione e sviluppo in una fondazione coerente e affidabile utilizzata quotidianamente da MSAT, Process Development, Operations e team di dati globali.

Stiamo cercando un Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp per progettare, costruire e gestire questa base di dati e supportare l'utilizzo affidabile e scalabile dei dati operativi tra i team

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura in Visp può essere trovata su 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Cosa farai:

• Progettazione, costruzione e gestione di datadotti automatizzati che integrano archivi distribuiti e database di sistemi operativi grezzi, tra cui storici (PI), dati MES, ELN e strumenti, in una coerente base di dati operativi end-to-end.

• Sostituire la gestione manuale dei dati, basata su file con flussi di dati regolati, versioneti e tracciabili che si estendono all'uso operativo quotidiano.

• Implementare e applicare controlli di qualità dei dati, regole di convalida e monitoraggio per garantire l'affidabilità dei dati in scala in un ambiente operativo.

• Fornire set di dati analitici (strumenti puliti, semantici coerenti, dati allineati a tempo) a BI a valle, livelli di analisi e modellazione avanzati che supportano il processo decisionale operativo.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con MSAT, Sviluppo dei processi, Automazione, QA, IT e team di dati globali per allineare modelli di dati, definizioni e modelli di integrazione in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Migliorare costantemente le prestazioni delle tubazioni, la robustezza e la manutenbilità in linea con le priorità operative.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Prove esperienze di costruzione, funzionamento e ottimizzazione di datadotti di qualità della produzione in ambienti produttivi, industriali o operativi.

• Forte competenza SQL con la capacità di progettare modelli di dati efficienti e ottimizzare le richieste per carichi di lavoro operativi ad alto volume.

• Esperienza pratica con lo sviluppo e l'integrazione delle fonti di dati di processo, esecuzione e operativi ETL/ELT.

• Conoscenza pratica dei sistemi OT, tra cui MES, PI Historian, dati degli strumenti o piattaforme di dati industriali simili.

• Solida comprensione della qualità dei dati, del lignaggio, della tracciabilità, della governance e della conformità, idealmente all'interno di ambienti regolati da GxP.

• Esperienza con i servizi dati Azure, tra cui Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control e cloud-native data architectures.

• Sfondo in biofarmaci, scienze della vita, dati di produzione o operativi, con la capacità di tradurre complessi processi operativi in soluzioni dati scalabili.

Informazioni su Lonza:
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed

Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we build production-ready data infrastructure that connects process, execution, and development data into a coherent and trusted foundation used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global data teams.

We are looking for a Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp to design, build, and operate this data foundation and support reliable, scalable use of operational data across teams

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and operate automated data pipelines integrating distributed file-based data stores and raw operational system databases, including historians (PI), MES, ELN and instrument data, into a coherent, end-to-end operational data foundation.

• Replace manual, file-based data handling with governed, versioned and traceable data flows that stand up to daily operational use.

• Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring to ensure data reliability at scale in an operational environment.

• Deliver analytics-ready datasets (clean schemas, consistent semantics, time-aligned data) to downstream BI, advanced analytics and modeling layers supporting operational decision-making.

• Work closely with MSAT, Process Development, Automation, QA, IT and global data teams to align data models, definitions and integration patterns across the organization.

• Continuously improve pipeline performance, robustness and maintainability in line with operational priorities.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience building, operating, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines in manufacturing, industrial, or operational environments.

• Strong SQL expertise with the ability to design efficient data models and optimize queries for high-volume operational workloads.

• Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipeline development and integration of process, execution, and operational data sources.

• Practical knowledge of OT systems, including MES, PI Historian, instrument data, or similar industrial data platforms.

• Solid understanding of data quality, lineage, traceability, governance, and compliance, ideally within GxP-regulated environments.

• Experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control, and cloud-native data architectures.

• Background in biopharma, life sciences, manufacturing, or operations data, with the ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable data solutions.

About Lonza:
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Innerhalb des direkt in Operations eingebetteten Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI)-Teams bauen wir eine produktionsfähige Dateninfrastruktur auf, die Prozess-, Ausführungs- und Entwicklungsdaten zu einer kohärenten und vertrauenswürdigen Grundlage verbindet, die täglich von MSAT, Process Development, Operations und globalen Datenteams verwendet wird.

Wir suchen einen Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp, um diese Datengrundlage zu entwerfen, aufzubauen und zu betreiben und die zuverlässige, skalierbare Nutzung von Betriebsdaten in allen Teams zu unterstützen.

Dies ist eine vollständig ortsbezogene Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteile erwarten. Unsere vollständige Liste der maßgeschneiderten lokalen Vorteile in Visp finden Sie unter 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Was Sie tun werden:

• Entwerfen, bauen und betreiben Sie automatisierte Datenpipelines, die verteilte dateibasierte Datenspeicher und rohe Betriebssystemdatenbanken, einschließlich Historiker (PI), MES, ELN und Instrumentendaten, in eine kohärente, durchgängige operative Datenbasis integrieren.

• Ersetzen Sie manuelle, dateibasierte Datenverarbeitung durch geregelte, versionierte und nachvollziehbare Datenflüsse, die dem täglichen operativen Einsatz standhalten.

• Implementieren und Erzwingen von Datenqualitätsprüfungen, Validierungsregeln und Überwachung, um die Datenzuverlässigkeit in einer operativen Umgebung zu gewährleisten.

• Bereitstellen von analysefähigen Datensätzen (saubere Schemata, konsistente Semantik, zeitorientierte Daten) für nachgelagerte BI, fortschrittliche Analyse- und Modellierungsebenen, die die operative Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit MSAT, Prozessentwicklung, Automatisierung, QA, IT und globalen Datenteams zusammen, um Datenmodelle, Definitionen und Integrationsmuster im gesamten Unternehmen abzugleichen.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Leistung, Robustheit und Wartbarkeit der Pipeline im Einklang mit den operativen Prioritäten.

Was wir suchen:

• Bewährte Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb und der Optimierung von produktionsgerechten Datenpipelines in Fertigungs-, Industrie- oder Betriebsumgebungen.

• Starkes SQL-Know-how mit der Fähigkeit, effiziente Datenmodelle zu entwerfen und Abfragen für hochvolumige operative Workloads zu optimieren.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von ETL/ELT-Pipelines und der Integration von Prozess-, Ausführungs- und Betriebsdatenquellen.

• Praktische Kenntnisse von OT-Systemen, einschließlich MES, PI Historian, Instrumentendaten oder ähnlichen industriellen Datenplattformen.

• Solides Verständnis von Datenqualität, Abstammung, Rückverfolgbarkeit, Governance und Compliance, idealerweise in GxP-regulierten Umgebungen.

• Erfahrung mit Azure-Datendiensten, einschließlich Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-basierter Versionskontrolle und Cloud-nativer Datenarchitekturen.

• Hintergrund in Biopharma-, Biowissenschaften-, Fertigungs- oder Betriebsdaten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Betriebsprozesse in skalierbare Datenlösungen zu übersetzen.

Über Lonza:
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Au sein de l'équipe Processus Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI), intégrée directement aux Opérations, nous construisons une infrastructure de données prête à la production qui relie les données de processus, d'exécution et de développement en une base cohérente et fiable utilisée quotidiennement par les équipes MSAT, Process Development, Operations et Global Data.

Nous recherchons un Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence à Viège pour concevoir, construire et exploiter cette base de données et soutenir une utilisation fiable et évolutive des données opérationnelles entre les équipes

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Notre liste complète des prestations locales sur mesure à Visp se trouve sur 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Ce que vous ferez :

• Concevoir, construire et exploiter des pipelines de données automatisés intégrant des dépôts de données distribués basés sur des fichiers et des bases de données de systèmes opérationnels bruts, y compris des historiens (PI), des MES, des ELN et des données d'instruments, en une base de données opérationnelles cohérente et complète.

• Remplacer le traitement manuel des données par des flux de données régis, en version et traçables qui résistent à une utilisation opérationnelle quotidienne.

• Mettre en œuvre et faire appliquer des contrôles de la qualité des données, des règles de validation et une surveillance pour assurer la fiabilité des données à l'échelle dans un environnement opérationnel.

• Fournir des ensembles de données prêts à l'analyse (schémas propres, sémantique cohérente, données chronologiques) à BI en aval, des niveaux d'analyse et de modélisation avancés qui appuient la prise de décisions opérationnelles.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de MSAT, de développement des processus, d'automatisation, d'AQ, d'informatique et de données mondiales pour harmoniser les modèles de données, les définitions et les modèles d'intégration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Améliorer continuellement le rendement, la robustesse et la viabilité des pipelines conformément aux priorités opérationnelles.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de construction, d'exploitation et d'optimisation de pipelines de données de qualité de production dans des environnements de fabrication, industriels ou opérationnels.

• Forte expertise SQL avec la capacité de concevoir des modèles de données efficaces et d'optimiser les requêtes pour les charges de travail opérationnelles élevées.

• Expérience pratique du développement de pipelines ETL/ELT et intégration des sources de données de processus, d'exécution et d'exploitation.

• Connaissance pratique des systèmes OT, y compris MES, PI historien, données d'instrument, ou des plateformes de données industrielles similaires.

• Une bonne compréhension de la qualité des données, de la lignée, de la traçabilité, de la gouvernance et de la conformité, idéalement dans les environnements réglementés par GxP.

• Expérience avec les services de données Azure, y compris Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control, et les architectures de données cloud-native.

• Contexte en biopharmacie, en sciences de la vie, en fabrication ou en exploitation, avec la capacité de traduire des processus opérationnels complexes en solutions de données évolutives.

À propos de Lonza :
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

We are looking to recruit a Manufacturing Lead (Director) to build up the operations organization for the Payload-Linker capacity expansion in Visp.  Leads a team of  production leaders, supervisors and specialists You will manage the operational readiness and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up within the investment / Capex Project. After becoming operational, you will oversee the operational activities of the manufacturing unit with overall responsibility of manufacturing execution regarding safety, quality and on-time-in full delivery, as well as for the performance and results of the assigned area including cost control.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Lead a team of production managers (chemists/chemical engineers), supervisors, and specialists, with full responsibility for all aspects of people management, including qualification, development, coaching, hiring, compensation decisions, and performance or conduct issues.

• Manage the operational readiness within the CAPEX project and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up

What we are looking for:

• Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or equivalent) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

• Demonstrated leadership skills with strong self-motivation, integrity, perseverance, and results orientation.

• Extensive experience in chemical manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry, in leadership roles.

• Strong knowledge of GMP and EHS requirements.

• Fluency in English, German is an advantage

jobs.title: Bioprocess Engineer DSP
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

The DSP Bioprocess Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and documentation of commercial and clinical manufacturing campaigns within the Downstream Processing (DSP) area. The role serves as the manufacturing subject matter expert for assigned products, ensuring compliant, safe, efficient, and reliable production according to cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, and operational excellence standards.
The DSP Bioprocess Engineer acts as the Functional Lead for manufacturing-related activities, supports plant operations, leads risk assessments and process improvements, and provides technical expertise for capital projects, commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness.

What you will do:

• Lead and oversee DSP manufacturing campaigns, ensuring execution, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation are compliant with cGMP and regulatory requirements.

• Act as the manufacturing Functional Lead for assigned products, coordinating cross-functional teams and maintaining technical expertise in processes, equipment, and facilities.

• Drive risk management activities, including SHE, EM, operational, cleaning, and product risk assessments, while supporting investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.

• Maintain GMP documentation such as SOPs, manufacturing instructions, risk assessments, and records to ensure compliance and audit readiness.

• Train and support manufacturing personnel, contributing to workforce development and fostering a culture of safety, quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

• Represent manufacturing in capital projects, providing technical input for facility design, equipment selection, commissioning, qualification, and technology transfers.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives and serve as a manufacturing representative during customer audits, inspections, and strategic cross-functional projects.

What we are looking for:

• Strong expertise in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, particularly downstream processing (DSP), with the ability to troubleshoot technical and process-related issues.

• Solid understanding of cGMP requirements and regulatory standards applicable to pharmaceutical manufacturing.

• Experience managing quality systems and compliance activities, including risk assessments, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and validation.

• Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities, enabling effective collaboration across functions and organizational levels.

• Demonstrated project leadership and team coordination experience within complex, regulated manufacturing environments.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, along with relevant experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, process engineering, technical operations, or cGMP-regulated environments.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi su misura locali può anche essere trovato di seguito.

• Vantaggi in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Il DSP Bioprocess Engineer è responsabile per la pianificazione, l'esecuzione, il monitoraggio e la documentazione delle campagne di produzione commerciali e cliniche nell'area di Downstream Processing (DSP). Il ruolo serve come esperto di materia manifatturiera per i prodotti assegnati, garantendo la produzione conforme, sicura, efficiente e affidabile secondo i requisiti cGMP, le aspettative normative e gli standard di eccellenza operativa.
L'Ingegnere del Bioprocesso DSP agisce come il Piombo Funzionale per attività legate alla produzione, supporta le operazioni degli impianti, conduce valutazioni dei rischi e miglioramenti dei processi, e fornisce competenze tecniche per progetti di capitale, commissioning, qualificazione e prontezza operativa.

Cosa farai:

• Guidare e supervisionare le campagne di produzione DSP, assicurando l'esecuzione, il monitoraggio, la risoluzione dei problemi e la documentazione sono conformi a cGMP e requisiti normativi.

• Agire come il piombo funzionale di produzione per i prodotti assegnati, coordinare le squadre interfunzionali e mantenere l'esperienza tecnica nei processi, attrezzature e strutture.

• Guidare le attività di gestione dei rischi, tra cui SHE, EM, le valutazioni operative, le pulizie e i rischi di prodotto, supportando le indagini, le deviazioni, i controlli CAPAs e i controlli di cambiamento.

• Mantenere la documentazione GMP come le SOP, le istruzioni di fabbricazione, le valutazioni dei rischi e i record per garantire la conformità e la disponibilità di audit.

• Formare e sostenere il personale manifatturiero, contribuire allo sviluppo della forza lavoro e promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, qualità, eccellenza operativa e miglioramento continuo.

• Rappresentare la produzione in progetti di capitale, fornendo input tecnici per la progettazione di impianti, la selezione di attrezzature, la messa in servizio, la qualificazione e i trasferimenti di tecnologia.

• Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo e servire come rappresentante di produzione durante le verifiche dei clienti, ispezioni e progetti strategici interfunzionali.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Forte competenza nella produzione biofarmaceutica, in particolare nella lavorazione a valle (DSP), con la capacità di risolvere problemi tecnici e legati al processo.

• Solida comprensione dei requisiti cGMP e degli standard normativi applicabili alla produzione farmaceutica.

• Esperienza di gestione dei sistemi di qualità e delle attività di conformità, comprese le valutazioni di rischio, deviazioni, CAPAs, controlli di cambiamento e validazione.

• Prove abilità di problem solving con la capacità di identificare le cause della radice e implementare azioni correttive efficaci.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, consentendo una collaborazione efficace tra funzioni e livelli organizzativi.

• Dimostrata esperienza di leadership del progetto e coordinamento del team in ambienti di produzione complessi e regolamentati.

• Laurea o Master in Biotecnologia, Ingegneria Biochimica, Ingegneria Chimica, Scienze della Vita, o un campo correlato, insieme con esperienza rilevante nella produzione biofarmaceutica, ingegneria dei processi, operazioni tecniche, o ambienti regolamentati cGMP.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

L'ingénieur en bioprocédés DSP est responsable de la planification, de l'exécution, de la surveillance et de la documentation des campagnes de fabrication commerciale et clinique dans la zone de traitement aval (DSP). Ce rôle sert d'expert en matière de fabrication pour les produits assignés, assurant une production conforme, sûre, efficace et fiable selon les exigences des BPFc, les attentes réglementaires et les normes d'excellence opérationnelle.
L'ingénieur en bioprocédés du PSD agit à titre de chef de file fonctionnel pour les activités liées à la fabrication, appuie les opérations d'usine, dirige les évaluations des risques et les améliorations des procédés, et fournit une expertise technique pour les projets d'immobilisations, la mise en service, la qualification et la préparation opérationnelle.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Diriger et superviser les campagnes de fabrication du PSD, en veillant à ce que l'exécution, la surveillance, le dépannage et la documentation soient conformes aux BPFc et aux exigences réglementaires.

• Agir comme chef fonctionnel de fabrication pour les produits assignés, coordonner les équipes interfonctionnelles et maintenir l'expertise technique dans les processus, l'équipement et les installations.

• Diriger les activités de gestion des risques, y compris la SHE, la SM, les évaluations opérationnelles, le nettoyage et les évaluations des risques liés aux produits, tout en appuyant les enquêtes, les écarts, les APC et les contrôles des changements.

• Tenir à jour la documentation sur les BPF, comme les PON, les instructions de fabrication, les évaluations des risques et les dossiers pour assurer la conformité et l'état de préparation à la vérification.

• Former et soutenir le personnel manufacturier, contribuer au développement de la main-d'oeuvre et favoriser une culture de sécurité, de qualité, d'excellence opérationnelle et d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la fabrication dans les projets d'immobilisations, fournir des intrants techniques pour la conception des installations, la sélection des équipements, la mise en service, la qualification et les transferts de technologie.

• Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue et servir de représentant de la fabrication lors des vérifications des clients, des inspections et des projets stratégiques interfonctionnels.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Forte expertise en fabrication biopharmaceutique, en particulier en aval, avec la capacité de résoudre les problèmes techniques et liés aux procédés.

• Connaissance approfondie des exigences des BPFc et des normes réglementaires applicables à la fabrication pharmaceutique.

• Expérience de la gestion des systèmes de qualité et des activités de conformité, y compris les évaluations des risques, les écarts, les APC, les contrôles du changement et la validation.

• Compétences éprouvées en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives efficaces.

• Renforcement des capacités de communication et de gestion des intervenants, permettant une collaboration efficace entre les fonctions et l'organisation.

• Expérience démontrée de leadership de projet et de coordination d'équipe dans des environnements de fabrication complexes et réglementés.

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en biotechnologie, en génie biochimique, en génie chimique, en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe, ainsi qu'une expérience pertinente en fabrication biopharmaceutique, en génie des procédés, en opérations techniques ou en environnements réglementés par le CGPG.

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing Ibex™ Solutions team in Visp and play a key leadership role in advancing innovative biologics manufacturing. As Associate Director, Manufacturing Downstream Processing (DSP), you will lead a high-performing operational team, drive manufacturing excellence, and contribute to the successful delivery of life-changing therapies for our customers and patients worldwide.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• The opportunity to lead a highly skilled, multidisciplinary manufacturing team within a growing biologics manufacturing environment.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace where collaboration and innovation are encouraged.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance and leadership impact.

• Professional development opportunities across a global life sciences organization.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of process engineers, specialists, and manufacturing professionals, fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Take ownership of operational performance within the DSP manufacturing area, ensuring production readiness, execution, and reliable on-time delivery.

• Drive the resolution of manufacturing challenges and complex production issues in close collaboration with MSAT, Production Support, QA, and Upstream Processing teams.

• Provide leadership for risk assessments, workplace inspections, technical change management, and compliance activities within the manufacturing unit.

• Represent the DSP organization during customer interactions, audits, and regulatory inspections, serving as a trusted operational expert.

• Contribute to capital investment projects, including facility design, equipment implementation, startup, and commissioning activities.

• As a member of the Production Leadership Team, champion operational excellence, innovation, employee development, and continuous improvement initiatives across the production organization.

What we are looking for

• Experience leading teams and operations within a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

• Strong expertise in downstream processing and biologics manufacturing, with knowledge of mammalian cell culture processes.

• Demonstrated ability to build, develop, coach, and engage high-performing technical teams.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with experience managing complex manufacturing or production challenges.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions and communicate confidently with customers, leadership teams, and regulatory inspectors.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Strong English communication skills, with German an advantage, combined with a structured mindset, initiative, and a team-oriented approach.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

The Supply Planning Manager is accountable for leading the site's end-to-end supply planning function, ensuring reliable production execution, optimized inventory levels, and full material and capacity readiness for manufacturing operations. The role owns the Master Production Schedule (MPS), supply planning governance, inventory strategy, and planning risk management across short-, medium-, and long-term horizons. The position leads and develops the Supply Planning team while driving alignment between Operations, Quality, MSAT, Procurement, Logistics, Engineering, Finance, and Project Management. The Supply Planning Manager plays a critical role in supporting site performance, supply reliability, growth projects, tech transfers, digital transformation initiatives, and long-term supply chain strategy.

What you will do:

• Own and optimize the site Master Production Schedule (MPS), ensuring alignment of demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and material availability to maintain reliable product supply.

• Lead short-, medium-, and long-term supply planning processes, supporting S&OP/IBP through capacity forecasts, inventory projections, scenario planning, and risk assessments.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Procurement, Logistics, MSAT, Engineering, Finance, and Project Management to resolve constraints and drive execution.

• Manage inventory strategy, capacity planning, supply risk mitigation, and business continuity plans while balancing service levels, operational flexibility, and working capital targets.

• Establish and monitor planning KPIs, maintain planning master data, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance overall supply chain performance.

• Lead, develop, and coach the Supply Planning team, building capabilities in SAP, IBP, MRP/MPS, inventory management, and capacity planning while fostering a high-performance culture.

• Drive digitalization, process optimization, and supply chain transformation initiatives, ensuring compliance with cGMP, quality standards, audit readiness, and a strong safety culture.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

• More than 10 years of progressive supply chain experience within a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.

• Proven people leadership and team management experience, with a strong track record of developing and coaching high-performing teams.

• Business fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.

• Deep expertise in MPS, MRP, RCCP, S&OP, and Integrated Business Planning, enabling effective supply chain planning and business decision-making.

• Strong collaborator and influencer with the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, manage stakeholders, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments.

• Demonstrated experience in supply chain risk management, digital transformation, SAP/IBP systems, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives that drive operational excellence.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Cosa farai:

• Condurre processi di pianificazione di approvvigionamento a breve, medio e lungo termine, supportando S&OP/IBP attraverso previsioni di capacità, proiezioni di inventario, pianificazione degli scenari e valutazioni dei rischi.

• Collaborare interfunzionalmente con operazioni, qualità, appalti, logistica, MSAT, ingegneria, finanza e Project Management per risolvere i vincoli e l'esecuzione dell'unità.

• Gestisci la strategia di inventario, la pianificazione della capacità, la mitigazione del rischio di approvvigionamento e i piani di continuità aziendale mentre bilancia i livelli di servizio, la flessibilità operativa e gli obiettivi dei capitali di lavoro.

• Stabilire e monitorare la pianificazione KPI, mantenere i dati master di pianificazione, e guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare le prestazioni globali della supply chain.

• Guidare, sviluppare e allenare il team di pianificazione della fornitura, capacità di costruzione in SAP, IBP, MRP/MPS, gestione dell'inventario e pianificazione della capacità, promuovendo una cultura ad alte prestazioni.

• Guidare la digitalizzazione, l'ottimizzazione dei processi e le iniziative di trasformazione della supply chain, assicurando il rispetto di cGMP, standard di qualità, la disponibilità di audit e una forte cultura della sicurezza.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Corso di laurea o Master in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business Administration, o una disciplina relativa.

• Più di 10 anni di esperienza progressiva di gestione della supply chain all'interno di un ambiente di produzione regolato da GMP.

• Proventa la leadership e l'esperienza di team management, con un forte record di sviluppo e coaching team di alto livello.

• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

• Profonda competenza in MPS, MRP, RCCP, S&OP e Integrated Business Planning, consentendo una pianificazione efficiente della supply chain e processi decisionali aziendali.

• Forte collaboratore e influencer con la capacità di condurre complesse iniziative interfunzionali, gestire gli stakeholder e navigare in ambiguità in ambienti dinamici.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione del rischio della supply chain, trasformazione digitale, sistemi SAP/IBP, standardizzazione dei processi e iniziative di miglioramento continuo che guidano l'eccellenza operativa.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Der Supply Planning Manager spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Standortleistung, Versorgungszuverlässigkeit, Wachstumsprojekten, Technologietransfers, digitalen Transformationsinitiativen und einer langfristigen Lieferkettenstrategie.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Besitzen und optimieren Sie die Website Master Production Schedule (MPS) und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung von Nachfrage, Angebot, Lagerbestand, Kapazität und Materialverfügbarkeit, um eine zuverlässige Produktversorgung zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Versorgungsplanungsprozesse und unterstützen Sie S&OP/IBP durch Kapazitätsprognosen, Bestandsprognosen, Szenarioplanung und Risikobewertungen.

• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit Operations, Quality, Procurement, Logistics, MSAT, Engineering, Finance und Project Management zusammen, um Einschränkungen zu lösen und die Ausführung voranzutreiben.

• Verwalten Sie die Bestandsstrategie, die Kapazitätsplanung, die Minderung des Versorgungsrisikos und die Business Continuity-Pläne, während Sie die Servicelevel, die operative Flexibilität und die Working Capital-Ziele in Einklang bringen.

• Etablieren und überwachen Sie Planungs-KPIs, pflegen Sie die Planung von Stammdaten und fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Gesamtleistung der Lieferkette.

• Führen, entwickeln und coachen Sie das Supply Planning-Team, bauen Sie Fähigkeiten in SAP, IBP, MRP/MPS, Lagerverwaltung und Kapazitätsplanung auf und fördern Sie gleichzeitig eine Hochleistungskultur.

• Fördern Sie Digitalisierung, Prozessoptimierung und Supply Chain Transformationsinitiativen, um die Einhaltung von cGMP, Qualitätsstandards, Auditbereitschaft und eine starke Sicherheitskultur sicherzustellen.

Was wir suchen:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Mehr als 10 Jahre fortschrittliches Supply Chain Management in einer GMP-regulierten Fertigungsumgebung.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in den Bereichen Personalführung und Teammanagement mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und dem Coaching von leistungsstarken Teams.

• Business fließend Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Tiefe Expertise in MPS, MRP, RCCP, S&OP und Integrated Business Planning, die eine effektive Supply Chain Planung und Geschäftsentscheidung ermöglicht.

• Starker Mitarbeiter und Influencer mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zu leiten, Stakeholder zu verwalten und Mehrdeutigkeiten in dynamischen Umgebungen zu steuern.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in den Bereichen Supply Chain Risk Management, Digitale Transformation, SAP/IBP-Systeme, Prozessstandardisierung und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, die operative Exzellenz fördern.

Le gestionnaire de la planification des approvisionnements est responsable de diriger la fonction de planification des approvisionnements de bout en bout du site, assurant une exécution fiable de la production, des niveaux d'inventaire optimisés et de l'état de préparation du matériel et des capacités pour les opérations de fabrication. Ce rôle est le propriétaire du calendrier directeur de production, de la gouvernance de la planification de l'approvisionnement, de la stratégie d'inventaire et de la gestion des risques de planification à court, à moyen et à long terme. Le poste dirige et développe l'équipe de planification des approvisionnements tout en conduisant l'alignement entre les opérations, la qualité, le MSAT, les achats, la logistique, l'ingénierie, les finances et la gestion de projet. Le gestionnaire de la planification de l'approvisionnement joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien de la performance du site, de la fiabilité de l'approvisionnement, des projets de croissance, des transferts technologiques, des initiatives de transformation numérique et de la stratégie à long terme de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

Ce que vous ferez :

As the technical lead for sterile drug product transfers, you coordinate cross-functional teams and customer interactions to bring new products seamlessly onto the manufacturing line, driving process setup, scale-up, documentation, and implementation activities. You proactively manage timelines, risks, deviations, CAPAs, and change management processes while maintaining the highest GMP, quality, regulatory, and safety standards. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:
●      An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
●      An inclusive and ethical workplace.
●      Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.

• Act as the central point of contact for customers and cross-functional stakeholders, coordinating activities, timelines, risks, and milestones throughout the project lifecycle.

• Drive process setup, scale-up, and implementation activities for aseptic manufacturing, ensuring successful product launch and operational readiness.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, including master batch records, transfer packages, and process implementation documents, while ensuring data integrity and GMP compliance.

• Oversee deviation management, CAPAs, and change controls, supporting inspections, audits, and regulatory activities while maintaining the highest quality, safety, and compliance standards.
