Als CQV Ingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du für die Qualifizierung und Validierung von verfahrenstechnischem Equipment und Einrichtungen verantwortlich. Du trägst massgebend zur laufenden Optimierung von Prozessen, Anlagen und internen Abläufen bei. Du bist für die Sicherstellung des nötigen fachtechnischen Wissensstands des Anlagepersonals sowie der Engineering-Gruppen mitverantwortlich.

Deine Karriere bei Lonza in Visp

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwartest Du zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest Du auch unter: Benefits - Visp

Deine Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Erstqualifizierungen sowie Requalifizierungen von Anlagen, Systemen und technischem Equipment über den gesamten Lebenszyklus

• Bewertung technischer Änderungen hinsichtlich Qualifizierungsbedarf und Sicherstellung des qualifizierten Zustands bestehender Anlagen und Systeme

• Erstellung, Bearbeitung und Koordination von Technical Change Requests (TCRs) sowie Unterstützung bei Abweichungen, Untersuchungen und CAPA-Maßnahmen

• Erstellung, Prüfung und Pflege von CQV-, Engineering- und GMP-relevanten Dokumentationen unter Einhaltung geltender GxP-Anforderungen

• Funktion als Subject Matter Expert (SME) für CQV-Themen und Beratung von Engineering, Betrieb, Qualitätssicherung und Projektteams

• Unterstützung und Vertretung des Fachbereichs bei internen und externen Audits, Inspektionen sowie Kundenbesuchen

• Durchführung periodischer Reviews, Begleitung von Decommissioning-Aktivitäten und Sicherstellung der kontinuierlichen Compliance-Anforderungen im Anlagenbetrieb

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (ETH, FH, HF) ODER vergleichbare Berufserfahrung

• Gute Berufserfahrung im regulierten Umfeld bezüglich Inbetriebnahme, Qualifizierung und Validierung z.B. Kühl- und Gefrierschränke, Reinmedienräume, sowie verfahrenstechnischem Equipment - ein Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office werden vorausgesetzt, Kenntnisse in COMOS (Plant Engineering Softwarelösung), DMS, TrackWise und SAP sind von Vorteil

• Deutsch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift) und Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten mit gutem Kommunikationsstil, ausserdem strukturiertes, fokussiertes und gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

​
Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Au besoin, les candidats admissibles et leur famille seront aidés à déménager.

En tant qu'ingénieur du CQV (h/f/d), vous êtes responsable de la qualification et de la validation des équipements et installations du procédé. Vous contribuez de manière significative à l'optimisation continue des processus, des usines et des processus internes. Vous êtes conjointement responsable d'assurer les connaissances techniques nécessaires du personnel d'investissement et des groupes d'ingénierie.

Votre carrière à Lonza à Viège

Ce que nous vous offrons:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

• Attendez-vous à un salaire concurrentiel Vous avez de nombreux avantages dans les domaines du style de vie, de la famille et des loisirs. Retrouvez la liste complète de nos services mondiaux Vous aussi sous: Avantages - Visp

Vos tâches:

• Responsabilité de la planification, de la coordination et de la mise en œuvre des qualifications initiales ainsi que de la requalification des installations, systèmes et équipements techniques pendant tout le cycle de vie

• Évaluation de l'évolution technique des besoins de qualification et garantie de la qualification des installations et systèmes existants

• Création, traitement et coordination des demandes de changement technique (TCR) ainsi que soutien aux écarts, enquêtes et mesures de l'ACAP

• Préparation, mise à l'essai et tenue à jour de la documentation relative au CQV, à l'ingénierie et aux BPF conformément aux exigences applicables du GxP

• Fonction d'expert en matière (SME) pour les sujets du CQV et de consultant pour les équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, d'assurance de la qualité et de projet

• Appui et représentation du Ministère dans les audits internes et externes, les inspections et les visites des clients

• Effectuer des examens périodiques, appuyer les activités de déclassement et veiller à ce que les exigences en matière de conformité dans l'exploitation des installations soient respectées en permanence

Votre profil d'exigence:

• Formation terminée (ETH, FH, HF) OU expérience professionnelle comparable

• Bonne expérience professionnelle dans l'environnement réglementé en ce qui concerne la mise en service, la qualification et la validation, p. ex. réfrigérateurs et congélateurs, salles de communication propres, ainsi que l'équipement de traitement - un avantage

• Une bonne connaissance de Microsoft Office est nécessaire, la connaissance de COMOS (solution logicielle Plant Engineering), DMS, TrackWise et SAP sont avantageuses

• Anglais (négociable)

• Travail indépendant et flexible avec un bon style de communication, aussi structuré, ciblé et bien organisé

​
À propos de Lonza:

À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales: collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est exactement ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire nos clients en thérapies viables, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.title: MES Technical Lead (m/f/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
Location. Visp, Switzerland.

Lonza is a global leader in the life sciences industry, operating across three continents. While we are a science-driven organization, there is no single formula for how we work. Our most important scientific solution is our people, talented individuals who collaborate, share ideas, and help businesses help people.
In return, our employees are empowered to shape their own careers. Their ideas, big and small, make a meaningful difference and contribute to improving the world. This is the kind of work we want to be part of.

As MES Technical Lead, you are responsible for the daily tasks in the production. You and MES team are reporting to Team Lead Documentation who is responsible for the personnel management and development. You are involved in regular exchange meetings with other team leaders/stakeholders in order to optimize efficiency together. You are responsible for training and coaching MES team members, support Team Lead Documentation conducting performance reviews and actively supporting their further development.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Setting priorities and allocating resources to meet deadlines

• Communicating with stakeholders

• Participating in improvement projects

• Ensuring safety and GMP compliance

• Recognizing, interpreting and eliminating deviations

• Participating in audits and visits

• Providing frontline MES technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing teams, QA and plant engineers

• Performs training activities of MES and supports others and new joiners.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor / Master Degree

• Preferred area of study:   Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacy or equivalent scientific degree

• Experience in MES recipe authoring, preferably in Emerson Syncade

• Knowledge of DeltaV is preferable

• Knowledge in the area of sterile Drug Product is an asset

• Coordination of resources and workflows Past experience as a lead for a technical team is an asset.

• High motivation and dynamic drive; solution-oriented

• Structured, focused and organized way of working, assertive and motivated, working independently, flexible and resilient

• High attitude for Safety, Quality, Solution focus and Cooperation

• Fluency in both English and German (written and oral) would be an advantage

• Prepared to work flexible working hours

• Good communication skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization and on the shopfloor

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione. Visp, Svizzera.

Lonza è leader globale nel settore delle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Mentre siamo un'organizzazione scientifica, non c'è nessuna formula per come lavoriamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è la nostra gente, individui di talento che collaborano, condividono idee e aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone.
In cambio, i nostri dipendenti sono autorizzati a plasmare la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, fanno una differenza significativa e contribuiscono a migliorare il mondo. Questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Come MES Technical Lead, sei responsabile dei compiti quotidiani nella produzione. Voi e il team MES state segnalando al Team Lead Documentation che è responsabile della gestione e dello sviluppo del personale. Siete coinvolti in riunioni di scambio regolari con altri leader/stakeholder del team al fine di ottimizzare l'efficienza insieme. Sei responsabile della formazione e dell'addestramento dei membri del team MES, supporta il Team Lead Documentation che conduce recensioni sulle prestazioni e supporta attivamente il loro ulteriore sviluppo.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Cosa farai:

• Impostare priorità e assegnare risorse per rispettare le scadenze

• Comunicare con le parti interessate

• Partecipazione a progetti di miglioramento

• Garantire sicurezza e conformità GMP

• Riconoscere, interpretare ed eliminare deviazioni

• Partecipazione a audit e visite

• Fornire assistenza tecnica e procedurale MES, lavorando con i team di produzione, QA e gli ingegneri degli impianti

• Esegui le attività di formazione di MES e supporta altri e nuovi iscritti.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea / Master

• Area di studio preferita: Tecnologia farmaceutica, Chimica, Farmacia o grado scientifico equivalente

• Esperienza nella ricetta MES, preferibilmente in Emerson Syncade

• La conoscenza di DeltaV è preferibile

• La conoscenza nell'area della droga sterile è un bene

• Il coordinamento delle risorse e dei flussi di lavoro L'esperienza passata come vantaggio per un team tecnico è una risorsa.

• Alta motivazione e unità dinamica; orientata alla soluzione

• Strutturato, focalizzato e organizzato modo di lavorare, assertivo e motivato, lavorare in modo indipendente, flessibile e resiliente

• Alta attitudine per sicurezza, qualità, messa a fuoco e cooperazione delle soluzioni

• La fluidità sia in inglese che in tedesco (scritto e orale) sarebbe un vantaggio

• Preparati a lavorare ore di lavoro flessibili

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e interazione con una varietà di interfacce all'interno dell'organizzazione e sul piano del negozio

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

jobs.title: Teamlead Downstream Processing
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Lead the planning, execution, and documentation of DSP manufacturing campaigns, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient delivery of production objectives.

• Provide technical expertise for DSP operations, including chromatography, filtration, UF/DF, bulk filling, process monitoring, technology transfers, validation, and lifecycle management activities.

• Drive operational excellence by leading investigations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process robustness and manufacturing performance.

• Act as the DSP manufacturing subject matter expert during customer audits, regulatory inspections, customer visits, capital projects, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.

• Ensure all manufacturing activities are executed in accordance with cGMP requirements, approved procedures, and established SHE, environmental monitoring, and quality standards.

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Bioprocess Engineers by setting objectives, managing performance, supporting talent development, and serving as the primary escalation point for technical and personnel matters.

• Partner with DSP leadership and Shift Team Leads to optimize resource allocation, capacity planning, manufacturing support, and strategic initiatives while ensuring alignment between engineering and operations teams.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in biotechnology, preferably DSP operations

• Strong technical expertise in downstream processing technologies, including chromatography, filtration, UF/DF, viral clearance processes, and GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

Du rüstest unsere Anlagen um, behebst kleinere Störungen und hältst so die Produktion zuverlässig am Laufen. In der GMP‑gerechten Abfüllung (Fill‑&‑Finish) arbeitest du im Reinraum und im 2‑Schichtmodell. Dich erwartet ein eingespieltes, wertschätzendes Team, in dem Zusammenarbeit wirklich zählt. Lerne unsere Manufacturing Operations kennen - Your Career in Manufacturing Operations at Lonza!

Was auf dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:

• Benefits in Stein: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du meisterst alle Arbeiten im Isolator – inklusive qualifizierter Eingriffe, Filtertests sowie Be‑ und Entladen des Gefriertrockners.

• Du rüstest Abfüll‑ und Produktionsanlagen auf und ab, bereitest Räume & Equipment vor und übernimmst Reinigungs‑ und GMP‑gerechte Dokumentationstätigkeiten.

• Du führst mechanische und technische Aufgaben im Reinraum durch, installierst und de-installierst Equipment und übernimmst technische Verantwortung für Anlagen.

• Du überwachst Produktionsprozesse, führst IPCs und mikrobiologisches Monitoring durch und erkennst Abweichungen sofort.

• Du unterstützt bei Fehleranalysen, löst komplexe Fragestellungen und agierst als Spezialist*in sowie Ansprechperson an der Abfülllinie.

• Du gestaltest den Bereich aktiv mit, bildest neue Mitarbeitende aus, organisierst vorbeugende Instandhaltung und förderst kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserungen.

Was wir suchen:

• Mechanische Grundausbildung, z. B. als KFZ‑Mechanikerin, Anlagenmechanikerin oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Beruf.

• Erste Berufserfahrung als Linienmechaniker*in oder in einer ähnlichen technischen Funktion ist wünschenswert.

• Erfahrung im Reinraum sowie Arbeiten nach GMP‑Standards sind ein grosses Plus.

• Erfahrung in der Pharmaproduktion, idealerweise an Fill‑&‑Finish‑Anlagen, ist von Vorteil.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2‑Schichtmodell, sowie Bereitschaft im Reinraum zu arbeiten.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?

Soutien à la réinstallation : Disponible pour les candidats admissibles et leurs familles.

Voulez-vous utiliser vos compétences techniques dans un environnement de production pharmaceutique de pointe? Sur notre site à Stein AG, vous veillez à ce que nos systèmes stériles de remplissage et de séchage sur gel fonctionnent de manière fiable et à ce que les normes de qualité et de BPF les plus élevées soient respectées. Si vous souhaitez assumer vos responsabilités, apprécier les défis techniques et travailler dans un changement dynamique, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.

Ce qui vous attend :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages pour le mode de vie, la famille et les loisirs. Retrouvez notre liste complète des prestations locales Vous ci-dessous:

• Avantages en pierre: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5?lz=2

Vos tâches

• Vous fournissez des équipements techniques dans le domaine du remplissage stérile et du séchage au gel selon les directives des BPF, y compris les conversions, les changements de format et les essais.

• Vous effectuerez l'entretien et le dépannage mécanique sur des installations de production complexes.

• Vous identifiez le potentiel d'optimisation et soutenez l'amélioration continue des usines, des processus et des processus.

• Vous travaillez dans des zones propres conformément aux règles applicables en matière de BPF, de sécurité, d'hygiène et d'environnement.

• Vous documentez tous les travaux réalisés avec soin et compréhension dans les journaux de bord ainsi que dans SAP.

• Vous supportez la production par la mise en place et le démontage d'équipements pour les processus de fabrication et les remplissages de médias.

• Vous surveillez les processus de production en cours et effectuez des interventions correctives si nécessaire.

Votre profil

• Formation mécanique complète ou formation professionnelle technique équivalente.

• Bonne compréhension technique et intérêt pour les installations de production complexes, idéalement dans l'environnement réglementé par les BPF.

• Première expérience professionnelle dans les technologies d'usine, d'exploitation ou de production, de préférence dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• Personnalité de communication forte avec plaisir dans le travail avec différents domaines spécialisés.

• Bonne connaissance du MS Office et expérience de la documentation technique.

• Préparation pour le travail posté, pikettdienst et les affectations occasionnelles du samedi.

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture, idéalement connaissance de base de l'anglais.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire nos clients en thérapies viables, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à bord.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower or Visp in Switzerland.

Reporting to the Value Stream Lead, the Process Delivery Lead acts as the IT business partner to Engineering. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities to drive efficiencies and automation. The roles is also responsible for the delivery, operation, support, and continuous improvement of IT services, applications, and solutions in Engineering.

As the Primary IT business partner the Lonza engineering department, the role is responsible for aligning technology capabilities with business priorities, driving operational excellence, managing demand, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects, enhancements, and service improvements.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Ability to impact Lonza core business

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

Basel: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/5c78e3b906804b0cb6710009ab5507de?updated

What you will do:

• Act as the primary technology partner for the Engineering organization, aligning business priorities with digital and IT solutions.

• Lead the delivery, support, and continuous improvement of Engineering applications and services across the enterprise.

• Drive operational excellence by ensuring reliable, high-performing, and user-focused technology services.

• Identify and implement opportunities leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance engineering processes and productivity.

• Develop and execute the Engineering technology roadmap in collaboration with business stakeholders and Global Process Owners.

• Manage project portfolios, system enhancements, and application lifecycle activities to deliver business value.

• Foster innovation and collaboration while ensuring compliance with quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

• Proven experience in IT business partnering, service delivery, application management, or digital transformation within a global environment.

• Strong understanding of AI, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging digital technologies.

• Experience managing complex projects, portfolios, and operational services across multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships and effectively influence senior business and technical leaders.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English; experience in a regulated environment is considered an advantage.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. • Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Formazione dell'equipaggio di impianti e del personale di officina sulla conoscenza del processo e dell'impianto, sicurezza, igiene, ambiente e qualità (cGMP)

Il tuo profilo:

• Apprendistato tecnico completo (probabilmente con ulteriore formazione come specialista di manutenzione / tecnico HF)

• Conoscenza di GMP, COMOS, SAP

• Lavoro indipendente e flessibile, lavoro di squadra forte

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione

• Comportamento di lavoro strutturato, focalizzato e molto ben organizzato

• Affidabile e resiliente; orientata alla soluzione e aperta a nuove idee; Agile, proattivo e altamente motivato

• Tedesco fluido e buone competenze in inglese

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo che tu condivida.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

For our location in Visp we are looking for you as an investment technician 80-100% (m/f/d). In this role, you are jointly responsible for ensuring the availability of the allocated plant(s) or sub-plant(s) taking into account cost-optimal operational engineering. You support the professional and economical implementation of maintenance and contribute significantly to the continuous optimization of processes, plants and internal processes. In addition, you help to ensure and further develop the technical knowledge of the operator.

This is what we offer you:

• An agile career and dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. All global services can be found here: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Ensure a professional and economical implementation of the maintenance with at the same time sufficient plant availability, including dealing with the authorities (e.g. SVTI, etc.)

• Preparation and coordination of maintenance work with workshops

• Search for opportunities for improvement in the processes, facilities and processes, as well as in the knowledge of the staff

• Maintaining safety, hygiene, environment, quality (cGMP) in relation to technical facilities

• Use of the possibilities offered in SAP for placing orders and the provided technical-commercial evaluations as well as capacity planning to optimize plant and personnel use

• Cooperation in monitoring and complying with the available budget (maintenance, conversions and investments)

• Ensuring, updating and checking the ongoing plant documentation, e.g. by seamless recording and maintenance of the data, GMP fair change management using the systems provided or by continuous updating of the flow pictures, zone plans and installation plans

• Training of plant crew and workshop staff on process and plant knowledge, safety, hygiene, environment and quality (cGMP)

Your profile:

• Completed technical apprenticeship (ideally with further training as a maintenance specialist / technician HF)

• Knowledge of GMP, COMOS, SAP

• Independent and flexible working, strong teamwork

• Very good communication skills

• Structured, focused and very well organized work behavior

• Reliable and resilient; solution-oriented and open to new ideas; Agile, proactive and highly motivated

• Fluent German and good English skills

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

To strengthen our logistics team, we are looking for a committed and reliable personality as an employee Logistics, CoE Pharma Shipments - Samples 80-100% in Visp. In this role, you are responsible for the timely handling of shipping orders for samples, including coordination and organization of incoming and outgoing shipments between Quality Assurance (QA) and our customers worldwide.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Coordination of logistical tasks between logistics and internal and external clients

• Responsible for the receipt of shipping orders and their timely and correct preparation, handling as well as the organization of physical shipping (labeling / final packaging / documentation)

• Present our standard processes at kickoff meetings with our customers and PMs

• Successful participation in the regulatoryly prescribed “CBTA IATA” courses

• Ongoing review of internal shipping processes including the correct implementation of internal and cross-divisional optimization options

Your requirement profile:

• You have a completed commercial, logistical (preferably logistics specialist) or CPT vocational training with eidg. Certificate of ability and ideally already have 2-3 years of professional experience in a pharmaceutical company

• You have practical experience with SAP EWM / WM / MM

• You are flexible, communicative, resilient and reliable

• Good knowledge of German in word and writing is required; Knowledge of English is an advantage.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

jobs.title: Team Lead Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Start your career with Lonza today by applying for the position of Team Lead Operations. Due to the special interface function between management and production, this position is fundamentally important for the long-term success of Lonza. There are also regular exchange meetings with other team leaders in order to optimize efficiency together. You are responsible for training and coaching your employees, conducting performance reviews and actively supporting their further development.

Your main tasks:

• Leading, assessing, coaching and developing employees by creating and implementing training plans

• Setting priorities and allocating resources to meet deadlines

• Recognizing and correcting deviations and participating in investigations as well as improvement projects

• Assuring security, GMP compliance amongst others

• Comparing cross-company process steps (relationships, dependencies, processes)

• Managing shift handovers, inspections as well as creating, maintaining and updating instruction manuals

Your qualifications:

• Several years of professional experience as a shift team leader, deputy or system specialist in organic production

• Comprehensive knowledge of production processes and interrelationships in a large production area with detailed knowledge of all process steps and systems

• Experienced in installing and handling manufacturing plants as well as in coordinating resources and work processes

• Comprehensive knowledge of process engineering

• Fluency in English (written and oral), German would be an advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Inizia la tua carriera con Lonza oggi applicando la posizione di Team Lead Operations. A causa della speciale funzione di interfaccia tra gestione e produzione, questa posizione è fondamentalmente importante per il successo a lungo termine di Lonza. Ci sono anche incontri di scambio regolari con altri leader del team al fine di ottimizzare l'efficienza insieme. Sei responsabile della formazione e della formazione dei tuoi dipendenti, della conduzione delle recensioni sulle prestazioni e del supporto attivo al loro ulteriore sviluppo.

I vostri compiti principali:

• Leader, valutazione, coaching e sviluppo dei dipendenti creando e implementando piani di formazione

• Impostare le priorità e assegnare risorse per rispettare le scadenze

• Riconoscere e correggere deviazioni e partecipare a indagini e progetti di miglioramento

• Garantire la sicurezza, conformità GMP tra gli altri

• Paragonare i passi di processo tra le società (relazioni, dipendenze, processi)

• Gestione delle consegne a turni, delle ispezioni e creazione, mantenimento e aggiornamento dei manuali di istruzioni

Le tue qualifiche:

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come leader del team di turni, vice o specialista del sistema nella produzione organica

• Conoscenza completa dei processi produttivi e delle interrelazioni in un'ampia area di produzione con conoscenza dettagliata di tutti i processi e sistemi

• Esperienza nell'installazione e nella gestione degli impianti produttivi e nel coordinamento delle risorse e dei processi di lavoro

• Conoscenza completa dell'ingegneria dei processi

• Fluency in inglese (scritto e orale), tedesco sarebbe un vantaggio

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Beginnen Sie noch heute Ihre Karriere bei Lonza, indem Sie sich für die Position des Team Lead Operations bewerben. Aufgrund der besonderen Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Management und Produktion ist diese Position grundlegend wichtig für den langfristigen Erfolg von Lonza. Zudem finden regelmäßige Austauschgespräche mit anderen Teamleitern statt, um gemeinsam die Effizienz zu optimieren. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, Ihre Mitarbeiter zu schulen und zu coachen, Leistungsüberprüfungen durchzuführen und deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv zu unterstützen.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

• Leitung, Bewertung, Coaching und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitern durch Erstellung und Umsetzung von Schulungsplänen

• Festlegung von Prioritäten und Zuweisung von Ressourcen zur Einhaltung von Fristen

• Erkennung und Korrektur von Abweichungen und Teilnahme an Untersuchungen sowie Verbesserungsprojekten

• Sicherheit, GMP-Compliance u.a.

• Vergleich unternehmensübergreifender Prozessschritte (Beziehungen, Abhängigkeiten, Prozesse)

• Verwaltung von Schichtübergaben, Inspektionen sowie Erstellung, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Bedienungsanleitungen

Ihre Qualifikationen:

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Schichtteamleiter, Stellvertreter oder Systemspezialist in der Bioproduktion

• Umfassende Kenntnisse der Produktionsprozesse und Zusammenhänge in einem großen Produktionsbereich mit detaillierter Kenntnis aller Prozessschritte und Systeme

• Erfahrung in der Installation und Handhabung von Produktionsanlagen sowie in der Koordination von Ressourcen und Arbeitsprozessen

• Umfassende Kenntnisse der Verfahrenstechnik

• fließend Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch wäre von Vorteil

Jeden Tag haben die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Die Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um sich der Herausforderung und Kreativität zu stellen, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Commencez votre carrière avec Lonza aujourd'hui en postulant au poste de chef d'équipe Opérations. En raison de la fonction d'interface spéciale entre la gestion et la production, cette position est fondamentalement importante pour le succès à long terme de Lonza. Des échanges réguliers sont également organisés avec d'autres chefs d'équipe afin d'optimiser l'efficacité. Vous êtes responsable de la formation et de l'encadrement de vos employés, de la conduite d'examens du rendement et du soutien actif à leur perfectionnement.

Vos principales tâches:

• Diriger, évaluer, encadrer et former les employés en créant et en mettant en oeuvre des plans de formation

• Établissement des priorités et allocation des ressources pour respecter les délais

• Reconnaître et corriger les écarts et participer aux enquêtes ainsi qu'aux projets d'amélioration

• Assurer la sécurité, la conformité aux BPF, entre autres

• Comparaison des étapes de processus interentreprises (relations, dépendances, processus)

• Gérer les transferts de postes, les inspections ainsi que créer, tenir à jour et mettre à jour les manuels d'instruction

Vos qualifications:

• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que chef d'équipe, adjoint ou spécialiste du système en production biologique

• Connaissance approfondie des processus de production et des relations dans un vaste secteur de production, avec une connaissance détaillée de toutes les étapes et de tous les systèmes des procédés

• Expérience de l'installation et de la manutention des usines de fabrication ainsi que de la coordination des ressources et des processus de travail

• Connaissance approfondie de l'ingénierie des procédés

• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et oral), l'allemand serait un avantage

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

jobs.title: Team Lead / Operations
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
As we build our new biotechnological production plant in Visp, we’re looking for a motivated and resilient Team Lead Operations to help lead our vaccine production efforts. If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and make a real difference, we invite you to join our team.

As a Team Lead, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the success of our production efforts by leading and supporting your team through both the project phase and routine production!

What you’ll do:

• Team Leadership & Development: Lead, assess, and coach a diverse team, providing the guidance they need to thrive. You’ll support employee growth through performance reviews, regular feedback, and development plans.

• Production Oversight: Manage daily operations within a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll set priorities, allocate resources, and work collaboratively to ensure that production targets and quality standards are met.

• Problem Solving & Process Improvement: Investigate production deviations and contribute to continuous improvement projects. You’ll be responsible for recognizing and correcting issues, ensuring compliance with safety and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other team leaders and departments to optimize efficiency, streamline processes, and share best practices. Your role as a key interface between management and production will drive long-term success.

• Administrative Excellence: Oversee shift handovers, manage inspections, and ensure that training plans are created and implemented on time.

What we’re looking for:

• Several years of experience in a leadership role within biotechnological production, such as a shift team leader, deputy, or system specialist.

• A deep understanding of production processes in a large-scale environment, with expertise in all process steps and systems.

• Experience with manufacturing plants and coordinating complex work processes and resources.

• Strong knowledge of process engineering principles and practices.

• Fluency in English, with German language skills being a plus.

• A structured, organized approach to work, with the ability to be assertive, flexible, and resilient in a fast-moving environment.

• Willingness to work in a 4-shift system.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.
Mentre costruiamo il nostro nuovo impianto di produzione biotecnologica a Visp, stiamo cercando un Team Lead Operations motivato e resiliente per aiutare a condurre i nostri sforzi di produzione del vaccino. Se siete pronti a fare il passo successivo nella vostra carriera e fare una vera differenza, vi invitiamo a unirsi alla nostra squadra.

In qualità di Team Lead, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il successo dei nostri sforzi di produzione guidando e supportando il vostro team attraverso la fase di progetto e la produzione di routine!

Cosa farai:

• Team Leadership & Development: guidare, valutare e allenare un team diverso, fornendo la guida di cui hanno bisogno per prosperare. Sosterrai la crescita dei dipendenti attraverso recensioni sulle prestazioni, feedback regolari e piani di sviluppo.

• Oversight di produzione: gestire le operazioni quotidiane in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. Impostare le priorità, assegnare le risorse e lavorare in collaborazione per garantire che gli obiettivi di produzione e gli standard di qualità siano soddisfatti.

• Problem Solving & Process Improvement: Investigare deviazioni di produzione e contribuire a progetti di miglioramento continuo. Sarete responsabili di riconoscere e correggere i problemi, garantendo il rispetto della sicurezza e buone pratiche di produzione (GMP).

• Collaborazione interfunzionale: lavorare a stretto contatto con altri leader e dipartimenti del team per ottimizzare l'efficienza, semplificare i processi e condividere le migliori pratiche. Il vostro ruolo di interfaccia chiave tra gestione e produzione guiderà il successo a lungo termine.

• Eccellenza amministrativa: supervisionare le consegne a turni, gestire le ispezioni e garantire che i piani di formazione siano creati e attuati in tempo.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Diversi anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership all'interno della produzione biotecnologica, come un leader del team di turni, vice, o specialista di sistema.

• Una profonda comprensione dei processi produttivi in un ambiente su larga scala, con competenze in tutti i processi e sistemi.

• Esperienza con impianti di produzione e coordinamento di complessi processi di lavoro e risorse.

• Forte conoscenza dei principi e delle pratiche di ingegneria dei processi.

• Fluency in inglese, con competenze di lingua tedesca essere un plus.

• Un approccio strutturato e organizzato al lavoro, con la capacità di essere assertivo, flessibile e resiliente in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

• Volontà di lavorare in un sistema a 4 turni.

jobs.title: Process Chemist 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Shape the Future of API Process Development

We are looking for a motivated Process Chemist to join our Process Development Team for Small Molecules within the Advanced Synthesis Platform. In this role, you will play a key part in developing and implementing manufacturing processes for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), including highly potent APIs (HPAPIs). If you are passionate about cutting-edge process development and want to contribute to life-changing medicines, we would love to hear from you.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: Visp

What You'll Do

• Develop, optimize, and scale chemical manufacturing processes for small-molecule APIs and HPAPIs from early clinical development through Process Validation

• Plan, supervise, and evaluate laboratory experiments, ensuring high scientific standards, reliable data generation, and accurate interpretation of results

• Prepare technical reports, presentations, and development documentation to communicate process understanding, results, and recommendations

• Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing facilities and provide technical support as a process expert during production campaigns

• Identify process risks, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and implement robust, scalable, and compliant solutions

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional project teams and external customers to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables

• Lead, coach, and develop laboratory professionals while driving innovation and continuous improvement within the area of expertise

What We're Looking For

• Ph.D. in Chemistry

• Industrial experience in chemical process development; experience transferring processes to GMP manufacturing is highly preferred

• Knowledge of GMP requirements and experience working in a regulated environment is advantageous

• Strong scientific mindset with the ability to analyze, understand, optimize, and improve chemical processes

• Independent, structured, and reliable working style combined with excellent collaboration and communication skills

• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken; German language skills or a willingness to learn German are required

• Previous experience leading or mentoring scientific professionals in an industrial environment is considered an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Forma il futuro dello sviluppo del processo API

Stiamo cercando un chimico di processo motivato per unirsi al nostro team di sviluppo dei processi per piccole molecole all'interno della piattaforma di sintesi avanzata. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà una parte fondamentale nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione dei processi produttivi per gli ingredienti farmaceutici attivi (API), tra cui API altamente potenti (HPAPI). Se siete appassionati di sviluppo di processo all'avanguardia e volete contribuire a farmaci che cambiano la vita, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Che cosa si otterrà

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi globali può essere trovato qui: Visp

Cosa farai

• Sviluppare, ottimizzare e scalare i processi di produzione chimica per le API di piccole molecole e HPAPI dal primo sviluppo clinico attraverso la convalida dei processi

• Pianificare, supervisionare e valutare gli esperimenti di laboratorio, garantire elevati standard scientifici, la generazione di dati affidabile e l'interpretazione accurata dei risultati

• Preparare relazioni tecniche, presentazioni e documentazione di sviluppo per comunicare comprensione, risultati e raccomandazioni del processo

• Trasferire i processi alle strutture di produzione GMP e fornire supporto tecnico come esperto di processo durante le campagne di produzione

• Identificare i rischi di processo, risolvere complesse sfide tecniche e implementare soluzioni robuste, scalabili e conformi

• Collabora a stretto contatto con team di progetto interfunzionali e clienti esterni per garantire l'allineamento su obiettivi di progetto, tempi e consegnabili

• Leader, coach e sviluppare professionisti di laboratorio mentre guidano l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo nell'ambito delle competenze

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Ph.D. in Chimica

• L'esperienza industriale nello sviluppo di processi chimici; i processi di trasferimento di esperienze nella produzione di GMP sono molto preferiti

• La conoscenza dei requisiti e dell'esperienza GMP che lavorano in un ambiente regolamentato è vantaggiosa

• Forte mentalità scientifica con la capacità di analizzare, comprendere, ottimizzare e migliorare i processi chimici

• Stile di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e affidabile combinato con eccellenti capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione

• Competenze fluenti dell'inglese, sia scritte che parlate; competenze linguistiche tedesche o la volontà di imparare il tedesco sono necessarie

• Esperienza precedente leader o mentoring professionisti scientifici in un ambiente industriale è considerato un vantaggio

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?
Applichi subito.

What you will get

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What You'll Do

• Develop, optimize, and scale chemical manufacturing processes for small-molecule APIs and HPAPIs from early clinical development through Process Validation

• Plan, supervise, and evaluate laboratory experiments, ensuring high scientific standards, reliable data generation, and accurate interpretation of results

• Prepare technical reports, presentations, and development documentation to communicate process understanding, results, and recommendations

• Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing facilities and provide technical support as a process expert during production campaigns

• Identify process risks, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and implement robust, scalable, and compliant solutions

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional project teams and external customers to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables

• Lead, coach, and develop laboratory professionals while driving innovation and continuous improvement within the area of expertise

What We're Looking For

• Ph.D. in Chemistry

• Industrial experience in chemical process development; experience transferring processes to GMP manufacturing is highly preferred

• Knowledge of GMP requirements and experience working in a regulated environment is advantageous

• Strong scientific mindset with the ability to analyze, understand, optimize, and improve chemical processes

• Independent, structured, and reliable working style combined with excellent collaboration and communication skills

• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken; German language skills or a willingness to learn German are required

• Previous experience leading or mentoring scientific professionals in an industrial environment is considered an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

The MSAT Process Specialist of DSP at Lonza AG will play a key role in supporting the successful transfer, scale-up, validation activities, continuous improvement of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes. This individual will provide technical expertise and hands-on support to ensure robust and efficient production.

What you will do:

• Execute and oversee process validation activities in downstream unit operations.

• Support the transfer of new manufacturing processes from R&D to manufacturing, ensuring successful scale-up and validation activities

• Support root cause analysis for process deviations and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Develop and revise process documentation, including process description, validation protocols and reports, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical reports.

• Provide technical support to manufacturing operations for troubleshooting and continuous process improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and R&D.

• Support regulatory submissions.

• Conduct data analysis and trending to monitor process performance and identify areas for improvement.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in process development, MSAT, or manufacturing support within the biopharmaceutical industry.

• Strong understanding of downstream (purification) manufacturing processes.

• Experience with process scale-up, technology transfer, and validation activities.

• Proficiency in data analysis and statistical tools.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong analytical mindset.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Knowledge of cGMP regulations and quality systems.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Il MSAT Process Specialist di DSP di Lonza AG svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel sostenere le attività di trasferimento, scale-up, validazione, miglioramento continuo dei processi di produzione biofarmaceutica. Questo individuo fornirà competenze tecniche e supporto pratico per garantire una produzione robusta ed efficiente.

Cosa farai:

• Eseguire e supervisionare le attività di validazione dei processi nelle operazioni delle unità a valle.

• Sostenere il trasferimento di nuovi processi produttivi dalla R&D alla produzione, garantendo attività di scalabilità e validazione di successo

• Supporta l'analisi della causa principale per deviazioni di processo e implementa azioni correttive e preventive efficaci (CAPA).

• Sviluppare e rivedere la documentazione di processo, tra cui descrizione del processo, protocolli di validazione e report, procedure operative standard (SOP) e relazioni tecniche.

• Fornire supporto tecnico alle operazioni di produzione per la risoluzione dei problemi e le iniziative di miglioramento continuo dei processi.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali tra cui Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering e R&D.

• Supporta le sottomissioni normative.

• Condurre l'analisi dei dati e la tendenza a monitorare le prestazioni del processo e identificare le aree di miglioramento.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria Chimica, Biotecnologia, Biochimica, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Minimo di 3-5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di processo, MSAT, o supporto di produzione all'interno dell'industria biofarmaceutica.

• Forte comprensione dei processi produttivi a valle (purificazione).

• Esperienza con scala di processo, trasferimento tecnologico e attività di validazione.

• Competenza nell'analisi dei dati e negli strumenti statistici.

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving e una forte mentalità analitica.

• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente veloce e orientato al team.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese.

• Conoscenza delle normative cGMP e dei sistemi di qualità.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

In dieser vielseitigen Position arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Head Security zusammen, übernehmen Verantwortung für die operative Security-Organisation und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Sicherheitsstandards und -systeme.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Benefits in Visp: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Führung der operativen Security-Schichtorganisation sowie Sicherstellung eines sicheren, professionellen und effizienten 24/7-Betriebs.

• Stellvertretung des Head Security und Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung der Security-Strategie sowie der Weiterentwicklung der Sicherheitsorganisation.

• Verantwortung für die Einsatz-, Schicht- und Ferienplanung sowie die Aus- und Weiterbildung der Security-Mitarbeitenden.

• Sicherstellung des zuverlässigen Betriebs von Security-Systemen durch Analyse technischer Störungen und Koordination nachhaltiger Lösungen mit internen und externen Partnern.

• Unterstützung bei der Einführung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Security-Systemen, Prozessen, Betriebs-, Wartungs- und Notfallkonzepten.

• Koordination der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Sicherheitsdienstleistern sowie Unterstützung bei Audits, Inspektionen und Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Förderung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung von Security-Prozessen sowie aktive operative Unterstützung des Teams in Ausnahme- und Personalausfallsituationen.

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Security Management, Polizei, Militär, Risikomanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer Sicherheitsfunktion, idealerweise in einem industriellen, pharmazeutischen oder regulierten Umfeld.

• Führungserfahrung in einem operativen Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der Koordination von Teams und externen Dienstleistern.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen physische Sicherheit, Sicherheitsmanagement, Risikomanagement und Compliance.

• Technisches Verständnis sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Sicherheits- und Überwachungssystemen.

• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Entscheidungs- und Umsetzungsstärke.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. jobs.title: Process Expert MSAT, Ibex
jobs.description:
USP Process Expert MSAT (m/f/d)
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As a USP member of the MSAT (Manufacturing Science & Technology) organization in Visp, you are responsible for the successful transfer, scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian cell culture processes. As an experienced professional, you are regarded as an expert in process science and manufacturing aspects. In this role, you significantly contribute to the development of the MSAT toolbox and share the manufacturing responsibility as a long-term process owner.

Key Responsibilities

• Leading cross-functional teams as a process expert tasked with technology transfers (process design and scaling-up) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole product lifecycle of assigned projects from planning over coordination, implementation, control and project completion aligned with project management goals.

• Act as the interface between the process donor (external customer, process development) and operations. Responsible to ensure process scalability and manufacturability.

• Securing success during technology transfer by applying formal processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control

• Responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory requirements. This includes 24/7 on-call duty.

• Responsible for execution of GMP risk analysis for the manufacturing processes.

• Interacting directly with customers during tech transfer, campaign preparation, execution and closure including daily reporting of batch status and performance.

• Ensuring timely compilation of process related deviations, change requests and campaign reports as well as responsible for continuous improvement of process performance.

Key Requirements

•
• PhD (preferred), Master’s or Bachelor degree in biotechnology, chemical engineering or related disciplines

• A minimum of five years of industry experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing or process development, with a strong preference for expertise in mammalian cell based processes.

• Understanding of GMP and bioprocess technology

• Very good communication skills and interaction with all kinds of interfaces within customers and the project organization

• Fluency in English

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
esperto di processo MSAT (m/f/d)
Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Come membro USP dell'organizzazione MSAT (Manufacturing Science & Technology) di Visp, sei responsabile del trasferimento di successo, della scala, della supervisione e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi di coltura delle cellule mammali. Come professionista esperto, sei considerato come un esperto in scienze del processo e aspetti di produzione. In questo ruolo, si contribuisce significativamente allo sviluppo della cassetta degli strumenti MSAT e condividere la responsabilità di produzione come proprietario di processo a lungo termine.

Principali responsabilità

• Leader di team interfunzionali come esperto di processo incaricato di trasferimenti tecnologici (progettazione di processo e scaling-up) e l'implementazione tempestiva di processo a scala di produzione. Questo include l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto di progetti assegnati dalla pianificazione su coordinamento, implementazione, controllo e completamento del progetto allineati con gli obiettivi di gestione del progetto.

• Agire come interfaccia tra il donatore di processo (cliente esterno, sviluppo di processo) e le operazioni. Responsabile per garantire scalabilità del processo e manufacturability.

• Securing successo durante il trasferimento tecnologico applicando processi e strumenti formali per gestire il trasferimento di informazioni, i rischi connessi al processo e il controllo dei cambiamenti

• Responsabile per la risoluzione dei problemi di processo che possono sorgere durante la produzione, considerando tutti i requisiti normativi. Questo include 24 ore su 24.

• Responsabile per l'esecuzione dell'analisi dei rischi GMP per i processi produttivi.

• Interagire direttamente con i clienti durante il trasferimento tecnico, la preparazione della campagna, l'esecuzione e la chiusura, compresa la segnalazione quotidiana di stato e prestazioni batch.

• Garantire una tempestiva compilazione delle deviazioni, delle richieste di cambiamento e dei report delle campagne, nonché il continuo miglioramento delle prestazioni dei processi.

Requisiti chiave

•
• PhD (preferito), Master o Bachelor in biotecnologia, ingegneria chimica o discipline correlate

• Un minimo di cinque anni di esperienza nel settore della produzione biofarmaceutica o dello sviluppo di processi, con una forte preferenza per le competenze nei processi basati sulle cellule mammali.

• Comprensione della tecnologia GMP e del bioprocesso

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione e interazione con tutti i tipi di interfacce all'interno dei clienti e l'organizzazione del progetto

• Fluency in inglese

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.
