descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine Zauberformel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten und Verhaltensweisen
• Strategische Rahmenimplementierung: Etablierung der strategischen wissenschaftlichen und operativen Rahmenbedingungen, die die Transformationspraktiken in allen F & E-Funktionen leiten
• Unternehmensführung: Führen Sie die Integration von Transformationsaktivitäten in mehrere Bereiche und definieren Sie Prioritäten für plattformübergreifende Portfolios mit starker Governance
• Vertrauensvoller Berater: Als Senior Advisor für die F&E-Führung fungieren und interne und externe Netzwerke nutzen, um neue organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Angebote aufzubauen
• Capability-Strategie: Setzen Sie die Personal- und Kapazitätsstrategie für die F&E-Transformation und treten Sie als Sponsor für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und berufliches Wachstum im gesamten Netzwerk auf
• Organisatorische Effektivität: Identifizieren und lösen Sie komplexe Geschäfts- und Branchenherausforderungen, indem Sie neue Ideen in praktische strategische Optionen und langfristige Innovations-Roadmaps einbringen

Hauptbuchhaltung
• Strategische Ausrichtung: Verantwortlich für die unternehmensweite Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und die erfolgreiche Realisierung von Transformationsvorteilen
• Nachhaltige Fähigkeit: Aufbau interner, nachhaltiger Veränderungsfähigkeit innerhalb von F&E, anstatt sich auf projektbasierte Interventionen zu verlassen
• Thought Leadership: Externe und interne Thought Leadership zur Organisationsbereitschaft und Transformationseffektivität
Erfolgsmessungen
• Messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen: Bereitstellung unternehmensweiter Initiativen, die zu quantifizierbaren Verbesserungen der Organisationsleistung führen
• Netzwerkkonsistenz: Etablierung von Praktiken, die zu einer gleichbleibenden Qualität und der Wiederverwendung von Best Practices im gesamten Lonza-Netzwerk führen (CoE, F&E Centres of Excellence)
• Kulturelle Evolution: Demonstrierte Veränderung des organisatorischen Verhaltens und eine gestärkte interne Fähigkeit, zukünftige Transformationen zu bewältigen

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen
Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

• Strategisches Stakeholder-Management: Fähigkeit, die Stakeholder-Strategie über Teams und Funktionen hinweg zu führen und zu gestalten, um eine Abstimmung zwischen wissenschaftlicher Leistungsfähigkeit und Geschäftsanforderungen zu gewährleisten

• Business Integration: Überbrückung technischer Innovationen mit Unternehmens- und Plattformstrategie, um sicherzustellen, dass Transformationsvorteile kommerziell und operativ realisiert werden

• Organisationsentwicklung: Einstellung von Personen und Fähigkeiten für eine Domäne, um eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und der Zusammenarbeit zu gestalten

• Talententwicklung: Aufbau von Teamfähigkeit durch die Entwicklung älterer Talente und die Förderung integrativer, leistungsstarker Kulturen

Kernkompetenzen:

• Influencing & Negotiation: Querfunktionale Ausrichtung vorantreiben, um Innovationszyklen zu beschleunigen und Entscheidungen auf hoher Ebene zu beeinflussen

• Strategische Umsetzung: Umsetzung der Innovations-Roadmap und Sicherstellung, dass alle Initiativen wissenschaftliche Kreativität mit Geschäftszielen integrieren

• Empowerment & Coaching: Befähigung verschiedener Teams, strategische F & E-Ziele zu erreichen und berufliches Wachstum auf allen Karrierewegen zu unterstützen

• Change Leadership: Über projektbasierte Interventionen hinaus, um dauerhafte wissenschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen und Praktiken zu etablieren, die Konsistenz und Innovation unterstützen

• Kritisches Denken & Innovation: Förderung einer Kultur des kritischen Denkens und Förderung der Integration neuer Methoden, um einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu erhalten

Qualifikationen & Erfahrung
• Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Organisationsentwicklung, Wirtschaft, Psychologie, Naturwissenschaften oder Ingenieurwissenschaften
• Erfahrung: Bedeutende Erfahrung bei der Unterstützung oder Leitung einer groß angelegten organisatorischen Transformation und bei der Beeinflussung leitender Stakeholder in einem komplexen, matrixförmigen Umfeld
• Erfahrung in der Managementberatung ist sehr wünschenswert
• Zertifizierungen: Professionelle Zertifizierungen im Change Management (z.B. PROSCI), Coaching oder Organisationsentwicklung sind sehr vorteilhaft

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.
Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Principales responsabilités et comportements
• Mise en oeuvre du cadre stratégique : Établir les cadres stratégiques scientifiques et opérationnels qui guident les pratiques de transformation dans toutes les fonctions de R-D
• Leadership de l'entreprise: Diriger l'intégration des activités de transformation dans plusieurs domaines, définir les priorités pour les portefeuilles multiplateformes avec une gouvernance forte
• Conseiller fiable : Servir de conseiller principal pour le leadership en R-D, en tirant parti des réseaux internes et externes pour créer de nouvelles capacités et offres organisationnelles
• Stratégie de capacité : Établir la stratégie des ressources humaines et des capacités pour la transformation de la R-D, en tant que commanditaire de l'amélioration continue et de la croissance professionnelle dans l'ensemble du réseau
• Efficacité organisationnelle : Identifier et résoudre les défis complexes des entreprises et de l'industrie en faisant de nouvelles idées des options stratégiques pratiques et des feuilles de route pour l'innovation à long terme

Principales responsabilités
• alignement stratégique: responsable de l'alignement des parties prenantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise et de la réalisation réussie des avantages de la transformation
• Capacité durable : Renforcer la capacité de changement interne et durable au sein de la R-D plutôt que de compter sur des interventions fondées sur des projets
• Leadership de la pensée : fournir un leadership de la pensée externe et interne sur la préparation organisationnelle et l'efficacité de la transformation
Mesures de succès
• Impact opérationnel mesurable : Mise en oeuvre d'initiatives à l'échelle de l'organisation qui entraînent des améliorations quantifiables de la performance organisationnelle
• Cohérence du réseau : Établissement de pratiques qui aboutissent à une qualité uniforme et à la réutilisation des pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble du réseau Lonza (CoE, Centres d'excellence en R-D)
• Évolution culturelle : Changement manifeste des comportements organisationnels et renforcement de la capacité interne de gérer les transformations futures

Compétences et compétences requises
Compétences requises

• Gestion stratégique des intervenants : Capacité de diriger et de façonner la stratégie des intervenants entre les équipes et les fonctions, en assurant l'harmonisation entre la capacité scientifique et les besoins opérationnels

• Intégration des entreprises : Relier l'innovation technique avec la stratégie de l'entreprise et de la plate-forme pour assurer la réalisation commerciale et opérationnelle des avantages de la transformation

• Développement organisationnel: Définir des stratégies humaines et des capacités pour un domaine qui façonne une culture d'apprentissage et de collaboration continus

• Développement des talents : renforcer les capacités de l'équipe en développant les talents supérieurs et en favorisant des cultures inclusives et performantes

Compétences de base :

• Influencer et négocier : favoriser l'alignement interfonctionnel pour accélérer les cycles d'innovation et influencer la prise de décisions de haut niveau

• Exécution stratégique: Exécuter la feuille de route pour l'innovation et veiller à ce que toutes les initiatives intègrent la créativité scientifique aux objectifs commerciaux

• Autonomisation & Coaching: Autonomiser diverses équipes pour atteindre des objectifs stratégiques de R-D et soutenir la croissance professionnelle sur tous les parcours de carrière

• Leadership du changement : Au-delà des interventions fondées sur des projets, établir des cadres et des pratiques scientifiques permanents qui appuient la cohérence et l'innovation

• Pensée critique et innovation : favoriser une culture de pensée critique et encourager l'intégration de méthodes émergentes pour maintenir un avantage concurrentiel

Qualifications et expérience
• Études : Licence ou maîtrise en développement organisationnel, affaires, psychologie, sciences ou génie
• Expérience: Expérience importante appuyant ou menant une transformation organisationnelle à grande échelle et influençant les parties prenantes de haut niveau dans un environnement complexe et matricial
• L'expérience du conseil en gestion est hautement souhaitable
• Certifications: Certification professionnelle en gestion du changement (p. ex. PROSCI), coaching, ou développement organisationnel est très avantageux

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.
Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient de faire une différence significative.

jobs.description:
Der Arbeitsort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Anspruchsberechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Der Produktionsbetrieb Accelerate in Visp ist gestartet – und wir suchen dich, um ihn gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.
Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Werde Teil eines motivierten Teams und bring dein Know-how in einer modernen Produktionsanlage zum Einsatz.

Diese Stelle erfordert eine durchgehende Präsenz vor Ort. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht eine enge, zeitnahe Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was wir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:

• Benefits in Visp

Deine Aufgaben:

• Selbstständige Durchführung, Überwachung und Dokumentation von Produktionsprozessen und Anlagenrundgängen nach GMP‑Vorgaben

• Sicheres Arbeiten unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheits‑, Qualitäts‑ und Betriebsrichtlinien (GMP)

• Aktive Mitarbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb sowie flexible Übernahme von Spezialaufträgen

• Verantwortung für Ordnung und Sauberkeit am Arbeitsplatz

• Einbringen deiner beruflichen Erfahrung sowie Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, technisches oder handwerkliches Verständnis, IT‑Grundkenntnisse (MS Office)

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert und stellen einen klaren Vorteil dar

• Teamgeist, Genauigkeit, hohes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und körperliche Belastbarkeit

• Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob groß oder klein und von welcher Person sie auch kommt, hat das Potenzial, das Leben von Millionen Menschen zu verbessern, und genau an dieser Art von Arbeit möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a member of the QA Small Molecules team, you ensure compliance with all quality and regulatory requirements throughout the entire product lifecycle. You support our production units in all quality‑related matters and contribute to the efficient and GMP‑compliant manufacturing of our products.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Ensure that manufacturing is conducted in accordance with the process registered with health authorities.

• Monitor compliance with all quality agreements established with our international customers.

• Build and maintain reliable and transparent relationships with customers to consistently meet quality expectations and requirements.

• Independently review batch‑related manufacturing documentation for completeness, accuracy, and GMP compliance.

• Support, assess, and approve Deviations, Change Requests, and CAPA actions.

• Contribute to quality risk assessments and prepare Quality Review Reports.

• Conduct internal audits and support customer audits as well as inspections by regulatory authorities.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in a scientific discipline (Chemistry/ Biochemistry/ Pharmacy or similar).

• Ideally initial professional experience in an industrial environment; GMP knowledge and experience in chemical manufacturing are advantageous.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in German and English required

• High sense of ownership, structured working style, and strong customer and team orientation.

• Ability to interpret regulatory requirements accurately and align them with sound business understanding.

• Proficient in MS Office; experience with pharmaceutical IT systems (e.g., Documentum, LIMS, TrackWise) is an asset.

• Quick comprehension skills and strong organizational abilities.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Ibex manufacturing team in Visp and play a key role in delivering life-changing biopharmaceutical products. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge manufacturing operations while developing technical expertise in upstream or downstream processing within a fast-growing and innovative environment.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

• Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.

• Support upstream or downstream manufacturing activities in compliance with cGMP and safety requirements.

• Troubleshoot process equipment, evaluate results, and recommend appropriate solutions.

• Contribute to environmental monitoring, safety initiatives, and risk assessment activities.

• Prepare, review, and maintain manufacturing documentation, including batch records and SOPs.

• Support investigations, deviations, change controls, and CAPA activities.

• Participate in equipment commissioning and capital investment projects.

• Train and support manufacturing personnel on equipment operation and standard manufacturing practices.

What we are looking for

• Education in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering, or a related life sciences discipline.

• Experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including microbial or mammalian cell culture and/or protein purification.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a regulated environment.

• Collaborative mindset with strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.

• Understanding of GMP principles and pharmaceutical manufacturing practices is beneficial.

• Previous experience in DSP and Column Packing.

• Our role is based on morning and afternoon shift (rotation) Mon -Fri with some flexibility.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our site in Visp, we are looking for an experienced MSAT Chemist to support highly potent active pharmaceutical ingredient (HPAPI) processes and products transferred into or manufactured within our HAPI Kilo Suites and Apollo production facilities.

As part of the Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) team, you will play a key role in ensuring successful process transfers, supporting commercial manufacturing, driving process robustness, and acting as a subject matter expert in preparative chromatography.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: Visp

What you will do:

• Support the transfer of commercial GMP manufacturing processes from the HAPI laboratories into the HAPI Kilo Suite Manufacturing (HKSM) and/or Apollo production facilities, working closely with manufacturing teams, project teams, and customers

• Provide scientific and technical support for the commercial manufacture of highly potent products during process start-up and routine operations. This includes troubleshooting, root cause investigations, hypothesis testing, process optimization, and the execution of use tests

• Support qualification activities, including the evaluation and introduction of new suppliers, raw materials, and process-related changes

• Develop a deep understanding of assigned manufacturing processes to ensure robust process performance, operational excellence, and reliable product supply

• Lead and develop assigned laboratory technicians while acting as a process optimization specialist within the department

• Serve as a subject matter expert for preparative chromatography and contribute to the continuous improvement of purification processes and manufacturing performance

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry (Ph.D., M.Sc., or equivalent industry experience), preferably in organic chemistry, analytical chemistry, or a related field.

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in the development, optimization, and application of preparative chromatography methods, ideally in the pharmaceutical, chemical, or CDMO industry.

• Strong expertise in chromatographic separation technologies with a proven track record in purification process development and optimization.

• Practical experience in preparative chromatography method development, troubleshooting, and process scale-up.

• Familiarity with cGMP requirements, data analysis, and structured problem-solving approaches is an advantage.

• Self-driven, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Fluent English skills (written and spoken) are required; German is considered a plus but is not mandatory.

• Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo dei metodi di cromatografia preparatoria, nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella scala dei processi.

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. • Diplôme en chimie (Ph.D., M.Sc. ou expérience équivalente de l'industrie), de préférence en chimie organique, en chimie analytique ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience pratique dans le développement, l'optimisation et l'application des méthodes de chromatographie préparative, idéalement dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, chimique ou CDMO.

• Forte expertise dans les technologies de séparation chromatographique avec une expérience prouvée dans le développement et l'optimisation des processus de purification.

• Expérience pratique dans le développement des méthodes de chromatographie préparative, le dépannage et l'échelle des processus.

• La connaissance des exigences du GMPc, de l'analyse des données et des approches structurées de résolution de problèmes est un avantage.

• Professionnel autonome, analytique et axé sur la solution, possédant de solides compétences en communication et la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes multidisciplinaires.

• Des compétences en anglais (écrites et parlées) sont requises; l'allemand est considéré comme un plus mais n'est pas obligatoire.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie?
Demande maintenant.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine Zauberformel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung besteht darin, dass engagierte Menschen zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.
An unserem Standort in Visp im Wallis suchen wir derzeit Process Expert MSAT Downstream- Mammalian Large Scale, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen!

Der eigentliche Standort dieses Jobs ist in Visp, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Was du tun wirst:

• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams als Prozessexperte, der mit Technologietransfers (Prozessdesign und Hochskalierung) und zeitnaher Prozessimplementierung im Fertigungsmaßstab beauftragt ist. Dies umfasst den gesamten Lebenszyklus der zugewiesenen Projekte von der Planung über die Koordination, Umsetzung, Kontrolle und Projektabwicklung im Einklang mit den Projektmanagementzielen.

• Handeln Sie als Schnittstelle zwischen Prozessspender (Kunde, Prozessentwicklung) und Betrieb. Verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Prozessskalierbarkeit und Herstellbarkeit.

• Sicherung des Erfolgs beim Technologietransfer durch Anwendung formaler Prozesse und Tools zur Verwaltung des Informationstransfers, prozessbezogener Risiken und Änderungskontrolle

• Verantwortlich für die Lösung von Prozessproblemen, die während der Herstellung auftreten können, unter Berücksichtigung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Verantwortlich für die Durchführung der GMP-Risikoanalyse für die Herstellungsprozesse.

• Arbeiten als MSAT-Prozessexperte in Kapitalinvestitionsprojekten für den Bau und die Inbetriebnahme der Fertigungseinheiten. Hauptverantwortlicher für die Bereitstellung aller für die spezifischen Prozesse erforderlichen Eingaben (Blockflussdiagramme, Medien- und Pufferlisten, kritische Parameterlisten)

• Verantwortlich für die Umsetzung des Herstellungsprozesses in der Anlage.

• Interagieren Sie direkt mit Kunden während des Technologietransfers, der Kampagnenvorbereitung, Ausführung und Schließung, einschließlich der täglichen Berichterstattung über Batchstatus und -leistung.

• Gewährleistung einer zeitnahen Zusammenstellung von prozessbezogenen Abweichungen, Änderungswünschen und Kampagnenberichten

• Zusammenstellung von CMC-Abschnitten in den Einreichungsunterlagen und technischer Inhalt der Validierungsberichte

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Implementierung standardisierter MSAT-Verfahren und -Prozesse.

• Verantwortlich für die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Prozessleistung

• Überwachung von Aufgaben im Bereich lokaler und globaler MSAT-Initiativen oder Leitung großer Task Forces oder Troubleshooting-Teams.

• Bewertung und Förderung innovativer Trends im jeweiligen Fachgebiet

• Als Mentor für wissenschaftliche und Produktionsmitarbeiter in verschiedenen Fachgebieten.

• Durchführung prozessspezifischer Schulungen für Produktionsmitarbeiter.

Was wir suchen:

• Bachelor / Master, PhD bevorzugt

• Bevorzugter Studienbereich: Biotechnologie, Chemietechnik oder verwandte Disziplinen

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich der biopharma Herstellung und / oder Prozessentwicklung bevorzugt im Bereich der Säugetierherstellung

• GMP und tiefes Verständnis der Bioprozesstechnologie

• fließend in Englisch und Deutsch wäre vorteilhaft

• Starke Führungsqualitäten

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Interaktion mit allen Arten von Schnittstellen innerhalb der Kunden und der Projektorganisation

• Starke Teamorientierung

• Strukturierte, fokussierte und gut organisierte Arbeitseinstellung

• Aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Vorschläge

• Agiler, hochmotivierter und dynamischer Antrieb

• Lösungsorientiert

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem signifikanten Unterschied einhergeht.

Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.

jobs.title: Internship Mammalian Analytical Development 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

For our recently launched outstanding biological manufacturing and development concept in Visp, Switzerland, we currently have an opening for students who would like to do an internship or write a thesis linked to the pharmaceutical industry. This internship will be in Analytical Development in Biologics Mammalian. Become part of this exciting opportunity and join our team by applying for this internship.

The duration is between 9 and 12 months.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you'll do:

• Contribute to the routine testing of protein therapeutics (HPLC, CE-SDS, icIEF, LC-MS or other methods)

• Generation and collection of high-quality data, including performing data analysis and interpretation of results

• Working independently on the implementation of improvements and development of new technical solutions

• Maintenance of laboratory equipment and responsibility for associated laboratory activities

What we are looking for:

• Basic knowledge of biochemical methods is a must. Hands-on laboratory experience is beneficial

• Scientific curiosity and interest in analytical chemistry

• Skills in data analysis and interpretation are desired

• Basic knowledge of programming languages is a plus

• Collaborative and good communication skills in English

• A reasonable sense of humor

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. descriptionByLocale.en:
Move more than just goods – as a driver for safe and sustainable transport in the logistics team in Visp, you ensure safe transport, smooth processes and are the connecting link between plant logistics and internal customers. Responsibility, technology and team spirit are waiting for you!

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Safe and timely transport of goods and materials
according to the prescribed routes and schedules.

• Loading and unloading of vehicles in compliance with safety requirements
and the careful handling of the goods.

• Regular check of vehicle condition
(tyres, brakes, fluid levels, etc.) and reporting of defects.

• Compliance with all relevant traffic rules, safety regulations and environmental standards.

• Maintenance of journey logs and other necessary documentation
Precise and complete.

• Communication with the logistics department
and other relevant transport coordination departments.

• Active participation in the optimization of transport processes
in terms of safety, efficiency and sustainability.

• Ensure the cleanliness and order of the assigned vehicle.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training as road transport specialist EFZ
or comparable qualification (work experience 3-5 years)

• proven experience in transport or logistics,
Ideally in an industrial environment.

• SUVA-approved training for industrial trucks of categories R1 and R2 (mandatory)

• Category C driving licence (mandatory)

• Driver qualification certificate - CZV (mandatory)

• ADR Certificate Basic Course (advantageous)

• High sense of responsibility for safety and quality.

• Reliability, punctuality and independent working methods

• Good knowledge of German in words and writing; Oral English skills are beneficial.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione. L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali può essere trovato anche su lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Cosa farai:

• Guidare, sviluppare e allenare un team di 8–12 QC Microbiology Reviewers, costruendo una cultura di qualità, responsabilità, collaborazione e miglioramento continuo

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Una laurea in microbiologia, biotecnologia, scienze farmaceutiche, biologia o una disciplina scientifica correlata

• Esperienza significativa nelle operazioni di laboratorio farmaceutico QC, QA o microbiologico all'interno di un ambiente regolamentato GMP

• Esperienza comprovata team leader, sviluppo delle persone e guida delle prestazioni operative

• Forte conoscenza di test microbiologici, processi di rilascio batch, gestione delle indagini e requisiti normativi

• Esperienza che supporta ispezioni normative e audit dei clienti

• Forte acume aziendale e giudizio positivo quando si bilanciano qualità, conformità e priorità operative

• La capacità di gestire le priorità concorrenti e guidare i team attraverso un ambiente di produzione complesso e in rapida evoluzione

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. jobs.description:

Was wir suchen:

• Sie befinden sind in einem naturwissenschaftliches Masterstudium / haben einen Masterabschluss (Uni / FH) – bevorzugt in Biotechnologie, Chemieingenieurwesen oder verwandtem Fachgebiet

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere größte Stärke. descriptionByLocale.en:
The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an intern (m/f/d) Biotechnologist Manufacturing.
We offer a 12-month internship.

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate the groundbreaking ideas of our customers into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you to our team.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

jobs.title: Project Lead, QC (m
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a QC Project Lead (m/f/d) to join our Quality Control team in Visp, Switzerland. As the QC representative and single point of contact within cross-functional project teams, you will connect analytical laboratories, internal stakeholders and external customers. Through effective planning and independent coordination, you will ensure QC activities are delivered on time and within budget, adapting to changing customer needs and project priorities.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location. The full list of our global benefits can also be found at lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you’ll do:

• Represent QC in cross-functional project teams, independently coordinating QC activities and aligning priorities with QA, Operations, MSAT and Engineering

• Establish and maintain strong customer relationships, acting as the primary contact for project-related QC matters

• Plan and oversee QC activities supporting production campaigns, ensuring readiness and timely delivery

• Coordinate, prioritize and schedule tasks across analytical laboratories in line with project requirements and available resources

• Process change requests and deviations in accordance with GMP requirements

• Coordinate QC contributions to customer audits and regulatory inspections

• Calculate and monitor project-related QC costs, supporting cost-efficient delivery

• Collaborate closely with Program Management, Process Development, Manufacturing and QA to resolve issues and adapt plans to changing priorities

What we’re looking for:

• A master’s degree or PhD in biology, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences or a related natural science discipline

• Experience in a GMP-regulated environment and Quality Control is advantageous

• Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and remain focused under pressure

• Clear communication skills in German and English

• A collaborative, customer-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively across functions

• The ability to work independently, make sound decisions and take ownership of project-related QC activities

• Confidence using MS Office; knowledge of systems such as Documentum, LIMS or TrackWise is advantageous

• An adaptable and thorough approach to solving problems and delivering results

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

jobs.title: CQV Engineer – SPOC Utilities & HVAC 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join us in as a CQV Engineer – SPOC Utilities & HVAC in Visp. You will be the subject matter expert and primary point of contact within the CQV department for the qualification and validation of Utilities and HVAC systems. You will take ownership of the CQV activities related to these systems throughout their entire lifecycle and contribute significantly to ensuring their compliant, reliable and efficient operation.
In this role, you will work independently while acting as a strong interface between CQV, Engineering, Operations, Plant Engineering, Quality Assurance and Project teams. You will combine strong technical expertise with a solid understanding of GMP requirements and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: Benefits - Visp

What you’ll do:

• Act as the CQV SPOC and SME for Utilities & HVAC systems, providing technical expertise and guidance across the organization.

• Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and maintenance of qualifications and requalifications throughout the system lifecycle.

• Assess qualification impacts from installations, modifications, changes, deviations, and lifecycle activities, ensuring ongoing compliance.

• Prepare, review, and maintain CQV, Engineering, and GMP documentation in line with GxP requirements and internal procedures.

• Manage and support TCRs, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and other quality-related activities for Utilities & HVAC systems.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and project teams to deliver compliant solutions from design through qualification and operation.

• Support audits, inspections, continuous improvement initiatives, and decommissioning activities while maintaining system compliance and lifecycle requirements.

What we are looking for:

• Completed technical education (ETH, FH, HF) or equivalent professional experience

• Several years of relevant experience in Utilities, HVAC, commissioning, validation within a regulated GMP environment

• Strong technical knowledge of HVAC systems and/or pharmaceutical utilities, with a good understanding of their operation, critical parameters and qualification requirements

• Solid knowledge of GMP/GxP requirements and regulatory expectations

• Proven ability to work independently, take ownership and make sound technical and compliance-related decisions

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with other departments

• A structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach, combined with a strong focus on quality and compliance

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of German is an advantage.

• A strong team player who is comfortable working in a cross-functional environment while maintaining a high level of independence and accountability

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Every day, our teams across the world work together to turn scientific breakthroughs into life-changing medicines that reach up to 100 million patients a year. Lonza is a place where people can make a unique impact, grow their careers and belong.

You will coordinate and support audits and inspections at an innovative manufacturing site equipped with state-of-the-art sterile filling technologies, ensuring the smooth execution of all audit-related activities from the back office. This role offers exciting exposure to international customer and regulatory inspections, along with excellent opportunities to further develop your expertise in quality, compliance, and inspection management over the long term. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits can be found here: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Coordinate and support regulatory inspections and customer audits, including preparation, hosting activities, inspection logistics, and audit documentation.

• Act as a key back-office partner during audits and inspections, ensuring efficient coordination, timely responses, and seamless communication with internal and external stakeholders.

• Drive audit and inspection follow-up activities in TrackWise, partnering with subject matter experts to develop and track effective CAPA plans.

• Contribute to inspection readiness initiatives for a state-of-the-art sterile filling facility, helping maintain a culture of continuous compliance and quality excellence.

• Support GMP compliance and Quality Management System activities, including change controls, deviations, CAPAs, self-inspections, document management, and implementation of global quality standards.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences or a related field, combined with several years of work experience in a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment (e.g. in shopfloor GMP production, MSAT, QC or similar background).

• Fluent English communication skills are essential, enabling effective collaboration with global stakeholders, customers, and regulatory authorities.

• Strong understanding of GMP principles, quality processes, and compliance requirements is a must; experience in sterile manufacturing or biologics/drug substance operations is an advantage.

• Customer audit and/or regulatory inspection experience is beneficial, with a keen interest in developing expertise in audit and inspection management.

• Willingness to work primarily at our Stein site and travel approximately one day per week to Basel; German skills are a plus, and you should be motivated to further develop your German language proficiency to support your own long-term career growth.

You will feel at home at Lonza if you:
• Take ownership, step forward, and enjoy meaningful responsibility
• Love solving problems and thrive in a complex, fast-moving environment
• Are curious, always looking to learn and improve
• Work collaboratively, contributing to something bigger than yourself
• Are motivated to make a difference through work that impacts customers and their patients

Why Lonza:
We are a place of unique opportunity, where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference. Here, you will have the freedom to grow, the support to succeed and the chance to contribute to work that matters.

We are the makers of the medicines of tomorrow.
Join us. Be you. Apply now.

• Contribuire alle iniziative di prontezza di ispezione per un impianto di riempimento sterile all'avanguardia, contribuendo a mantenere una cultura di conformità continua e di eccellenza di qualità.

• Supporta la conformità GMP e le attività del sistema di gestione della qualità, compresi i controlli di cambiamento, le deviazioni, CAPAs, l'auto-ispezione, la gestione dei documenti e l'attuazione degli standard di qualità globali.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Corso di laurea o Master in Scienze della Vita o un campo correlato, combinato con diversi anni di esperienza lavorativa in un ambiente di produzione regolamentato GMP (ad esempio nella produzione di GMP, MSAT, QC o background simile).

Ti sentirai a casa a Lonza se:
• Prendere la proprietà, fare un passo avanti e godere di responsabilità significativa
• Amore risolvere i problemi e prosperare in un ambiente complesso e veloce
• Sono curiosi, sempre alla ricerca di imparare e migliorare
• Lavorare in collaborazione, contribuendo a qualcosa di più grande di te stesso
• Sono motivati a fare la differenza attraverso il lavoro che colpisce i clienti e i loro pazienti

Perché Lonza:
Siamo un luogo di opportunità unica, dove le vostre idee, competenze e ambizione possono fare una vera differenza. Qui, avrete la libertà di crescere, il supporto per avere successo e la possibilità di contribuire al lavoro che conta.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

jobs.title: Senior Deviation Specialist 80%-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Deviation Specialist

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

Join Lonza's Quality organization in Visp and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, compliance, and reliability of life-saving therapies. As a Senior Deviation Specialist, you will lead complex investigations, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborate across functions to maintain the highest GMP standards.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Lead complex GMP deviation investigations, utilizing structured root cause analysis methodologies to identify underlying issues and implement sustainable solutions.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to gather data, evaluate findings, and drive effective CAPAs.

• Author clear, scientifically sound, and compliant deviation reports in accordance with internal procedures and global regulatory expectations.

• Monitor CAPA implementation and effectiveness, ensuring timely completion and reducing the risk of recurring deviations.

• Act as a subject matter expert during internal and external audits, supporting inspection readiness and defending investigation outcomes.

• Analyze deviation trends, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen process reliability and product quality.

• Participate in risk assessments and change control activities to proactively prevent quality issues and support continuous improvement.

What we are looking for

• Experience working within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environment, including several years focused on quality systems, deviation management, quality assurance, or quality control.

• Strong expertise in root cause analysis methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, FMEA, or similar structured problem-solving approaches.

• Ability to interpret data, assess risks, and make sound quality decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Strong understanding of cGMP requirements and global regulatory expectations, including FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly.

• Experience working with quality management systems such as TrackWise, Veeva, or comparable platforms.

• Degree in a scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent experience that provides a strong foundation in quality and compliance principles.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Senior Deviation Specialist

Ubicazione: Visp, Svizzera

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera.

Partecipa all'organizzazione Quality di Lonza a Visp e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la qualità, la conformità e l'affidabilità delle terapie salvavita. Come Senior Deviation Specialist, guiderai indagini complesse, guiderai iniziative di miglioramento continuo e collaborerai attraverso funzioni per mantenere i più elevati standard GMP.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Che cosa si otterrà

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai

• Indagini complesse di deviazione GMP, utilizzando metodologie di analisi delle cause radice strutturate per identificare i problemi sottostanti e implementare soluzioni sostenibili.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Manufacturing, Quality Control, Engineering e altri stakeholder interfunzionali per raccogliere dati, valutare i risultati e guidare CAPA efficaci.

• Autori rapporti di deviazione chiari, scientificamente sani e conformi secondo procedure interne e aspettative normative globali.

• Monitorare l'implementazione e l'efficacia della CAPA, garantire il completamento tempestivo e ridurre il rischio di deviazioni ricorrenti.

• Agire come esperto di materia soggetto durante gli audit interni ed esterni, sostenendo la disponibilità di ispezione e difendendo i risultati delle indagini.

• Analizzare le tendenze della deviazione, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e contribuire a iniziative che rafforzano l'affidabilità del processo e la qualità del prodotto.

• Partecipa a valutazioni di rischio e attività di controllo del cambiamento per prevenire proattivamente i problemi di qualità e sostenere il miglioramento continuo.

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, biotecnologico, o di dispositivi medici, tra cui diversi anni focalizzati su sistemi di qualità, gestione delle deviazioni, garanzia della qualità o controllo della qualità.

• Forte esperienza nelle metodologie di analisi delle cause principali come 5 Perché, Diagrammi di Fishbone, FMEA, o simili approcci strutturati di problem solving.

• Capacità di interpretare i dati, valutare i rischi e prendere decisioni di qualità sonora in un ambiente di produzione veloce.

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti cGMP e delle aspettative normative globali, tra cui le linee guida FDA, EMA e ICH.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in tedesco e inglese, con la capacità di comunicare con chiarezza informazioni tecniche complesse.

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi di gestione della qualità come TrackWise, Veeva, o piattaforme paragonabili.

• Laurea in una disciplina scientifica o ingegneristica, o esperienza equivalente che fornisce una solida base in principi di qualità e conformità.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

jobs.description:
Senior Bioprocess Engineer (m/f/d) 80%–100%

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza's Biotechnology Manufacturing team in Visp and contribute to the delivery of innovative therapies through world-class GMP manufacturing. As a Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for manufacturing campaigns, drive process improvements, and support the development of both manufacturing processes and people in a highly collaborative environment.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Provide technical leadership and oversight for GMP manufacturing campaigns across upstream and downstream bioprocessing operations.

• Support successful batch execution through data analysis, troubleshooting, process monitoring, and implementation of sustainable technical solutions.

• Lead and review risk assessments, ensuring follow-up actions are effectively implemented and monitored.

• Maintain high-quality GMP documentation and ensure manufacturing processes remain inspection-ready and compliant.

• Identify, evaluate, and implement improvements to processes, equipment, and workflows in close partnership with Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, and Quality stakeholders.

• Deliver product-specific training and contribute to the technical development of employees across the manufacturing organization.

• Act as a technical expert during audits, inspections, workshops, and cross-functional initiatives while coaching colleagues and sharing best practices.

What we are looking for

• Experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environments, supported by a strong understanding of GMP requirements and regulated operations.

• Solid knowledge of biotechnological manufacturing processes, ideally including upstream processing (USP), downstream processing (DSP), or both.

• Experience with deviation investigations, risk assessments, process optimization, and GMP documentation practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound technical decisions in a fast-paced production environment.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, influence stakeholders, and support technical leadership initiatives.

• Excellent communication, coaching, and training skills, with fluency in both German and English.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related scientific or technical discipline, or equivalent experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. jobs.description:
Der Standort dieser Position ist in Visp, Schweiz. Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Diese Position ist vollständig vor Ort angesiedelt. Die enge persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht einen direkten Austausch, schnelle Abstimmungen und die hohe technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lebensstil, Familie und Freizeit erwarten. Die vollständige Liste unserer lokal zugeschnittenen Benefits finden Sie unten.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams in einem anspruchsvollen GMP-regulierten Produktionsumfeld

• Förderung einer Kultur der Sicherheit, Qualität, kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

• Planung und Priorisierung von Ressourcen zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs und zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele

• Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und GMP-Anforderungen

• Aktive Mitwirkung bei Abweichungsuntersuchungen und Ursachenanalysen sowie bei der Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Koordination und termingerechte Umsetzung von Schulungs- und Qualifizierungsplänen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zur Optimierung von Prozessen und Schnittstellen

• Sicherstellung effizienter Schichtübergaben sowie Übernahme weiterer organisatorischer und administrativer Aufgaben

• Förderung einer leistungsorientierten, motivierenden und wertschätzenden Teamkultur

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Schichtleiter/in, stellvertretende/r Schichtleiter/in, Systemspezialist/in oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion innerhalb der pharmazeutischen, chemischen oder biotechnologischen Produktion

• Idealerweise eine Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/in (CPT) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und/oder einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Biotechnologie, Biologie, Biochemie, Verfahrenstechnik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet

• Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Entwicklung und Förderung von Mitarbeitenden

• Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Umfassendes Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse und deren Zusammenhänge sowie für die Anforderungen an Sicherheit, Qualität und Compliance in einem regulierten Umfeld

• Hohe Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität und Durchsetzungsvermögen in einem dynamischen Produktionsumfeld

• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Deutsch auf mind.B1-B2 Niveau

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4-Schicht-System

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere größte Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob groß oder klein, hat das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern – und genau an dieser Arbeit möchten wir Sie beteiligen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in umsetzbare Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüßen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

English Version

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

What you will do:

• Leading, assessing, coaching and developing employees in a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment

• Embodying our Culture of Safety, Quality, personal development and constant learning and improvement

• Setting priorities and prioritizing resources to meet deadlines

• Participation in the investigation of deviations and improvement projects

• Ensure compliance with all relevant safety, quality and GMP requirements

• Creation and timely implementation of training plans

• Comparison of cross-company process steps (relationships, dependencies, processes)

• Administrative tasks such as managing shift handovers, inspections and creating instructions

• Promote a high-performing, motivating and respectful team culture

What we are looking for:

• Several years of professional experience as a shift leader, deputy or system specialist in pharmaceutical, chemical or biotech production

• Ideally, completed vocational training as a Chemical and Pharmaceutical Technologist (CPT) or a comparable qualification and/or a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemistry, Process Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience will also be taken into account.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with a genuine interest in developing and supporting employees

• Structured, focused and organized way of working, solution oriented, assertive and motivated, working independently with a flexible and resilient mentality

• Extensive knowledge of production processes and interrelationships in a large production area with detailed knowledge of all process steps, systems and high attention for Safety and Quality

• Strong resilience and flexibility, with the ability to make confident decisions and drive results in a dynamic production environment.

• Proficiency in English (written and oral), German min. B1-B2 (intermediate level)

• Commitment to work in shift (4-shift system)

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione di questa posizione è a Visp, Svizzera. Se necessario, il sostegno è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie quando si muovono.

Questa posizione è interamente localizzata. La stretta collaborazione personale consente lo scambio diretto, il coordinamento rapido e l'elevata precisione tecnica necessaria per la produzione di medicinali ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi su misura locale può essere trovato di seguito.

• Vantaggi in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

I loro compiti:

• Leadership, coaching e ulteriore sviluppo di un team in un ambiente produttivo regolamentato GMP impegnativo

• Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, qualità, miglioramento continuo e sviluppo personale

• Pianificazione e priorità delle risorse per garantire un funzionamento regolare e raggiungere gli obiettivi di produzione

• Responsabilità per il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, qualità e GMP

• Partecipazione attiva alle indagini di deviazione e alle analisi delle cause radice, nonché all'attuazione di misure di miglioramento

• Coordinamento e attuazione tempestiva dei piani di formazione e di qualificazione

• Chiudere la collaborazione con vari dipartimenti per ottimizzare processi e interfacce

• Garantire trasferimenti efficienti a turni e assumere ulteriori compiti organizzativi e amministrativi

• Promuovere una cultura del team orientata alle prestazioni, motivazionale e apprezzata

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come turn manager, vice turn manager, specialista del sistema o in una funzione paragonabile all'interno della produzione farmaceutica, chimica o biotecnologica

• Idealmente, la formazione come chimico e farmacista (CPT) o una qualifica paragonabile e/o un diploma di laurea o master in biotecnologia, biologia, biochimica, ingegneria del processo o un campo correlato

• Forte capacità di leadership e comunicazione, nonché il piacere nello sviluppo e nella promozione dei dipendenti

• Metodo di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione con un elevato senso di qualità e responsabilità

• Comprensione completa dei processi produttivi e delle loro interrelazioni, nonché dei requisiti per la sicurezza, la qualità e la conformità in un ambiente regolamentato

• Alta capacità di carico, flessibilità e assertività in un ambiente di produzione dinamico

• Buone abilità inglesi in parola e scrittura, tedesco a mente. Livello B1-B2

• Prontezza al lavoro nel sistema a 4 turni

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. Con oltre 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello mondiale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali – collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità – riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Ogni idea, grande o piccola, ha il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite – e questo è il lavoro a cui vogliamo che partecipiate.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Quando siete pronti a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie attuabili, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Versione inglese

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi su misura locali può anche essere trovato di seguito.

Cosa farai:

• Leader, valutazione, coaching e sviluppo dei dipendenti in un ambiente di produzione regolamentato da GMP

• Incorporare la nostra cultura della sicurezza, della qualità, dello sviluppo personale e dell'apprendimento costante e del miglioramento

• Impostare priorità e risorse prioritarie per rispettare le scadenze

• Partecipazione all'indagine sulle deviazioni e sui progetti di miglioramento

• Garantire la conformità a tutti i requisiti di sicurezza, qualità e GMP rilevanti

• Creazione e attuazione tempestiva dei piani di formazione

• Confronto delle fasi di processo di cross-company (relazioni, dipendenze, processi)

• Compiti amministrativi come la gestione delle consegne a turni, ispezioni e la creazione di istruzioni

• Promuovere una cultura di squadra altamente performante, motivante e rispettosa

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come leader a turni, vice o specialista di sistema nella produzione farmaceutica, chimica o biotecnologia

• Idealmente, la formazione professionale completa come un tecnico chimico e farmaceutico (CPT) o una qualifica paragonabile e/o una laurea o Master in Biotecnologia, Biologia, Biochimica, Ingegneria dei processi, o un campo relativo. Verrà anche presa in considerazione un'esperienza comprovata.

• Forte capacità di leadership e comunicazione, con un autentico interesse nello sviluppo e nel sostegno dei dipendenti

• Strutturato, focalizzato e organizzato modo di lavorare, orientato alla soluzione, assertivo e motivato, lavorando in modo indipendente con una mentalità flessibile e resiliente

• Ampia conoscenza dei processi di produzione e delle interrelazioni in una grande area di produzione con conoscenza dettagliata di tutte le fasi di processo, sistemi e alta attenzione per la sicurezza e la qualità

• Forte resilienza e flessibilità, con la capacità di prendere decisioni sicure e portare risultati in un ambiente di produzione dinamico.

• Proficienza in inglese (scritto e orale), tedesco min. B1-B2 (livello intermedio)

• Impegno al lavoro a turni (4 turni)

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

• Structured, independent and solution-oriented working method with a high sense of quality and responsibility

• Comprehensive understanding of production processes and their interrelationships as well as the requirements for safety, quality and compliance in a regulated environment

• High load capacity, flexibility and assertiveness in a dynamic production environment

• Good English skills in word and writing, German at mind.B1-B2 level

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'emplacement de cette position est à Viège, Suisse. Si nécessaire, un soutien est offert aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille lorsqu'ils déménagent.

Cette position est entièrement localisée. Une coopération personnelle étroite permet un échange direct, une coordination rapide et une précision technique élevée pour la production de médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que nous vous offrons:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé
