Visp, Switzerland

The actual place of work for this position is Visp, Switzerland. Relocation support is available to eligible candidates and their families as needed.

Do you want to help shape the future of innovative biopharmaceuticals? In this key role, you will assume scientific and technical responsibility for the development, implementation and validation of modern bioanalytical methods while advancing the digitization and automation of analytical laboratories. Their work directly supports the development and manufacture of innovative biological drugs and enables the delivery of life-changing therapies to patients worldwide.

This is a fully site-bound position. Close collaboration on the ground supports direct coordination within teams and the scientific precision required to develop innovative therapies to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer

• An agile career with diverse development opportunities in an international environment.

• An inclusive and value-oriented corporate culture.

• defined benefit remuneration programmes.

• An attractive service and benefits package depending on role and location.

The full overview of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Their tasks

• Main scientific and technical contact for the development, implementation and validation of biochemical and chromatographic assays such as ELISA, enzyme assays, RT-qPCR, protein PCR, UV/Vis, icIEF and RP, SE and IEX HPLC.

• Lead analytical development, transfer and validation activities within several study and client programs.

• Creation, review and final approval of complex study protocols, work instructions and reports according to GLP requirements.

• Collaboration with cross-functional teams from Analytical Development, Process Development, Manufacturing and Quality to ensure scientific excellence.

• Training, coaching and professional development of laboratory and scientific staff.

• Identification, evaluation and implementation of new analytical technologies and promotion of digitalisation and automation initiatives.

• Support continuous improvement processes to increase efficiency, data quality and regulatory compliance.

What we are looking for:

• Doctorate (PhD) in biochemistry, biology, chemistry or a comparable scientific discipline.

• Experience in the development, implementation and validation of analytical methods in the biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical environment.

• In-depth knowledge of advanced bioanalytical and chromatographic technologies such as ELISA, qPCR, icIEF and HPLC.

• Ability to independently lead complex scientific projects and to address technical challenges in a solution-oriented manner.

• Strong communication and team skills as well as enjoy working together in a dynamic environment.

• High initiative, a sense of responsibility and a structured way of working.

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. jobs.description:
Manufacturing Specialist Vibe-X 80%-100%(m/f/d)

Location: Visp, Switzerland

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing vaccine manufacturing team in Visp and play a key role in bringing innovative therapies to patients worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to both the startup of new manufacturing facilities and the ongoing production of critical biopharmaceutical products in a state-of-the-art GMP environment.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What You Will Get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What You Will Do

• Support project teams in the development, implementation, and validation of innovative vaccine manufacturing processes and production facilities.

• Execute manufacturing activities within Upstream Processing, Downstream Processing, or Bioconjugates operations in compliance with cGMP requirements and approved procedures.

• Support Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), Environmental Monitoring (EM), operational, and cleaning risk assessments and contribute to the implementation of mitigation measures.

• Review and prepare manufacturing documentation, including electronic batch records, SOPs, and production-related documents.

• Investigate deviations, support change controls, and drive CAPA implementation to ensure compliance with GMP standards.

• Act as manufacturing subject matter expert during capital investment, commissioning, qualification, and startup projects for new manufacturing units.

• Train and support manufacturing teams on equipment operation, manufacturing processes, and standard procedures.

What We Are Looking For

• Completed vocational training in a chemical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related discipline, or a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Experience or strong theoretical knowledge of biotechnological manufacturing processes, including microbial cultivation, mammalian cell culture, protein purification, or bioconjugation technologies.

• Ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and communicate confidently with stakeholders across different functions.

• Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

• Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are considered an advantage.

• Willingness to work in a 4-shift manufacturing environment.

• Basic understanding of GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical production is advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone's ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that's the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Manufacturing Specialist Vibe-X 80%-100%(m/f/d)

Location: Visp, Switzerland

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing vaccine manufacturing team in Visp and play a key role in bringing innovative therapies to patients worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to both the startup of new manufacturing facilities and the ongoing production of critical biopharmaceutical products in a state-of-the-art GMP environment.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What You Will Get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What You Will Do

• Support project teams in the development, implementation, and validation of innovative vaccine manufacturing processes and production facilities.

• Execute manufacturing activities within Upstream Processing, Downstream Processing, or Bioconjugates operations in compliance with cGMP requirements and approved procedures.

• Support Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), Environmental Monitoring (EM), operational, and cleaning risk assessments and contribute to the implementation of mitigation measures.

• Review and prepare manufacturing documentation, including electronic batch records, SOPs, and production-related documents.

• Investigate deviations, support change controls, and drive CAPA implementation to ensure compliance with GMP standards.

• Act as manufacturing subject matter expert during capital investment, commissioning, qualification, and startup projects for new manufacturing units.

• Train and support manufacturing teams on equipment operation, manufacturing processes, and standard procedures.

What We Are Looking For

• Completed vocational training in a chemical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related discipline, or a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Experience or strong theoretical knowledge of biotechnological manufacturing processes, including microbial cultivation, mammalian cell culture, protein purification, or bioconjugation technologies.

• Ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and communicate confidently with stakeholders across different functions.

• Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

• Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are considered an advantage.

• Willingness to work in a 4-shift manufacturing environment.

• Basic understanding of GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical production is advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone's ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that's the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. • Überwachen Sie Produktionsprozesse, identifizieren Sie potenzielle Probleme und unterstützen Sie Initiativen zur Fehlerbehebung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

• Gewährleistung einer GMP-konformen und zeitnahen Dokumentation der Fertigungsaktivitäten unter Verwendung elektronischer Systeme und Logbücher.

• Handhabung, Inspektion, Reinigung und Lagerung von Produktionsanlagen unter Einhaltung der höchsten Standards in Bezug auf Qualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.

Was wir suchen

• Wir begrüßen Kandidaten aller Erfahrungsstufen, einschließlich erfahrener Fertigungsfachleute und Karrierewechsler mit relevanten Qualifikationen.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem pharmazeutischen, chemischen, biotechnologischen oder verwandten technischen Bereich oder einem Hochschulabschluss in einer relevanten Disziplin.

• Frühere Erfahrungen in der pharmazeutischen oder biopharmazeutischen Herstellung und in GMP-regulierten Umgebungen sind von Vorteil.

• Starkes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Engagement für Qualität und Compliance.

• Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem Team zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig Besitz und Rechenschaftspflicht zu demonstrieren.

• Fließende deutsche und/oder englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Flexibilität und Bereitschaft, in einer 4-Schicht-Produktionsumgebung zu arbeiten.

Über Lonza

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments selon les normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• Exploiter le matériel de fabrication de façon indépendante, y compris les activités de préparation, d'exécution, de surveillance et de nettoyage conformément aux procédures approuvées.

• Effectuer une surveillance environnementale, des contrôles en cours de fabrication (CPI) et des échantillonnages dans les environnements de fabrication réglementés par les BPF.

• Veiller à ce que la documentation des activités de fabrication soit conforme aux BPF et en temps opportun au moyen de systèmes électroniques et de journaux de bord.

• Manipulation, inspection, nettoyage et stockage de l'équipement de production tout en maintenant les normes les plus élevées de qualité, de sécurité et de conformité.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Nous accueillons des candidats de tous les niveaux d'expérience, y compris des professionnels de la fabrication expérimentés et des changements de carrière possédant des qualifications pertinentes.

• Achevé un apprentissage dans un domaine pharmaceutique, chimique, de biotechnologie ou technique connexe, ou un diplôme universitaire dans une discipline pertinente.

• Une expérience antérieure dans la fabrication pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique et les environnements réglementés par les BPF est avantageuse.

• Forte sensibilisation à la sécurité et engagement envers la qualité et la conformité.

• Capacité de travailler efficacement en équipe tout en faisant preuve d'appropriation et de responsabilité.

• Compétences en communication allemande et/ou anglaise.

• Flexibilité et volonté de travailler dans un environnement de production en 4 équipes.

À propos de Lonza

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of our logistics team in Visp as logistics specialist for external logistics service providers 80-100% (m/f/d). In this position, you will design the interface between internal departments, customers and international logistics partners. In this varied role, you take on the operational control and optimization of complex inbound and outbound processes, accompanying implementations at external 3PL service providers and actively contribute to ensuring the highest GMP and GDP standards. Look forward to a dynamic environment with international projects and a great deal of scope for design.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Coordination of logistical tasks between logistics, internal departments and external customers and service providers.

• Responsible for operational control, coordination and continuous optimization of inbound and outbound processes within intralogistics and production supply in compliance with GMP and GDP requirements.

• Implementation, handover and sustainable assurance of Lonza processes at external logistics service providers (3PL).

• Operational responsibility for compliance and continuous improvement of the defined Lonza processes at the 3PL partners.

• Presentation and coordination of standard processes at customer, project and kick-off meetings.

• Close cooperation with internal stakeholders, customers, project managers, quality assurance and external logistics partners.

• Proactive support of cross-divisional logistics and supply chain teams.

• Ongoing review, standardization and optimization of shipping and logistics processes taking into account regulatory and operational requirements.

Your requirement profile:

• You have a completed commercial, logistical (preferably logistics specialist) or CPT vocational training with eidg. Certificate of ability and ideally already have professional experience in a pharmaceutical company

• You have practical experience with SAP EWM / WM / MM

• You are flexible, communicative, resilient and reliable

• 40-60% willingness to travel throughout Switzerland for implementations, process transfers, audits, training and operational support at various 3PL locations.

• Readiness for 2-shift operation

• English skills round off your profile

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

Every day, our teams across the world work together to turn scientific breakthroughs into life-changing medicines that reach up to 100 million patients a year. Lonza is a place where people can make a unique impact, grow their careers and belong.

As Associate Director, Tech Transfer & Lifecycle Lead you take ownership of critical customer programs and play a pivotal role in bringing innovative products to market, leading technology transfers, commercial launches and lifecycle management activities within a state-of-the-art Drug Product fill & finish manufacturing facilities. You'll provide expert technical leadership, work in cross-functional teams and shape the processes, validation strategies and manufacturing standards that ensure successful product launches, sustained process performance and operational excellence. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this great opportunity and apply now!

Key responsibilities:

• You lead multi-functional teams tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale

• You act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and manufacturing

• You directly connect with customers during campaign preparation, execution and closure including regular reporting of batch status and process performance

• You are responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing considering all regulatory requirements

• You secure technology transfer success by applying standardized processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control

Key requirements:

• Bachelor, Master's degree or PhD or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related field

• Significant experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferably in Mammalian Manufacturing (large-scale)

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

• Corso di laurea, laurea magistrale o PhD o esperienza equivalente in Biotecnologia, ingegneria chimica o campo relativo

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We have recently been confirmed as the global manufacturing partner for Moderna’s vaccine against the novel coronavirus, providing a tenfold manufacturing capacity increase. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this exciting opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• As Bioprocess Engineer, you will ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• You will act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• In upstream processing (USP), you will be in the lead in one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In downstream processing (DSP), you will be in charge in one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. capture, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• In the manufacturing of therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC), you will be responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree in Biotechnology, Bio-chemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

• Dans le traitement en aval (DSP), vous serez responsable dans une ou plusieurs zones définies de DSP (p. ex. capture, polissage ou remplissage) pour la purification des protéines thérapeutiques des cellules mammifères ou microbiennes (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Dans la fabrication de BioConjugates thérapeutiques comme Anticorps Drug Conjugates (ADC), vous serez responsable de l'ensemble des processus ou des unités de processus pour les projets de fabrication clinique et commerciale (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Principales exigences:

• Maîtrise en biotechnologie, génie biochimique, biochimie ou matière connexe aux sciences de la vie, ou titulaire d'un baccalauréat

• Connaissance des unités USP (comme les bioréacteurs) ou DSP (comme la chromatographie)

• L'expérience de travail dans la fabrication biologique serait un avantage

• Expérience des BPF et compréhension de la technologie des bioprocédés

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et/ou en allemand

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

jobs.description:
Der Arbeitsort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Anspruchsberechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Für unser Team in der Analytischen Entwicklung von Biokonjugaten am Standort Visp suchen wir eine/n hochmotivierten Projektleiter (m/w/d). Als Mitglied unserer Abteilung sind Sie verantwortlich für die Etablierung der Analytischen Methoden während der Prozessentwicklung. Dazu gehört die Entwicklung, Transfer, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden im Auftrag unserer Kunden sowie die prozessbegleitende Analytik während der Entwicklungsphase, die Freigabeanalytik von Pilot Batches und von Stabilitätsstudien. Als Mitglied von interdisziplinären Projekt Teams Planen, Koordinieren und Priorisieren Sie die Analysenaufträge inklusive Kostenkontrolle und Dokumentation, diskutieren analytische Fragestellungen und Resultate mit internen und externen Kunden und arbeiten nach aktuellen ISO- und GMP Qualitätsrichtlinien.

Diese Stelle erfordert eine durchgehende Präsenz vor Ort. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht eine enge, zeitnahe Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was wir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:

• Benefits in Visp

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortlich für die Planung und Koordination von Laborarbeiten in den zugeteilten Projekten, dies beinhaltet Entwicklungs- und Validierungsaufträge aber auch unterstützende Analytik während der Prozessentwicklung; für die Überprüfung und Auswertung der Ergebnisse sowie für die Präsentation von Daten und Schlussfolgerungen an die Kunden

• Primäre Schnittstelle für die internen und externen Kunden, Teilnahme an den abteilungsübergreifenden Projektmeetings mit Forschung, Produktion und Qualitätssicherung sowie an den projektupdate Meetings zusammen mit dem Kunden

• Verfassen und Freigeben von technischen Berichten, GAP- und Risikoanalysen, SOPs und Kundenberichten.

• Sicherstellen der termin- und kostengerechten Bearbeitung der zugewiesenen Aufträge

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• PhD im naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry oder Pharmaceutical Sciences) mit Erfahrung in der Durchführung unterschiedlicher Analysetechniken wie HPLC, CE und ELISA oder MSc mit mehrjähriger relevanter Industrieerfahrung.

• Flexible, motivierte Persönlichkeit mit Freude an der Analytik, die sich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten wohl fühlt und in der Lage ist, komplexe Probleme für die es keine Routinelösung gibt zu analysieren und zu lösen

• Strukturierte, fokussierte und gut organisierte Arbeitseinstellung, lösungsorientiert und verantwortungsbewusst.

• Fliessend Deutsch und Englisch ist erforderlich.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

• Interfaccia primaria per i clienti interni ed esterni, partecipazione agli incontri di progetto cross-departmental con la ricerca, la produzione e l'assicurazione della qualità, nonché alle riunioni di aggiornamento del progetto insieme al cliente

The Market Modelling team develops forecasting models, analytical products and decision-support tools that help Lonza make better strategic, portfolio and commercial decisions in an uncertain environment.
We are looking for a technically proficient Analytics Solutions Manager to drive the development, adoption and continuous evolution of analytical products supporting stakeholders across Commercial, Strategy, Business Development, Portfolio Management and Marketing functions.
In this role, you will own and develop a portfolio of analytical applications and decision-support tools, acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and analytical development.
You will ensure our products address meaningful business questions, deliver measurable value and evolve in line with changing business needs.
This is a hands-on, cross-functional role combining analytical product ownership, stakeholder engagement, advanced analytics and modelling development.

• Own and develop a portfolio of analytical products and decision-support tools, from concept through deployment, adoption and continuous improvement

The ideal profile will also include several of the following:

• Experience owning, developing and/or supporting data analytics products, portfolio management tools or decision-support applications

• Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, manufacturing or related industries

• Experience with machine learning or AI-based analytical solutions

• Experience with data visualization, dashboarding or analytical application development (e.g., Plotly Dash, Streamlit)

• Familiarity with software engineering practices for analytical applications, including Git, testing, containerization (e.g., Docker) and CI/CD

• Exposure to MLOps, ML pipeline operationalization, cloud platforms (ideally Microsoft Azure), or the deployment and monitoring of analytical applications

Werde Teil unseres EMR-Teams in Visp!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Engineering-&-Maintenance-Teams im Bereich Development & Manufacturing Solutions am Standort Visp suchen wir eine/n Elektro-, Mess- und Regeltechnik (EMR) Ingenieur/in. Die Position umfasst die Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung und verschiedene Projekte in Mono- oder Mehrprodukteanlagen.

Was wir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest Du unter:
Benefits - Visp

Deine Aufgaben:

• Planung und Durchführung von Investitions- und Umstellungsaufgaben in einem automatisierten Produktionsbetrieb für pharmazeutische Wirkstoffe

• Kontinuierliche Anpassung und Verbesserung von Anlagen, Prozessen und Produktwechseln mit Fokus auf Qualität, Sicherheit und Leistung

• Sicherstellung des reibungslosen Betriebs und der zuverlässigen Performance hochautomatisierter Produktionsanlagen mit DeltaV- und MES-Systemen

• GMP-konforme Durchführung von Prüfungen, Dokumentationen und Änderungsmanagement unter Verwendung von Kneat und Ubik

• Erstellung und Pflege von Anlagendokumentationen in SAP/COMOS zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer Anforderungen

• Koordination und Überwachung von Projekten hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Leistung, Kosten und Terminen

• Begleitung der Projekte von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme

• Effiziente Planung und Organisation der Instandhaltung zur Sicherstellung von Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit

• Förderung technologischer Weiterentwicklungen durch eine innovative und proaktive Arbeitsweise

• Aktive Mitarbeit in fachübergreifenden Gremien

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Elektro-, Automations- oder Systemtechnik bzw. Informatik

• Erste Berufserfahrung im Betriebs- oder Projektengineering, in der Instandhaltung oder im Anlagenneubau, idealerweise in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma- oder Chemieindustrie

• Kenntnisse in GMP, COMOS, DeltaV, MES und SAP

• Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie eine selbstständige und flexible Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Geschäftliches Denken, hohe Motivation und Veränderungsbereitschaft

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Au besoin, les candidats admissibles et leur famille seront aidés à déménager.

Devenez membre de notre équipe EMR à Viège !

Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénierie et de maintenance dans le domaine des solutions de développement et de fabrication sur le site de Visp, nous recherchons un ingénieur électrique, de mesure et de contrôle (EMR). Le poste comprend la responsabilité de l'entretien et divers projets dans des installations mono ou multiproduits.

Ce que nous offrons:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

• En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages dans les domaines du mode de vie, de la famille et des loisirs. Retrouvez la liste complète de nos services mondiaux Vous êtes sous :
Avantages - Vispe

Vos tâches :

• Planification et mise en œuvre de tâches d'investissement et de conversion dans une usine de production automatisée d'ingrédients actifs pharmaceutiques

• Adaptation et amélioration continues de l'équipement, des processus et des changements de produits en mettant l'accent sur la qualité, la sécurité et les performances

• Assurer le bon fonctionnement et la fiabilité des installations de production hautement automatisées avec les systèmes DeltaV et MES

• Rendement conforme aux BPF des vérifications, de la documentation et de la gestion du changement en utilisant Kneat et Ubik

• Création et mise à jour de la documentation des installations dans SAP/COMOS pour garantir les exigences réglementaires

• Coordination et suivi des projets en termes de fonctionnalité, de performance, de coûts et de délais

• Appui aux projets, de la planification à la mise en service réussie

• Planification et organisation efficaces de l'entretien pour assurer la disponibilité des installations et la sécurité opérationnelle

• Promotion des progrès technologiques par des méthodes de travail novatrices et proactives

• Participation active aux comités interdisciplinaires

Votre profil:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en électrotechnique, en automatisation ou en informatique

• Première expérience professionnelle en ingénierie d'exploitation ou de projet, entretien ou construction d'usines neuves, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou chimique

• Connaissance des GMP, COMOS, DeltaV, MES et SAP

• Appréciation de la coopération interdisciplinaire et d'une méthode de travail indépendante et flexible

• Un travail d'équipe fort et de très bonnes compétences en communication

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

• Pensée des affaires, forte motivation et volonté de changer

À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est exactement ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire nos clients en thérapies viables, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Postulez !

descriptionByLocale.it:
Se necessario, i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento.

Diventa parte del nostro team EMR a Visp!

Per rafforzare il nostro team Engineering & Maintenance nell'area di Development & Manufacturing Solutions presso il sito Visp, stiamo cercando un ingegnere elettrico, di misura e di controllo (EMR). La posizione comprende la responsabilità per la manutenzione e vari progetti in impianti mono o multi-prodotto.

Cosa offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. Trova l'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali Sei sotto:
Vantaggi - Visp

I vostri compiti:

• Pianificazione e realizzazione di attività di investimento e conversione in un impianto di produzione automatizzato per i principi attivi farmaceutici

• adattamento continuo e miglioramento di attrezzature, processi e cambiamenti di prodotto con particolare attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni

• Garantire un funzionamento fluido e prestazioni affidabili di impianti di produzione altamente automatizzati con sistemi DeltaV e MES

• GMP-conforme alle prestazioni di audit, documentazione e gestione dei cambiamenti utilizzando Kneat e Ubik

• Creazione e manutenzione della documentazione degli impianti in SAP/COMOS per garantire i requisiti normativi

• Coordinamento e monitoraggio dei progetti in termini di funzionalità, performance, costi e scadenze

• Sostegno ai progetti dalla pianificazione alla messa in servizio di successo

• Efficiente pianificazione e organizzazione della manutenzione per garantire la disponibilità degli impianti e la sicurezza operativa

• Promuovere i progressi tecnologici attraverso metodi di lavoro innovativi e proattivi

• Partecipazione attiva ai comitati interdisciplinari

Il tuo profilo:

• Laurea completa o master in ingegneria elettrica, automazione o sistemi o informatica

• Prima esperienza professionale nell'ingegneria operativa o di progetto, manutenzione o nuova costruzione di impianti, idealmente in un ambiente GMP-regolato dell'industria farmaceutica o chimica

• Conoscenza di GMP, COMOS, DeltaV, MES e SAP

• La cooperazione interdisciplinare e un metodo di lavoro indipendente e flessibile

• Forte lavoro di squadra e ottime capacità di comunicazione

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Business thinking, alta motivazione e disponibilità a cambiare

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

Become part of our EMR team in Visp!

To strengthen our Engineering & Maintenance team in the area of Development & Manufacturing Solutions at the Visp site, we are looking for an electrical, measurement and control (EMR) engineer. The position includes responsibility for maintenance and various projects in mono- or multi-product plants.

What we offer:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous advantages in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. Find the full list of our global services You are under:
Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Planning and implementation of investment and conversion tasks in an automated production plant for pharmaceutical active ingredients

• Continuous adaptation and improvement of equipment, processes and product changes with focus on quality, safety and performance

• Ensuring the smooth operation and reliable performance of highly automated production facilities with DeltaV and MES systems

• GMP-compliant performance of audits, documentation and change management using Kneat and Ubik

• Creation and maintenance of plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure regulatory requirements

• Coordination and monitoring of projects in terms of functionality, performance, costs and deadlines

• Support of projects from planning to successful commissioning

• Efficient planning and organisation of maintenance to ensure plant availability and operational safety

• Promoting technological advancements through innovative and proactive working methods

• Active participation in interdisciplinary committees

Your profile:

• Completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Automation or Systems Engineering or Computer science

• First professional experience in operation or project engineering, maintenance or new plant construction, ideally in a GMP-regulated environment of the pharmaceutical or chemical industry

• Knowledge of GMP, COMOS, DeltaV, MES and SAP

• Enjoying interdisciplinary cooperation and an independent and flexible working method

• Strong teamwork and very good communication skills

• Good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

• Business thinking, high motivation and willingness to change

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Zur Verstärkung des Teams am Standort Visp wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit für die fachliche Leitung eines EMR-Subteams gesucht. Im Fokus stehen Projektierung, Instandhaltung, Dokumentation, Know-how-Transfer sowie die Einhaltung von GMP- und Sicherheitsvorschriften.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Planung und Umsetzung von Automatisierungsprojekten (Anlagenoptimierungen, Erweiterungen, Produkteumstellungen)

• Technische Verantwortung über alle Projektphasen – von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme

• Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams sowie Teilnahme an Risikoanalysen und Betriebsversuchen

• Sicherstellung einer zuverlässigen, wirtschaftlichen Instandhaltung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Koordination von internen und externen Partnern sowie Überwachung des Instandhaltungsbudgets

• Pflege und laufende Aktualisierung der Anlagendokumentation (SAP, COMOS)

• Verantwortung für GMP-gerechtes Änderungsmanagement und Systempflege

• Fachliche Betreuung definierter EMR-Bereiche sowie Weitergabe von Know-how an Werkstatt- und Betriebspersonal

• Einhaltung und Umsetzung geltender GMP-, Sicherheits- und Umweltvorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium als Ingenieur*in (ETH, FH, HF) in Elektro-, Automations- oder Systemtechnik

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb, in der Instandhaltung oder im Anlagenbau in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Kenntnisse in SAP, COMOS, DeltaV, MES von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, gute Englischkenntnisse

• Strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

• Teamorientiertes Denken, klare Kommunikation und hohe Belastbarkeit

• Offen für neue Technologien und agile Arbeitsweisen

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Menschen werden Teil der Lonza, um herausfordernde und komplexe Problemstellungen durch kreative und innovative Ansätze im Bereich Life Sciences zu lösen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die damit einhergeht, einen sinnvollen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

Se necessario, ai candidati idonei e alle loro famiglie viene offerto supporto per il trasferimento.

Lonza è oggi un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nel settore delle scienze della vita, che opera in tre continenti. Operiamo nel campo della scienza, tuttavia non esiste una formula magica per il modo in cui affrontiamo il lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è rappresentata da collaboratori di talento, che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri collaboratori gestiscono autonomamente la propria carriera. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. Ed è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo far parte.

Per rafforzare il team presso la sede di Visp, si cerca una figura esperta per la guida tecnica di un sottoteam EMR. In primo piano vi sono progettazione, manutenzione, documentazione, trasferimento del know-how e rispetto delle norme GMP e di sicurezza.

Cosa ti offriamo:

- Una carriera agile e una cultura lavorativa dinamica
- Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
- Programmi retributivi che riconoscono le prestazioni di alto livello
- Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, ti aspettano numerosi benefit nell'ambito dello stile di vita, della famiglia e del tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri benefit globali è disponibile anche all'indirizzo: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Le tue mansioni:

- Pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti di automazione (ottimizzazione degli impianti, ampliamenti, cambi di prodotto)
- Responsabilità tecnica in tutte le fasi del progetto – dalla concezione alla messa in servizio
- Collaborazione in team di progetto interdisciplinari e partecipazione ad analisi dei rischi e prove operative
- Garantire una manutenzione affidabile ed economica in un ambiente regolamentato dalle GMP
- Coordinamento di partner interni ed esterni e monitoraggio del budget di manutenzione
- Gestione e aggiornamento continuo della documentazione degli impianti (SAP, COMOS)
- Responsabilità per la gestione delle modifiche conforme alle GMP e la manutenzione dei sistemi
- Supervisione tecnica delle aree EMR designate e trasferimento del know-how al personale di officina e operativo
- Rispetto e attuazione delle disposizioni vigenti in materia di GMP, sicurezza e ambiente

Il tuo profilo:

- Laurea conseguita in ingegneria (ETH, FH, HF), con specializzazione in elettrotecnica, automazione o tecnica dei sistemi
- Esperienza pluriennale nell'esercizio, nella manutenzione o nella costruzione di impianti in un ambiente regolamentato dalle GMP
- La conoscenza di SAP, COMOS, DeltaV e MES costituisce un vantaggio
- Ottima conoscenza del tedesco, parlato e scritto, e buona conoscenza dell'inglese
- Metodo di lavoro strutturato e autonomo, con un elevato senso di responsabilità
- Mentalità orientata al lavoro di squadra, comunicazione chiara e elevata capacità di lavorare sotto pressione
- Apertura verso le nuove tecnologie e i metodi di lavoro agili

Informazioni su Lonza

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno ogni giorno un impatto positivo sulla vita di milioni di persone. Per noi, ciò rappresenta non solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Il modo in cui raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è per noi importante tanto quanto i risultati stessi. In Lonza, il rispetto è un valore fondamentale e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti sia il nostro ambiente. Per noi, il successo significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Le persone entrano a far parte di Lonza per risolvere problematiche impegnative e complesse attraverso approcci creativi e innovativi nel campo delle Life Sciences. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che deriva dal miglioramento della vita in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che deriva dal fare una differenza significativa.

Sei pronto a plasmare il futuro delle Life Sciences? Allora candidati ora!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

If required, relocation support is available to eligible candidates and their families.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach our work. Our most important scientific solution is our talented employees, who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their own careers. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of.

To strengthen the team at the Visp site, an experienced professional is sought to provide technical leadership for an EMR subteam. The focus is on project engineering, maintenance, documentation, knowledge transfer, and compliance with GMP and safety regulations.

What we offer you:

- An agile career and a dynamic work culture
- An inclusive and ethical workplace
- Compensation programs that recognize high performance
- In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the complete list of our global benefits at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your responsibilities:

- Planning and implementation of automation projects (plant optimizations, expansions, product changeovers)
- Technical responsibility throughout all project phases – from conception to commissioning
- Participation in interdisciplinary project teams as well as in risk analyses and operational trials
- Ensuring reliable, cost-effective maintenance in a GMP-regulated environment
- Coordination of internal and external partners and monitoring of the maintenance budget
- Maintenance and continuous updating of plant documentation (SAP, COMOS)
- Responsibility for GMP-compliant change management and system maintenance
- Providing technical support for defined EMR areas and transferring know-how to workshop and operations personnel
- Compliance with and implementation of applicable GMP, safety and environmental requirements

Your profile:

- Completed degree in engineering (ETH, FH, HF) in electrical engineering, automation engineering or systems engineering
- Several years of experience in operations, maintenance or plant construction in a GMP-regulated environment
- Knowledge of SAP, COMOS, DeltaV and MES is an advantage
- Very good German language skills, both spoken and written, and good English language skills
- Structured and independent way of working with a high degree of personal responsibility
- Team-oriented mindset, clear communication and a high ability to work under pressure
- Open to new technologies and agile ways of working

About Lonza

Lonza's products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is highly valued and we protect both our employees and our environment. For us, success means ethically responsible progress.

People join Lonza to solve challenging and complex problems through creative and innovative approaches in the field of Life Sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Ready to help shape the future of Life Sciences? Then apply now!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description

Si nécessaire, une aide à la relocalisation est mise à la disposition des candidats éligibles et de leurs familles.

Lonza est aujourd’hui une entreprise leader dans le monde dans le domaine des sciences de la vie, active sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans le domaine scientifique, mais il n’existe pas de formule magique pour définir notre façon de travailler. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante réside dans des collaborateurs talentueux qui travaillent ensemble et développent des idées aidant d’autres entreprises à aider les gens. En contrepartie, nos collaborateurs pilotent eux-mêmes leur carrière. Car leurs idées, grandes ou petites, améliorent le monde. Et c’est le type de travail auquel nous souhaitons prendre part.

Afin de renforcer l’équipe sur le site de Visp, nous recherchons une personne expérimentée pour assurer la direction technique d’une sous-équipe EMR. L’accent est mis sur la conception de projets, la maintenance, la documentation, le transfert de connaissances ainsi que le respect des prescriptions GMP et de sécurité.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

- Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique
- Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique
- Des programmes de rémunération qui récompensent les hautes performances
- En plus d’un salaire compétitif, vous bénéficierez de nombreux avantages dans les domaines du mode de vie, de la famille et des loisirs. La liste complète de nos avantages à l’échelle mondiale est également disponible à l’adresse suivante : https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Vos tâches :

- Planification et mise en œuvre de projets d’automatisation (optimisation d’installations, extensions, changements de produits)
- Responsabilité technique sur toutes les phases du projet – de la conception à la mise en service
- Participation à des équipes de projet interdisciplinaires ainsi qu’aux analyses de risques et aux essais d’exploitation
- Garantie d’une maintenance fiable et économique dans un environnement soumis aux exigences GMP
- Coordination des partenaires internes et externes ainsi que suivi du budget de maintenance
- Gestion et mise à jour continue de la documentation des installations (SAP, COMOS)
- Responsabilité de la gestion des modifications conforme aux GMP et de la maintenance des systèmes
- Suivi technique des domaines EMR définis ainsi que transmission du savoir-faire au personnel d’atelier et d’exploitation
- Respect et mise en œuvre des exigences GMP, de sécurité et environnementales en vigueur

Votre profil :

- Diplôme d’ingénieur·e (ETH, FH, HF) en électrotechnique, automatisation ou technique des systèmes
- Plusieurs années d’expérience dans l’exploitation, la maintenance ou la construction d’installations dans un environnement réglementé par les GMP
- Connaissances de SAP, COMOS, DeltaV et MES constituant un avantage
- Très bonnes connaissances de l’allemand à l’oral et à l’écrit, bonnes connaissances de l’anglais
- Méthode de travail structurée et autonome, avec un sens aigu des responsabilités
- Esprit d’équipe, communication claire et grande résistance au stress
- Ouvert aux nouvelles technologies et aux méthodes de travail agiles

À propos de Lonza

Les produits et services de Lonza ont chaque jour un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, cela représente non seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La manière dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est pour nous tout aussi importante que nos réussites elles-mêmes. Chez Lonza, le respect est une valeur fondamentale et nous protégeons aussi bien nos collaborateurs que notre environnement. Pour nous, la réussite signifie un progrès moralement acceptable.

Les personnes rejoignent Lonza afin de résoudre des problématiques difficiles et complexes grâce à des approches créatives et innovantes dans le domaine des sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui accompagne l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui accompagne le fait de faire une différence significative.

Êtes-vous prêt(e) à contribuer à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie ? Alors, postulez dès maintenant !

jobs.title: DeltaV Automation Engineer 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Join our Automation Engineering Team!

We are looking for a DeltaV Automation Engineer or Electrical Instrumentation & Control Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in a dynamic, cutting-edge environment where your work will significantly contribute to shaping the future of medicine.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Planning and realization of electrical MSR readiness (maintenance, changeovers, improvements) within the available budget and timelines

• Ensuring seamless operation and flawless performance of high-automated Biologics facilities equipped with DeltaV and MES systems. Equivalent experience is also acceptable for educational requirements like MES

• Managing GMP-compliant activities, including testing, documentation, and change management using systems such as Kneat and Ubik

• Preparing and updating plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards

• Determining and implementing continuous improvements in equipment and maintenance processes to improve efficiency and reliability

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine internal procedures and achieve optimized workflows

What we are looking for:

• Equivalent experience in Electrical or System Engineering or a related field, including University Degree or equivalent experience, or vocational education (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)

• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of pharmaceutical plants or the biotech industry

• Proficiency in SAP, COMOS (Plant Engineering Software), DeltaV (Process Control System), and MES Syncade (Manufacturing Execution System) is highly desirable

• Proficient in English and/or German to competently communicate in our diverse, collaborative environment

• Familiarity with GMP standards and protocols to ensure compliance in a regulated manufacturing setting

• A self-reliant, trustworthy, and effective working approach that ensures successful completion of tasks and projects

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'assistenza per il trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati e le loro famiglie, garantendo una transizione agevole alla nostra comunità di accoglienza a Visp.

Oggi Lonza è leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è alcuna formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più grande è persone di talento che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possiede la loro carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, veramente migliorare il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare parte di.

Stiamo cercando un'ingegnere di automazione DeltaV o un ingegnere di controllo e strumentazione elettrica (m/f/d) per unirsi a noi in un ambiente dinamico e all'avanguardia dove il vostro lavoro contribuirà in modo significativo a plasmare il futuro della medicina.

Quello che avrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione

• L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile anche su https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Cosa farete:

• Progettazione e realizzazione della prontezza dell'MSR elettrica (manutenzione, cambi, miglioramenti) entro i termini e il budget disponibili

• Garantire un funzionamento senza soluzione di continuità e prestazioni impeccabili di impianti biologici ad alta automazione dotati di sistemi DeltaV e MES. Esperienza equivalente è accettabile anche per esigenze educative come MES

• Gestione delle attività conformi al GMP, inclusi test, documentazione e gestione dei cambiamenti utilizzando sistemi come Kneat e Ubik

• Preparazione e aggiornamento della documentazione dell'impianto in SAP/COMOS per garantire la stretta conformità agli standard normativi

• Determinazione e attuazione di continui miglioramenti nelle apparecchiature e nei processi di manutenzione per migliorare efficienza e affidabilità

• Ilgarantire con squadre cross-funzionali per affinare le procedure interne e ottenere flussi di lavoro ottimizzati

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza equivalente in ingegneria elettrica o di sistema o in un campo correlato, compreso il diploma universitario o l'esperienza equivalente, o formazione professionale (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)

• Esperienza professionale nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di impianti farmaceutici o dell'industria biotecnologica

• La competenza in SAP, COMOS (Software di Ingegneria Piantata), DeltaV (Sistema di Controllo del Processo) e MES Syncade (Sistema di Esecuzione Manufacturing) è altamente auspicabile

• In inglese e/o tedesco competenti a comunicare con competenza nel nostro ambiente collaborativo diversificato

• Fa 1ster con standard e protocolli GMP per garantire la conformità in un set di produzione regolamentato

• Un approccio di lavoro auto-reliente, affidabile ed efficace che garantisce il completamento di compiti e progetti

Ogni giorno, prodotti e servizi Lonza ha un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante come i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo che raggiungiamo non è un successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con il miglioramento della vita in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader mondiale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti impianti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau

• Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen

• Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern,  bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen

• Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Entra a far parte del nostro team di officina come costruttore di impianti e apparecchiature!

In questo ruolo vario, ti occuperai di lavori impegnativi nell’ambito della costruzione di tubazioni, nonché della manutenzione reattiva, proattiva e preventiva dei nostri impianti di produzione. Grazie alla tua abilità artigianale e alle tue competenze tecniche specialistiche, garantirai il funzionamento sicuro e affidabile dei nostri sistemi di tubazioni. In questo modo darai un importante contributo all’elevata disponibilità degli impianti, alla qualità dei prodotti e al rispetto dei nostri standard di qualità, sicurezza e conformità presso il sito di Visp.

Cosa ti offriamo:

- Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
- Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
- Programmi retributivi che premiano le prestazioni elevate
- Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, ti aspettano numerosi vantaggi nei settori dello stile di vita, della famiglia e del tempo libero. L’elenco completo dei nostri benefit globali è disponibile anche all’indirizzo: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Le tue mansioni:

- Misurare, realizzare e montare a regola d’arte e in modo efficiente tubazioni e sistemi di supporto complessi nell’ambito della costruzione di tubazioni
- Creare isometrie e segmenti di tubazione in conformità con le specifiche tecniche e i requisiti di progetto
- Pianificare e organizzare i processi di lavoro sulla base degli schemi di flusso R&I, nell’ambito dei lavori di progetto e degli adeguamenti degli impianti
- Applicare le direttive PED e lavorare secondo le classi di tubazioni interne, le norme aziendali e le prescrizioni per la garanzia della qualità

Il tuo profilo:

- Formazione professionale completata come costruttore di impianti e apparecchiature EFZ specializzato nella costruzione di tubazioni, montatore di tubazioni, installatore di impianti di riscaldamento o installatore sanitario
- È preferibile una pluriennale esperienza professionale come montatore di tubazioni o prefabbricatore di tubazioni
- Disponibilità alla formazione continua
- Propensione al lavoro interfunzionale e capacità di lavorare in modo autonomo e flessibile in team
- Affidabilità, resistenza allo stress, spirito imprenditoriale e comunicazione aperta e diretta
- Conoscenza del tedesco parlato e scritto; la conoscenza dell’inglese costituisce titolo preferenziale

Informazioni su Lonza

In Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra più grande forza. In oltre 30 sedi distribuite sui cinque continenti, i nostri team connessi a livello globale lavorano ogni giorno insieme per produrre i medicinali di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di ogni singola persona, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale per migliorare milioni di vite, ed è proprio a questo che desideriamo renderla partecipe.

L’innovazione prospera quando persone dalle origini più diverse contribuiscono con le loro prospettive uniche. In Lonza apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se è pronto a trasformare le idee rivoluzionarie dei nostri clienti in terapie praticabili, saremo lieti di darle il benvenuto a bordo.

Candidatura

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle Life Sciences? Candidati ora!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Relocation support is available to eligible candidates and their families as needed.

Join our workshop team as a plant and apparatus fabricator!

In this varied role, you will take on demanding work in the field of piping as well as the reactive, proactive and preventive maintenance of our production facilities. With your practical skills and technical expertise, you will ensure the safe and reliable operation of our piping systems. In doing so, you will make an important contribution to high plant availability, product quality and compliance with our quality, safety and compliance standards at the Visp site.

What we offer you:

- An agile career and a dynamic work culture
- An inclusive and ethical workplace
- Compensation programs that recognize high performance
- In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the complete list of our global benefits at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your responsibilities:

- Accurate and cost-effective measuring, fabrication and installation of demanding pipelines and support systems in piping construction
- Creating isometric drawings and piping segments in accordance with technical specifications and project requirements
- Planning and organizing workflows based on P&ID flow diagrams for project work and plant modifications
- Applying PED guidelines and working in accordance with internal pipe classes, company standards and quality assurance requirements

Your profile:

- Completed vocational training as a plant and apparatus fabricator EFZ specializing in piping, or as a pipefitter, heating installer or sanitary installer
- Several years of professional experience as a pipefitter or pipe fabricator is an advantage
- Willingness to pursue continuous further training
- Enjoyment of cross-departmental work as well as the ability to work independently and flexibly in a team
- Reliability, resilience, entrepreneurial thinking and action, as well as open, direct communication
- German language skills, both spoken and written; English skills are an advantage

About Lonza

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to make the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values—collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity—reflect who we are and how we work together. The ideas of every individual, whether big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is exactly what we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from the most diverse backgrounds contribute their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to turn our customers' groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Application
